name: Elite Force
description: The Elite Force is one of the most prominent teams throughout the Eliteverse. The team consists of numerous individuals who has their own separate stories. Each member at times lives at Anura under the leadership of the headmistress, Celestria.

name: Zane
description: Zane is one of the most powerful beings, born over 3,000 years ago to Raphael and a Demon. He has since been a demon serving in the army of Chaos and an angel serving under the army of Elite Force. Now he is one of the oldest members of the Elite Force and has since been their leader. It is known that after he helped a little girl escape a raid by his army he knew of the goodness in humans and shortly after became their savior. Now he helps the other members of Elite Force protect mankind from demons and evil powered Descendants.
affiliates: Elite Force; Army of Chaos; The Immortals
abilities: Immortality; Telekinesis; Telepathy; Control over the weather; Teleportation; Invincibility; Flight

name: Samantha Cue
description: During her internship at MIT, Samantha discovered she could see into the future and foresaw the battle of Angels and Demons. She was later joined by Zane in hopes to stop this from happening and to bring peace to Earth. During her teen years, Samantha’s parents died in a car crash while visiting family in NYC, since then Samantha has been in several foster homes and eventually on her own. She worked at numerous jobs to pay for her way through college, she met Brian while attending MIT and the two joined SAA to help develop their abilities. Because of her abilities, Samantha knew that she had to learn to defend herself so she learned martial arts and has been training in the combat zone at SAA. In the year 2074, Samantha as The Oracle is one of the most sought out beings and a member of Elite Force team of psychics named The Mentals.

name: Samuel Owens
description: While away at school, Samuel returns home to find out his family has been captured by the Army of Chaos and wants his abilities for their own. Once joining Elite Force, Samuel’s new goal is to stop the army and rescue his family. In this year 2017, Samuel joins the Enlighten Ones in hopes to bring peace to Heaven and restore balance. Their main enemies are the Underworlders.

name: Seile Borbruen
description: Seile was born to a mutant mother and a human father who believe that keeping their daughter from the mutant world was the best. While traveling through the Amazon, Seile first learn of her abilities to shapeshift and used it to discover the Tomb of Alfeus. Once the discovery had been made, Seile unlock the blackest magic in history and begun the war between Angels and Demons. Since then she had joined Elite Force in hopes to bring justice. In the year 2020, Seile joins forces with the Doppelganger, the two married and gave birth to Lela (a powerful high level mutant that one day will lead the army of the Angels against the Demons)

name: Alexa Duncan
description: Alexa is twin sister of Alex (also known as Sun Man), she haves power over nature and uses her ability to mend her flower shop in Queens, New York. During their youth, Alexa and Alex used their abilities to help their mother put on shows and compete in contest. Their rewards would help pay bills and keep their family fed, however once their mother died of an illness, Alexa and Alex separated and Alex went to school to become a Herbologist while her brother a historian. Alexa joined the ranks of the Elementals of which she later would leave to join Elite Force.
abilities: Power over Nature; Limited power over the ground; Limited Telepathy

name: Max Thisend
description: Max was one of the smartest students in his class, he used his abilities to control time to learn more about the information he classes contain. While attending high school his secret was discovered and he was shipped off to SAA to enhance his abilities. Because of his high level abilities, Max would help Elite Force on and off however his status as one of them isn’t really known.

name: Jane Fawlkner
description: During the war of machines in the year 3105, Jane was mother of three and wife of a powerful governor who didn’t know of her abilities until one day the war of machines caused her abilities to show them and since then she became a fighter to save the world and her family. Jane controls all technology and can transform her body into massive amounts of technology. Jane travelled back in time to the age of Elite Force in order to gain enough knowledge and power to defeat the Cerebral Androids.

name: Celestia Barns
description: Headmistress Celestia Barns was one of the original super-powered humans that fought in the great war of gods, angels, & demons. Her parents were angels with great strength and speed and some say she contain similar abilities. Mostly seen has been her kindness to others with little demeanor toward hatred or anger. Her abilities range from control over minds, telekinesis, power drainage, & immortality. However she contains an extensive list of abilities, she has since her arrival to SAA only shown minor mirror of her true abilities. Celestia became headmistress after the original facility disappears during the raid of 1641 and has since been one of the most prominent figures in Elite Comics history.
affiliates: The Immortals; SAA (School of Angels; Descendants); Elite Force

name: Brian Kyle
description: Brian Kyle was one of the smartest people in his school, graduating high school at 15 and college at 18. Brian was called Gadget by 20 years old because of his ability to fix anything and his passion for technology. He was admitted into MIT by 21 and graduated top of his class by 23 a record for any student in the school’s history. His abilities allow him to create technology out of almost any substance and fix it at will with little to no prior knowledge of the device. His abilities are called Technopathy and from it, he can also produce weapons and computers out of his body parts. At one point he created giant beasts to travel with and fight with while in Aurelia while his fellow Elite Force members lost their abilities. His honors admitted him to SAA where he begun assisting Elite Force and served as assistant to Celestia “headmistress”
affiliates: SAA and Elite Force; Elite Force

name: Aldi-ri
description: An ancient group of demon slaying beings that was given powers by the angels to defeat their enemies. During the moment, this group of empowered beings encountered their first demon on Earth, demonic activity has since grew.

name: Aldi-ri
description: The Aldi-ri was the first demon slayers, within their bodies laid the 7 temples that protected the resting place of Belckus. When the world started to grow, the Aldi-ri knowing of their coming ascension to Heaven turned their bodies into the 7 temples and allowed one of their members to remain both in Hell and on Earth to protect against the demons that were looking to destroy the 7 temples. To make it harder to open the temples, the Aldi-ri scattered the 7 temples across the world and set a total of 66 seals circling each temple for added protection. In many myths it is believed that the Aldi-ri are responsible for constructing weapons to defeat demons and several of their kind such as blessing water to kill vampires (Holy Water), cursing doorways, cursing the moon and sun, cursing steel, and even blessing All Hollows Eve.
abilities: Creates portals; Omniprescenes; Galactic Beings; Angelic abilities; Demonic Abilities; Ominisense; Skilled swordsmans

name: Korse
description:
Age: Estimated over 6,000 years old

Called upon every 1,000 years to fight against the dark forces, Korse was one of the most powerful demon watchers of his time. He once fought a demon lord and his arm was severed, thus the cloth like structure that he has where his left arm once was. Korse appears as he is in his late 20s with long white hair and at times demonic like appearances like horns, black eyes, and markings of demonic origins around his body. It is believed that he is of demon blood however no one has found any definite proof. Korse was called upon to join the Nightwalkers when one of his returning enemies found its way back to the land of the living.
abilities: Sensing of demons; Energy based attacks; Turns blood into weapons; Great speed; Skilled swordsman

name: Alien 6
description: Aliens that travelled to Earth to only get stuck on our world and begins to protect it from the alien forces that has followed them here. Each member is from a different race and collectively they will combine their talents, knowledge, and power to stop anything from disrupting their new home.

name: Dain Richardson
description: Considered to be apart of secret society that once visited Earth during a raid of alien Descendants that wanted to find out Earth secrets to make themselves more powerful. Dain would later returned this time apart of a different team that over time would serve as their own partial government implanting a secret plan to unearth some of our world’s greatest secrets and technologies.

name: Debrah Nox
description:
Abilities: Body is composed of a non-toxic form of mercury

Debrah Nox was from the planet Tuwai, from her world she was considered the most beautiful with her black marble skin. She could stretch her body at will and produce toxins that could cause death if needed. She first met The Banisher at a Galactic Conference on Earth’s moon and from there she would join his ranks in order to provide immunity and peace to her homeworld as it was at war from a neighboring planet.
abilities: Which she can reshape; Stretch at will

name: Dedlin Rigin
description: Dedlin became Super Charge on his world, Tamaron when he had to fight his government. He was considered its Robin Hood as he fought for the less fortunate and was considered a vigilante. He joined the other Alien 6 members during the Galactic Conference waiting approval to take on his government for rights for his people.
abilities: Ability to charge metal with bio-energy

name: Venna Vardos
description: Venna Vardos was the most wanted on her planet because of her dangerous abilities. She escaped to the Galactic Conference disguising herself aas a princess fighting for her planet. She met the other future members of the Alien 6 of who (disguised as a princess fighting for her home world) invited her to their team. Over time she fought as a hero, vigilante, and villain, with her team members never truly knowing who she is.
abilities: Ability to induce extreme disorientation; Nausea; Unconsciousness

name: Ken Rodish
description:
Abilities: Metabolizes kinetic energy into greater physical attributes

Ken Rodish also known as Mr. Ken was one of the first members of the Alien 6 to induct others to hopefully fight against the Galactic Alliance in uniting all worlds together under one law and one order, controlling their very existence. United by other teams from across the galaxy, the Alien 6 and others formed the Galactic Conference.

name: Sesta Vitchi
description:
Abilities: Mechanical genius Able to create numerous types of energy

Main speaker of the Galactic Conference, Sesta also known as Lady Cyborg was very intelligent and possessed unique ways of uniting others from different cultures and worlds as one. She saw the Alien 6 and united them and led them against her enemies the Galactic Alliance.

name: Alpha 6
description: Created through a chemical spill that spilled out into the center of Elite City

name: Genoe
description:
Age: 19 (human age)

Solar boy was one of the first to create the Alpha 6; it was his goal to comprise a group strong enough to destroy the aliens that attacked his home world. While on Earth searching for these Descendants, Solar boy named Genoe fell in love with one of his fellow teammates The White Archess.

name: Linda Fairview
description: Linda never knew really what her purpose was in life, until that is when she met Genoe and the two fell in love while he was on Earth. She traveled around the planet in search of others while in the process dating Genoe. Back on Solar Boy’s world, the two married and had a son whose power would end the century old war that the two were in the midst of.

name: Bethany
description: Bethany was always known by her name the Screeching Harlet because of her sonic blasts that she emits while screaming. Seen with long white and gray hair and ghostly figure, Bethany was believed to have died centuries ago only remaining behind to take vengeance on the descendants of the criminals that took her life. She joined the Alpha 6 in hopes to gather the strength to defeat the last bloodline of the criminals.

name: Breck Daniels
description: Breck Daniels was one of the many soldiers in his father’s army to protect the world from an evil race of giant robots. By his fans, he is known as Energy Man and by many as the Source of Power because of his energy regeneration abilities.

name: Dorothy Harmon
description: Dorothy Harmon grew up in a small town south of Atlanta, GA and was one of the prettiest girls in her town. She won numerous pageants and was adored by her peers until she caught a virus that caused a strange transformation. Her body bulked up and everything that she touches was absorbed into negative energy of which she could release through great physical force. To find help to return back to normal, she joined the Alpha 6 and sometimes after she learn to accept her mutation and help others with her now found abilities.

name: Vector Reems
description: Fan of the bugs in his mother’s garden house, Vector Reems has devoted his life to find out everything he could about bugs and protecting the ones he come in contact with. One day while researching one of these specimens, Vector got poisoned by one of his insects causing him to react strangely. He received powers similar to that of a bug, he literally had every ability of a bug and could become smaller and bigger at will as one of his abilities. As an adult, Vector now known as Parasect would moonlight as both a team member of the Insectious 4 and Alpha 6.
abilities: Insect like abilities; Bug wings; Venom; Great hearing; Sight; Ability to see in the dark; Longevity; Durability

name: Alpha Beta Club
description: With his super powered team of college students, Coach Darrel Hines brought the group together in hopes to keep them out of trouble. Little did he knew at the time that each one of them had their own special abilities caused by a mysterious star shower that hit their caravan while they were on their way to their first tournament.

name: Ervin Lorenso
description: Ervin Lorenso was a professional football player that used his great speed and gift of strategic thinking to win several games unknowingly to his team and opponents. Ervin was discovering by an elite team of sports enthusiasts who each had similar abilities related to sports called the Alpha Beta Club.

name: Michael Dowin
description: Michael Dowin was considered a professional basketball player because of his enhanced ability to omit fireballs in shape of basketballs from his hands and control their movements. He would disguise the balls like basketballs and make the perfect goals. He was inducted into the NBA at 19 and met with Darrell Hines when he was 20 and worked part time as a member of the Alpha Beta Club.

name: Daniel Goop
description: Daniel Goop could have been the world’s best soccer player because of his ability. He had great speed, fast reflexes, and could see movements before they were done during a technique similar to premonitions. However when he was 19 he was discovered by Darrell Hines who was able to induct him into an elite society called Alpha Beta Club and made a vigilante.
abilities: Great Speed; Inhuman reflexes; Precognic motion sensing

name: Johnathan Stevens
description: Johnathan Stevens had the unique ability to turn his hands into tennis racket like object which could be used as swords and reflect other abilities thrown at him. He was known as the Player because of his great speed and intellectual thinking. He joined the Alpha Beta Club because of his similar interests in sports.

name: Sin Arnold Baines
description:
Abilities: Spiked like balls emitting of pure energy

Sin Arnold Baines was the captain of his volleyball team. He traveled the country in hopes to find others to join his team however he eventually broke the group up to join the Alpha Beta Club.

name: Coach Darrell Hines
description: Coach Darrell Hines was one of the most sought out professional sports coach in the world mostly because of his ability to provide good numbers during chapter games. However one day, Darrell let the pressure of winning and rich and fame get to him causing him to drink himself into insanity. From that moment, Darrell used his new insanity to recreate his varsity teams under the name Alpha Beta Club however this time around with a mission to literally destroy other teams as he makes it into the major playoffs.

name: Androids 168
description: Created to be superior to humans, yet allow their own unique personalities cause them to resemble those same humans.

name: Android 7 “Se7en”
description: Created to take on a human life, Android 7 or as she calls herself amongst humans, Se7en or Seven.  Se7en is tall, blonde, and the stereotypical cheerleader with no signs of being a robot, even her insides is human with robotic parts around organs to give her a longer life and abilities similar to those of an abnormal. Her creator remains a mystery but is believed by her and her two brothers to be A.N.G.E.L.
abilities: Super Strength; Great Intellect; Lazer beams; Flight; Ice breath; Control over the wind

name: Android 6
description: Often leader and oldest of his siblings, although only 3 years old, he appears about 17 and takes on the mature role of protecting his family and fighting for any cause that he believes in regardless if its right or wrong. He appears as the stereotypical jock in school with little to no signs of being a robot. He lost his virginity to the school’s head cheerleader much to his sister hatred. With his siblings, he forms the Androids 168 and together they fight crime and at times are often enemies of other superheroes believing that they should be the only ones.
abilities: Super Strength; Great Intellect; Fire breathing; Can melt things with his hands; Super speed

name: Android 8
description: When Android 6 proved to be a successful attempt at creating the perfect teenager and cover-up operation, Android 8 also known in his human form as Huit was created. He is the stereotypical geek that wears glasses, a pocket protector, and abnormal intellect.  His abilities to control the water around him has made him one of the strongest of his siblings and at times the most powerful because he can also control the water found in bodies.
abilities: Super strength; Great intellect; Control over water

name: Angel Slayers
description: Weapon wielding individuals that despise angels and their self-righteous attitudes. They have taken an oath to wipe the heavens of all angels before Santaniel returns.

name: Damion Scarse
description: One of the youngest Angel Slayers and a ruthless tyrant that uses his abilities to kill angels and other Descendants. Damion also known as Litch was born in South Korea and uses his influence there to train future Angel Slayers.
abilities: Enhanced Strength; Rapid speed; Giant invisible wings; Necklace that can kill angels

name: Monique Woods
description: A powerful weapon yet beautiful creature that took human form after being released from hell. Her demonic skin can kill normal humans if touched so to not bring attention to herself she is always seen covered in clothes. Her hair is made of acid and mixed the correct way it can kill other demons including her. She was giving a knife that can kill angels and is one of the secret beauties of the team and one of its most deadly.
abilities: Enhanced Strength; Long hair made of acid; Knife that can kill angels

name: Phillip Hawns
description: Phillip Hawns uses his powers over time to kill his opponents, son of the god Shecknurd; he is the many of Shecknurd’s children that has symbols of Lium “home of the gods” around his body which in return protects him from magic. He joined the Angel Slayers as Billith and has since discarded his godly ancestory.
abilities: Enhanced Strength; Time Manipulation; Dagger that can kill angels

name: Linly Victos
description: Known for trapping her opponents in a trap made of harden blood. Linly often called the Trap queen is a powerful advisory that is part vampire and part demonic spirit. From her heart lies the souls of all those that she has since killed since her birth. Rumor lies that she has the power to use those souls to control blood in living beings even in those of immortals and alien races. Linly is considered the most powerful member of the Angel Slayers and at times in the absence of the Bornock, she is their leader.
abilities: Enhanced Strength; Control over Blood; Ambulant to kill angels

name: Ginsing Conan
description:
Abilities: Can turn his bones into metallic structure weapons

Ginsing Conan is known for his appearance, body made of pure steel bones, Ginsing also called Ace was given a ring that could kill angels by glaring upon their skin. It was said that he himself is a demonic soul that escape from hell during the Black Raid saga.
abilities: Enhanced Strength; Ring to kill angels

name: Lumus Ventura
description: Known through South Asia because of his brute force tactics used to take over foreign countries. Lumus adopted the name Bornock because of its Elitshian name meaning “control”. It is believed that his longevity comes from an ancient spell that he received from the 13th son of Bewithia. Since the spell’s interaction, Lumus has travelled the world countless times in search of a powerful race of angel slayers, naming his team of such. He would name them the Angel Slayers because of the weapons they carried around their bodies that allowed them to weaken angels so they can kill them and take their knowledge and abilities. He however only created a few known group of angel slayers, with over 7 regions of angel slayer teams in the world.
abilities: Enhanced Strength; Control over beats; Demons; Sword to kill angels

name: Arabian Thieves
description: Some of the greatest thieves in history, the team of disastrous thieves prides themselves on gathering all the world’s most precious items.

name: Mischa Idura
description: Mischa Idura was the beautiful wife to Sensai, the King of Barburis. After many years of serving as his advisor and unknowningly to his knowledge, his very own protector. Mischa decided to use her abilities over dust to help out with the kingdom of which she helped to rule. She became the Sand Gypsy.

name: Daniel Arshka
description: Daniel Arshka fought alongside his fellow thieves to protect the poor from the hands of Sensai. Daniel met Mischa while trying to destroy the royal kingdom, after years of fighting, the two found love in each other after mutually saving a small girl from one of Sensai men who was destroying her home for a new mall. Daniel went by the name Lord of Sand because of his similar abilities over the sands.

name: Minden Rockari
description:
Abilities: Body Manipulation with the help of sand

Minden Rockari was the main general of Daniel Arshka over his Arabian Thieves. He possessed the ability to turn sand into hard substance stronger than diamond however slicker than ice. He could also turn the sand into differnet shapes and turn his body to match different alloids.

name: Arma Indras
description: One of the most feared groups of villains in history, the Arma Indras has caused some of the biggest crimes throughout history. Starting from their home of Russia all the way down to Elite City.

name: Sika Sibuichi
description: Responsible for terrorizing several cities with her mind abilities, Sika Sibuichi has always been a woman of fear to others. Once while a child, Sika probed the mind of her mother of whom she found out was going to send her away to boarding school because of her attitudes. While her mother was asleep one night, Sika used her abilities to place her mom into an eternity long coma. These actions led, Sika to go on the run of which later on in life she would join the Arma Indras who accepted her because of her dark personality and twisted ways of thinking. At one point of her life she would join forces with The Mentals to gain more power over the mind.

name: Kenith James
description: Born in Translyvannia, Kenith James is not a stranger to be called a vampire, mostly because of his old world uniforms, british accent, and vampire like teeth, even his entire personality is dark. Kenith would learn quickly that the world was an ugly place and that it would take him and others to fix it in their own twisted image. Kenith would travel the world as Kinect and would recruit four powerful Descendants that could utilize the power over the mind and use it for their advantage.

name: Shaun Masters
description: Shaun Masters was pronounced brain dead at the end of the year 2006, suffering from a deadly car crash, Shaun would be trapped in a world made of illusions and dreams and would learn how to survive very quickly. As many people thought Shaun was dead, his mind was very much alive, of which he learned how to manipulate dreams and use it to contact others. While visiting a dream of a powerful mental named Kinect, Shaun now known as Dream Scape would get to know the individual and work on his team as a guy on the inside as Kinect called him.

name: Mark Biesters
description: Paralyzed due to a horrible skiing accident, Mark Biesters found himself stuck in a wheel chair forever. After years of feeling angry at himself and the world around him, Mark would use his dreams to escape reality, a place where he could walk once again. Unknown to him at the time he would be able to use his dream self in the real world through a powerful form of Astral Projection. This event in his life led him to join the Arma Indras after meeting Kenith James in a dream he had, to learn more about his abilities and to make them as powerful as ever.

name: Armored Guild
description: Using powered suits, these crime fighting vigilantes find themselves going after the newly created Guild of Super Villains.

name: Gaylen Armorage
description:
Abilities: Suit powered with giant lazer beams from his hands

Traveling all the way from America to Elite City, Gaylen created a secret team of super armored heroes that caused more damage when saving the day. Where they fall short of not causing damage to the city. The entire city is greatly protected by Gaylen and his team. Gaylen is one of the seven smartest people in the world having created his billion-dollar collection of suits each aimed at different aspects of being a hero.

name: Perla Jamison
description:
Abilities: Long steel hair that can be used like a whip

During the age when heroes and villians are all battling each other, Perla Jamison decided to try out one of her father’s inventions where psionic charges from pads on an armor were used in the Great World War between Elite City, Atlantis, Muu, and Russia. The suit fell into dismay causing Perla’s father death. She becomes the Iron Maiden to battle alongside her new mentor Steel Knight as part of the Armored Guild.
abilities: Suit powered; Super strength; Enhanced vision; Lazer beams from fingers; Eyes

name: Bushka Oldmidilhy
description: Following the Russian war against numerous other countries during the Great World War, Bushka found himself on the wrong side of the war and allied against his home Russia. For this he was hunted until he found Alds Jamison twenty years ago and became the Metal Warrior using one of his armored heroes. Later in life, he joins the Armored Guild believing their mission is the same as Jamison’s dream years ago.
abilities: Suit powered; Super strength; Enhanced speed; Lazer beams from mouth

name: Cris Ivors
description:
Abilities: Suit powered symbiote that gives him super strength; Lazer beams from glass orbs on his head

Born to a defected skull, Cris was always in the hospital and was considered critical. Until one day he was visited by an irish woman who promised that he would live to be a hero and take on the name of Marble Patriot. The vision came true when a surgery performed by an alien giften him with a symbiotic suit that gives him incredible powers. He joins the Armored Guild for several years while also being a solo hero.

name: Dominus Casen
description: Dominus has a split personality disorder that causes him to become a villain overnight. During the day he is a part of the Armored Guild as a hero while at night his other half becomes dangerous and comits many crimes against his fellow team members. His condition worsens whenever he comes in direct contact with the moon’s light. His suit was given to him through a discovery of an alien ship one night when he had his first episode. It is believed that the ship gave him his split personality disorder through a discharge before the ship exploded.
abilities: Suit powered with super strength; Lazer beams from feet; Hands; Enhanced speed; Invisibility

name: Army of Chaos
description: Like their name states, the Army of Chaos brings chaos behind them wherever they are, led by one of the deadliest criminals in history, Armageddon. Their goal is to bring an end to current life as they see it as unfit for the precious lands around us.

name: Azir Oriya
description: 10,000 years ago, there lived a tyrant by the name of Azir Oriya. With his rampage he forced many cities and countries into slavery and caused many deaths. His greed for power caused him to invoke in powerful dark magic that gave him more power than anything in the universe. He was however consumed by so much black magic that it overcrowded his mind causing him to be placed into an inanimate state. During his sleep Azir’s slaves placed him into a tomb. It is told that he would be released from his sleep and brings forth Armageddon which brought on his name during the 18th century by scholars.
abilities: Immortality; Enhanced physical abilities; Psychic abilities; Elemental powers

name: Nerfitia
description: A long time ago sealed away for punishing thousands existed a queen known as Nerfitia and alongside her existed powerful spirits known as the Denri. She used the life forces of others to move throughout the dimensions bringing destruction. It wasn’t until her death that her reign lasted for nearly 100 years. Brought back by Armageddon, Nerfitia also known as the Black Shadow returns to continue her pledge of world domination. It is written that Nerfitia and Azir Oriya if reunited would be the rulers of the new world and destroy those that oppose them.
affiliates: Army of Chaos; leader of the Denri
abilities: Power over the dead; Shadows; Telekinesis

name: Elasen Reicks
description: Elasen was born to mortal parents however he grew up with powers which caused him to be outcast by almost everyone he met. This caused a void between Elasen and everyone around him which invoked his abilities to cause clones of himself to bring havoc to everyone.

name: Sarerara
description: Sarerara as a child was left alone most of her life while her parents went searching for her long lost sister. This caused Sarerara to grow tired of her parents’ absence and her loneliness, turning her evil in the process. She cast a powerful curse over her kingdom and would rule it and its surrounding planets. She would then go by the title The Dark Mistress.

name: Tommie Hendricks
description: Not much is known of Tommie Hendricks because of his secretive past. The only thing that most know of him is that he hates neutrally anything and only works alongside Armageddon to give him more power and dispel of anything that stops him from enjoying his peace.

name: Jimmy Beleign
description: Father of two and husband to an adoring wife, caused Jimmy Beleign to leave home for a job that would secure his family’s household. Out of work and nowhere to get a job, Jimmy took an offer from a mysterious character that would cause him to steal and even kill others. Over time, Jimmy forgotten of his ways and after placing his family a nice fortune, Jimmy relocated and joined the Army of Chaos apparently brain washed by dark magic. However after the great war of angels and demons, not much is mention of what happens to him, although a story in Chapter 13 suggested that he became a powerful political figure living a new life.

name: Mira Aiden
description: Constantly picked on in school, caused Mira to eventually drop out and run away from home. While away in KanSAA, Mira met up with a bug that gave her poisonous attributes. In Chapter 24, Mira leaves the Army of Chaos and joins the Insectous 4 where she then leads the group after Vernia left the group.

name: Gertrude Porvix
description: Gertrude has always been one of the most feared beings in the universe. She can control the energy around her and uses it to battle her enemies. Although her past isn’t known she made certain that her major goal in life would be to control the world. Her ability to control the dark energy in people allows her to be one of the most powerful Descendants.

name: Ascension
description: Finding each other when the other needed help, this team of unique individuals uses their abilities to cast a glow of hope for anyone that has once been abandoned or needed help.

name: Tricia-anne Helton
description:
Abilities: Able to control others through her voice

Capable of controlling individuals with spoken tongue, Tricia-anne has been using her gifts since she was a little girl and often got her in trouble with many including the law and her parents. Placed in TANTIRITH at a young age, Tricia-anne became Voix when she helped the team to defeat a psychopath. When she was captured by Abyss in an attempt to get to the Elite Force, Voix realized that she wasn’t interested in crime fighting and resulted to becoming a teacher at TANTIRITH instead. In the future, she returns as a member of a new group and becomes its leader.

name: Chaz Riverson
description:
A gentle soul with a electric heart is what his grandmother the previous Guardian Soul used to call him. However, the world knew him as the superhero Electrician during the 90s and 2000s. During these times, Chaz could borrow the electricity from devices and machinery to build up his power. His armor was a small conductor that could generate massive amounts of electricity which would be used as shields, weapons, attacks, and even modes of flight and teleportation. One day while fighting Molecule, Chaz was hurt so bad that he feared he wouldn’t live to see his, at the time newborn twins, so he quit the superhero business. In the years to come, he would raise his twins Kilo and Watts unaware of their own superhero identity.

When he was young, Chaz was one of the few kids able to rob a bank and leave no trace. He has since been sought out by hundreds of robbers and villians for his abilities to write anything into reality using his blood. He goes by Blood D’nero because of his unique and rare abilities and often assists with stealing from high security places. It is revealed that in the near future he becomes a good guy and becomes part of the team Ascension.

name: Justyn Hale
description: Once a villain capable of destroying cities using blackholes, Justyn Hale destroyed his home, killed his parents, and has only his memories and his dog to keep him comfort and at times alive. His constant hatred for his abilities and his string of bad luck in life causes him to often do things that he wish he didn’t such as destroying various locations throughout time. It is revealed in one story that, Justyn uses his abilities and at times is sucked into the blackhole only to appear in various places in time and the reason behind such tragic events such as Atlantis, Pompei; etc falling is because of his destructive powers. The reason revealed that he doesn’t die when entering the blackholes is because he is the creator of them and can subconsciencely control them. Justyn becomes a member of Ascension because of his unique abilities and slowly redeems himself by saving others.
abilities: Can create blackholes; Travel through time

name: Ashrac Team
description: Because of their unique position. This team of three witnessed the battle between magic and while they were supposed to have forgotten this. Their minds created a chemical compound that allowed them to remember plus giving each a different ability.

name: Silge Lassen
description: During time of the ancient wizards, there were several humans that witnessed the battle between magic. This caused the wizards to rid them from the world, however because of the humans witnessing magic in action, their minds and bodies compiled a chemical that gave them immunity thus making the wizards power was useless. Silge Lassen was one of those humans and was given the power to make anything turn into glass, she changed her name to Silver Iron and help create the team called Ashrac.

name: A.J Johnson
description: During time of the ancient wizards, there were several humans that witnessed the battle between magic. This caused the wizards to rid them from the world, however because of the humans witnessing magic in action, their minds and bodies compiled a chemical that gave them immunity thus making the wizards power was useless. A.J was one of thos humans was given the power to melt anything he touches. Because of his ability he was called Volcano Man and assisted in creating a team called Ashrac.

name: Jenna Aldenhine
description: During time of the ancient wizards, there were several humans that witnessed the battle between magic. This caused the wizards to rid them from the world, however because of the humans witnessing magic in action, their minds and bodies compiled a chemical that gave them immunity thus making the wizards power was useless. Jenna Aldenhine was one of those humans and was given the ability to fly. She called herself Glaze and along with the other members of the Ashrac Team, she was assisted in protecting the human race from dark magic and at times even the gods.

name: Molly Rifiru
description: Mother of Rizer, she is the stereotypical soccer mom at least called by her peers, after losing her daughter and husband to a fire caused when Rizer was very young, she became more in tempt to make sure her son is safe from harm. During a fight after the final day of school, Molly sent Rizer to camp in hopes he could find solid ground and learn from his new peers. She is also a lawyer.

name: Rizer Rifiru
description:
Creature: Clown Magician

The hero of the story, he is tough, strong willed, and will do anything to save the helpless. Once bullied, he showed his bully kindness when it was revealed that he was alone most of the time at home which caused his attitude at school. Rizer came to Aurelia by reading out loud a spell which transported him to the new world. There he found that he is the descendant of the Domi Mages and through him, he will save the world with the help of other descendants. His partner of choice is the Clown Magician which acts like him at times.

name: Zara Collins
description:
Creature: Aquadog > Gian

Smart and self loathing young girl that is head strong and often but heads with Rizer on things related to certain missions. She meets Rizer and is the first to befriend him on his journey throughout Aurelia. She has the ability to see events before they happen and her village has called on her to protect them from harm using those very gifts. She loves flowers and the smell of candy although she is often allergic to Earth candies but can enjoy Aurelian ones.

name: Taylon Urikuru
description:
Creature: Cyber Puppy > Cyber Hound > Cyber Cerebus

Friend of Rizer and Zara. He is tall, quiet, and quite shy at times. Although he strong and is used as the teams often muscle. He hates fighting and prefers to fix things as these calms him whenever distressed. He has shown on numerous occasions to become protective and even start a fight to protect others.

name: Jensen
description:
Creature: Serjes (until Serjes leads the team on missions)

A protector and guide to the Battle Guardians or protectors as he calls them at times. He is tall, usually investigates the distance in silence. His long white hair has said to be able to cure sickness and is often sought out by others. He is a skilled fighter and teaches the Battle Guardian their numerous fighting skills.

name: Dr. Emilia Aresta
description:
Creature: Suppatti > Ogguny

A skilled doctor that can heal almost any lifeform or at least knows how to through numerous studies she has gathered. She is responsible for providing various technological devices to the Battle Guardians including other Battlers across Aurelians. Her office is found at the entrance of almost every gate into Aurelia from other worlds by magic. With technology and magic, she has provided her likeness to androids that appear throughout Aurelia to help nurse and heal (through the use of machines) in a place known as the Aura Houses. Here all types of creatures and Aurelians come to get treated. Her partner of choice is Suppatti and sometimes Ogguny of which assists her in helping others. At times the androids can appear slightly different to match the respective environment such as in a place of rocky terrain, an android can appear to like rock climbing wearing boots while an underwater Aura House can have an android that wears mostly swimming like attire, etc.

name: Kendra Lucutti
description:
Creature: Pluruppa > Seeda > Rose Fairy

Kendra, since a young girl, showed a strong desire to help others. While her childhood is a mystery, she has since shown to have no memory of it (with her sister believe that she is blocking it out). She showed to be a Battle Guardian when her crest appeared on her neck. She showed strong magical abilities when protecting a flock of wild creatures in her garden from a wild attack.

name: Debren
description: Taylon’s father, he is brute and often cares little for the outside world, until chapter 2, he was thought to be dead and was considered a spirit until a story spoke about him being captured by Lord Behemoth and used his dreams to attack Taylon. He shortly returned home to his family and reunited by his long lost wife in the process.

name: Gia
description: Kendra’s older sister, she took care of Kendra after their parents died in a fire. She often appears as a techie for the Battle Guardians and leads them through several adventures that often rely on outside assistance. She is joined alongside Dr. Aresta and Jensen.

name: Black Knights
description: A band of thieves that uses their enhanced abilities to start a chain of unsolved robberies throughout Elite City.

name: Mitch Coner
description: Due to an experiment done to him when he was a child, Mitch Coner has received seven enhanced vision abilities along with enhanced vision to see things miles away at precision. Because of his abilities, he quickly started to use them for his own schemes and thievery. He created a band of robbers with unique talents and started becoming the most notorious group of thieves in Elite City.
abilities: X-ray Vision; Panoramic Vision; Infraed Vision; Night Vision; Ultraviolet Vision; Telescopic Vision; Aura Vision

name: Nick Browns
description: With all of his senses at extreme levels, Nick would often use his abilities to steal things that he considered to be challenging to steal. Nick met Mitch Coner while robbing the same bank, after a quick fight over the money, they agreed to work together and use each other for joint riches. Nick would go by Night watch and would be the group’s eyes and ears while entering into places. He is also considered the group’s best thieft because of his enhanced reflexes.

name: Luke Dale
description: During his initial years as a superhero under the team Elite Force where he tought martial arts and swordmanship to the new recruits, Luke notice how many people would overlook him thus causing him to leave the team. Frustrated with his recent team, he promised to never join another team and thus went solo on several missions including meeting and battling several other characters throughout Elite Comics Universe over the course of his lifetime. It wouldn’t be until almost 50 years later that he would be in another group, this time as a thieft believing that his true calling is to get what he deserves which would be the riches of others. He would then go by Coyote because his animal behavior and outfit.
abilities: Enhanced Durability; Strength; Agility; Cyber claws; Slowed down healing factor

name: Yedlia Cranken
description: During her youth, Yedlia has always been somewhat of a troublemaker, often leaving her aunt and uncle up all night wondering where she was located and if she was in trouble. During her birth, her parents disappeared, causing her to rebel in her teens. She came into her abilities once she hit puberty and has since worked with the Black Knights as their youngest member and after leaving the group, she became on/off their team member and later one of the many Descendants that can use ice as their ability.

name: Celestial Guardians
description: Chosen by the High Council to defend the Heavens and Earth if ever Santaniel and his dark forces return. Later their mission was to awaken and then protect the future ruler of Heaven in the absence of the Ultimate Power.

name: Araja Barnitchi
description:
Age: 19 (on Earth)

Chosen by the Ultimate Good to protect the highest level of Heaven. Araja Barnitchi is the leader and highest in command of the Celestial Guardians. Unlike her fellow team members, she was sent to Earth in a slumber and couldn’t be awaken until her entire team was united. In Heaven, Araja was a powerful angel and with her power ranging from light based to sun rays, Araja was considered one of the strongest angels in Heaven. Her mother was Eve, Queen of Heaven and she was next in line to become the new royal throne of Heaven ruling over all angels. However this was put on hold when she was sent to Earth during the great battle and placed in a deep slumber.
abilities: Power over Light; Healing; The Sun

name: Numera Cantain
description:
Age: 19 (on Earth)

Sent to Earth during the great demonic battle against angels in Heaven. Numera was the closest friend to Araja until she was sent to Earth to protect it from the approaching demonic army. Sadden by Araja leaving on her own, Numera left to follow her. However when she landed to Earth, most of her memory was erased by the descend and she lived as a normal human teenager until she was told of her past again. After which she became the Celestial Guardian of Shehaqim. Her personality is that of a dim witted but loyal friend. She is a joker and loves to swim and play water based sports. Her attacks are water based.

name: Rai Lyn Togachu
description:
Age: 18 (on Earth)

Strong minded and well organized, Rai Lyn was the well sought angel on war techniques against the dark forces while in Heaven. She was sent to Earth to watch over it but because of its growing influence she would forget about her past however retaining her recent passion for technology, strategies, organizations, and well sought out plans. Considered a book worm throughout her lifetime, she is called on once again to often guide and lead her fellow Celestial Guardians on various missions with several gadgets including a high tech pair of glasses and small pocket computer. Power of Middle Earth

name: Valerie Sikari
description: Strong and impatient, Valerie is hot headed and believes in a head on approach instead of rational reasoning. She is not very strategic and often fails at many tasks because of this. Although a great fighter, Valerie was sent to Earth to learn from humans and other fallen angels and she has since been forbidden to return to Heaven until she learns certain life skills. Although not a punishment, Valerie often considers this to be such and has a hard time believing in good at times. She became evil on several occasions because of often naivety. She slowly begins to learn why she was sent to Earth when joining the Celestial Guardians.

name: Synthia Hokura
description: Synthia is one of the few angels to remember who she was before the battle of angels and demons. She posseses the power over thunder and is a very athletic individual. She loves all sports and take very much passion for mortal sports including angelic sword fighting. She is the Celestial Guardians most skilled fighter often using weapons and physical techniques instead of her celestial powers in combat. She met the other Celestial Guardians while fighting a ward of demonic bounty hunters.

name: Mindy Solozar
description: One of the highest angels in the hierarchy of Heaven. Mindy Solozar was chosen to go to Earth to help find and unite the Celestial Guardians. She is one of the few who remembers her past as an arch angel fighting as a Celestial Guardian. Her closest friend is Vesat and from their partnership she fought by herself for nearly 100 years until she met the other Celestial Guardians. Her personality is said to be cold and unbroken and because of her true angelic status, she is unable to feel many emotions however she does grow a close bond with the other Celestial Guardians.

name: Olivia Spaulding
description: Able to regenerate from any womb, Olivia was a normal human with a unique genetic makeup until she was caught off guard by a dying angel who gave her the Celestial Stone of Shamayim believing that Olivia could continue her destined mission to defeat a raid of demons that were terrorizing the Earth. She became one of the seven Celestial Guardians.
abilities: Regeneration; Enhanced Strength; Speed; Lazer Beams

name: Lessa Jomille
description:
Age: 21 (on Earth)

A party magician, Lessa was once a powerful spell casting angel who worked for the armory in Heaven. She helped build magical weapons and even assisted in building the Key of Humanity for the side of good in the battle of angels and demons. When she was sent to Earth to retrieve it, she lost her memory and was thus given a human life. She lived out her life as a party magician that could perform partial real magic until she was given the Celestial Stone of Raquie and she became its guardian shortly after saying its name.

name: Sarah Ukata
description:
Age: 21 (on Earth)

A priestess to spirits who have died to suddenly. Sarah’s job in heaven was to ensure the easiest transition possible for young spirits while entering the afterlife. When the great battle of angels and demons was happening at the gates of Heaven. Sarah made the choice to attend the battle to make sure that the spirits would pass through safely. However at the edge of the battle ending, Sarah was casted to Earth. Here she lost her memory and was given a human persona. In her mortal life she continued to help others in need in the way of being a young priestess who could speak to spirits, read minds, and help the living speak to their deceased loved ones. This particular gift proved to be unstable and often a hoax amongst nonbelievers although all of her predictions were 100% accurate. She became the Celestial Guardian of Machon after she was visited by a lost spirit she helped while in Heaven.

name: Nioki Kentita
description: Nioki Kentita along with Senta Miochi were always close friends. Since they were young individuals, they possessed unique powers. Their individual tribes prayed to their gods to allow these two girls to be worshipped as deities and to be placed in the stars where their great power can be recognized. One day Nioki was sent through time by the way of magic and was given the Celestial Stone which allowed her to become the Celestial Guardian of Time. She would then receive special instructions from a voice which would tell her to defend existence at all cause from dark forces. She united with Senta and their friendship grew and they became the Protectors of Time and Space.
affiliates: Protectors of Time; Space; Celestial Guardians

name: Senta Miochi
description: Senta Miochi along with Nioki Kentita were always close friends. Since they were young individuals, they possessed unique powers. Their individual tribes prayed to their gods to allow these two girls to be worshipped as deities and to be placed in the stars where their great power can be recognized. One day Senta was sent into space and was given the Celestial Stone which allowed her to become the Celestial Guardian of Matter. She would then receive special instructions from a voice which would tell her to defend existence at all cause from dark forces. She united with Nioki and their friendship grew and they became the Protectors of Time and Space.
affiliates: Protectors of Time; Space; Celestial Guardians

name: Nicole Hutauc
description: A strong opponent and grateful ally, Nicole guards all Space, she is a descendant of the being called Space and she has been known to actually have somewhat of a resemblance to it. Since she was young she showed great talent such as moving objects with her mind, creating electronic fields around herself which could protect herself while repelling others. Not much is known of her upbringing as since she was 18 she only remembers living on a rock in space protecting all things from dark forces. She has since been to over 3,000 planets all containing life forms. She met Senta Miochi and Nioki Kentita while fighting a mutual enemy and the three became the Protectors of Time and Space.
affiliates: Protectors of Time; Space; Celestial Guardians
abilities: Telekinesis; Teleportation; Force Fields; Force Beams

name: Taki Mimauchi
description:
Age: Old as all life

Along with Aki and Auka Akuchiki, Taki is one of the three Protectors of Life and Death. She guards the gates of Eternity which leads to both Heaven, Hell, the Astral Plane, and the Underworld. She has the unique ability to appear nearly in all places at once and she is immortal. She can see all things at once and can detect particular motions from different directions at once. She is a strong willed fighter and by most is considered a very destructive opponent. As guardian of all things, she doesn’t value good nor evil and stands completely neutral. Although she can transform into a Celestial Guardian, she has no need for fighting as she wouldn’t fight on either side. She does however contain various attacks that could destroy a planet at will. She is forbidden to leave her post and will fight however if it is threaten as seen in the Life & Death webisode. (see Celestial Guardians Webisodes)
affiliates: Protectors of Life; Death; Celestial Guardians
abilities: Immortality; Soul Swapping; Power over Souls; Spirits; Aura Reading

name: Aki Akuchiki
description:
Age: Old as all life

Along with his sister Auka, Aki stands at the edge of all existence watching and protecting it from demonic forces. He is very skilled at fighting and takes a more direct approach at solving things then his sister. Like his sister he will do anything to ensure the safety of all things in life rather good or evil. He is at times neutral as seen when allowing dark forces to overpower the Celestial Guardians as his post represents balance of life and death. It is said that all beings of the dead (gods, grim reapers, spirits, and Death itself) are replicas of himself and they will all be consumed by him at the end of time. His father is Death (see Death in Galactic Beings) of which he has a strong resemblance toward.
affiliates: Protectors of Life; Death; Celestial Guardians

name: Auka Akuchiki
description:
Age: Old as all life

Standing at the edge of existence along with her brother Aki. Auka is a beautiful spirit who was chosen to watch over all life. She was giving the power to bring forces back from the dead and to heal beings and objects at will. Although very light hearted and loving, Auka has been known to also be a great warrior and often war minded when fighting dark forces. She takes her job very seriously and only leaves her post from the edge of existence when various places is in need of protecting such as Earth when it was nearly destroyed. She has only met the Celestial Guardians on four occasions of which she proved to be a lot stronger than they were.
affiliates: Protectors of Life; Death; Celestial Guardians

name: Jesia
description: Jesia is a proud member of the royal court of angels. Since her creation, Jesia has been in many forms serving at the feet of the Ultimate Good. She sung beautiful songs and could translate many variations of languages. Although older than any form of animal, Jesia took the form of a panther while visiting Earth. Because she was considered very precious, the Ultimate Good banished her to Earth during the raid of demons in Heaven. Here she took the permanent form of a panther and couldn’t transform back until all the Celestial Guardians were all in one place.

name: Vesat
description: Similar to the status of his companion Jesia. Vesat was of very precious importance to the Ultimate Good and was banished to Earth for his own protection. While on Earth he took various forms and was a guide to many great warriors throughout history including leader in many battles against dark forces. He is the ancestors to the feline species in the animal race and is said to have been present during the early days of the Garden of Eden before it became populated by Adam and Eve. Vesat met Jesia during the summoning of the Celestial Guardians. The two would grow close and it would be revealed later on that the two have a child in the future.

name: Febian
description: Born to Vesat and Jesia, Febian is a proud soldier and has assisted in battles against demons alongside his mother and father in the future. He is from the year 3,001 and although he is a teenager he is over 100 years old. His combat skills are used more than his celestial abilities. Because of his birthright, he contains the powers of both his parents however much weaker than theirs in comparison because of his lack of practice. He guides the future Celestial Guardians after the current Celestial Guardians fulfill their duties on Earth and ascend to Heaven. He came back to the past to warn his parents and the guardians of the arrival of Belckus. His very arrival also brought many powerful demons into the current time. Unknowingly this knowledge would spread to current demons and assist in the arrival of Belckus.

name: Siolus
description:
Abilities: Magical rings of light that can do various tasks including transporting the user

Siolus was one of the angels who went to Earth to protect it from demonic forces however his mission would be different in terms of his overall fight. He was chosen to guard the 67 seals of Belckus which served as locked gates to Belckus’ tomb. To ensure the lock of these seals at all times, Siolus created 66 spiritual guides in forms of owls to watch over and defend the seals while he watched over the most important seal, the one that guarded Belckus. Siolus allowed the owls to take various forms whenever they needed however they couldn’t leave their post.
affiliates: Celestial Guardians and Cosmic Soldiers; Celestial Guardians
abilities: Power over the Cosmos; Power to unlock/lock dimensions

name: Eve
description:
Age: Old as Life on Earth
Note: Queen of Heaven

Second wife to Adam, Eve is the sister to Lilith and mother to Araja. She was once the most powerful angel in Heaven, her father was the Ultimate Good and was considered one of the first angels to ever be sent to Earth. She was sent to Earth mortal to serve as consort to Adam. However her early temptation by Belckus (Lucifer) to bite a forbidden fruit caused her to be further pollute her descendants the human race. She bore two children and watch the negative influence from her own past come back and take over her eldest child as he killed his younger brother. Stricken by grief, Eve pleaded to the Ultimate Good for a chance to make amends for her past wrongful judgement. Given her chance, she rose from death of old age to become an angel of which she was the most successful and powerful of those that existed. She was given title the Queen of Heaven because of her strength and royal like appearance and power. She would give birth to her daughter Araja and along with her love Adam (now in Heaven as a fellow angel) and her two sons (Cain and Abel, also now as angels) she was given her second chance. She would die during the battle of demons and angels at the gate of Heaven. Here she used her power to banish the demons to hell, however few manage to fall to Earth and to make sure that the Garden of Eden remains intact, she appointed several powerful angels as the first Celestial Guardians to protect it. She would then disappear to only appear in the future as a guiding voice to angels.
abilities: Creation; Power over light; Healing; Immortality; Omnipresence

name: Domade Aska
description:
Abilities: Giant double swords which can kill demons instantly

Future husband to Araja and father of two daughters from the future who came back to warn him of oncoming threats to their lives. He has an overly protective nature with some saying it’s to protective including Araja. He left his post to explore the world around him and met Araja while the two was in Egypt at a marketplace shopping for ambrosia.

name: Lio’n Kingrue
description: Protector of the Garden of Eden, he is the youngest of its protectors and is the most skilled warrior on Earth until the arrival of the Celestial Guardians. He has since stated that he only wish to fight if it is to protect the garden and wish not to concern himself with anything else outside of it.

name: Harold Aumi
description:
Age: Old as humanity

Considered father of earth born soldiers, this old angel has been living amongst humans since their creation by the gods nearly millions of years ago. He is presented by two young followers who helps in protecting the Earth and the mystical Garden of Eden. He is their leader and are known as the Guardians of Earth. He lives at the edge of the Garden of Eden seen smoking a pipe laced with pure fresh air only found in Heaven which while on Earth can make anything and anyone including angels high. He is a comedic figure and only fights when he is too high to understand what is happening.

name: Valena
description:
Daughter to Araja, she is a playful and colorful spirited person who loves to play pranks on her younger sister and play sports with her father. She is the eldest daughter and came to the past to prevent the deaths of her parents due to an all-out attack of demons. Her Celestial Guardian form hasn’t been seen yet but it is suggested that she can transform with many considering her look to appear close to her mothers’.

Valena is the future daughter to The Princess and Prince of the Universe. She travelled back in time to help protect her parents from a demonic soldier of HELL. Her powers mostly consist of pure energy and light based and are mostly used to enhance her parent’s abilities. Her sister also travelled later to protect her continuing the chain. Valena is named after her mother and grandmother.
abilities: Power over Enhancing other abilities; Weakening of Abilities

name: Valia
description:
Age: 6 (in the future)

Valia is the future daughter to the princess and prince of the universe. She travelled back into time to help protect her sister whom in return travelled into the past to protect their parents. Upon her arrival many thought her to be the rebirth of the original Queen of the Universe because of facial similarities. In the far future when she is an adult (as seen in a vision and artwork from a parallel time) she is very beautiful and bare striking similarities to the original Queen. It is believed in the future, Valia marries Onorosh, God of Sleep and the two give birth to the reborn gods of dreams. Together they ruled over Dreomede.

Youngest daughter to Araja, she is princess of Heaven and is also wiser and less playful than her older sister. She went back in time to assist her older sister in fighting off demons with her parents and to protect them from a force that her sister didn’t know about before traveling backwards in time. She presented her powerful Celestial Stone and became the Guardian of Dreams. In the future it is said she would fall for a dream god and the two would live in the dream world watching over innocent dreams.

name: Sheila Zikouyawi
description: The embodiment of all emotions, she is the oldest of her siblings and with them bare the curse to be reborn each generation never living pass 20 years of age. Her parents is unknown and the reason behind her being goes into question by many that has met this colorful individual. Some believe that she along with her siblings was created to serve as the birthplace for all things of humanity.

name: Vega Zikouyawi
description: Sharing similar fates to this sisters, Vega is set to be reborn each generation. He is the embodiment to human Physical Attributes and has assisted in hand to hand combat against many demonic forces including demons with the help of his sisters including the Celestial Guardians of whom he met while playing in a field near Araja’s home.

name: Alinda Zikouyawi
description:
Sharing fate with her siblings, Alinda is the embodiment of human mentality. She has a psychic connection with all living beings thus being the strongest of all of her siblings by comparison. She can cause sickness, physical weakness, emotional disturbance, and other ill-fated things when she is angered so her siblings often try to keep her happy to prevent any bad things from happening hence their always playful natures.

Alinda is creator of the centaurs of the universe or in scientific terms creator of dwarf planets and stars in Elite Force Comics universe. She is sibling to Vega & Sheila and is the youngest of the group and wisest. From her amulet she can omit great power, strong enough to wipe out worlds of life.

name: Io’de’lagana
description: Io’de’lagana was previously a member of the guardians of the 66 seals until he left his post tempted by a demon to travel the outside world. He turned to dust following leaving his post and a restored image was placed back in his place named Io. The demon was then vanquished by the newly formed Io (see Guardians of the 66 Seals).
affiliates: Guardians of the 66 Seals; Celestial Guardians

name: Callisto’de’ampha
description: Callisto was a beautiful maiden that served under the Siolus before being turned into a guardian of the 66 seals. She loved him so much that she vowed to never leave his side. However once leaving heaven, she broke that promise and fell for a cunning demon posing as a human king. The two fell in love and had three children. The three children became the first beast of Hell. For punishment she was turned to dust by Siolus and was replaced by an image named simply Callisto. (see Guardians of the 66 Seals).
affiliates: Guardians of the 66 Seals; Celestial Guardians

name: Guardians of the 66 Seals
affiliates: Guardians of the 66 Seals; Celestial Guardians

name: Light
description: From the first spark of light in Helliholm (Heaven), came Light. The second known being in creation after his twin brother Dark. From his conception came the first star, first ray of sunshine, and the first known pallat of light onto the young universe. It is believed that his home is at the edge of The Ultimate Power’s never ending light, of which most fans believe to exist at the edge of eternity. Unlike his brethren he will be the first do die as prophesized by The Wiseman.

name: Dark
description: Dark is the twin brother to Light. The first child of the Ultimate Power, Dark was born moments before Light shined upon Helliholm and was also the father to Belckus (when Belckus was an angel). Dark watched and trained the Ho’zares during their youth and from him came their great fighting skills. It is believed that Dark tought demons and angels alike how to defend themselves and forged their armors and weaponry from The Ultimate Power’s very throne.

name: Emotion
description:
Called Despair, Delirium, Desire, and every known emotion in history, Emotion is not just a spirit that inspired emotion in all known beings including bad emotions such as fear, rage, anger, etc. Emotion created such feelings in Domaedians, Ho’zares, and other higher beings however her brethren and family shared no similar feeling since they are emotionless creations of the Ultimate Power. It is said that she can feel every known emotion there is and is considered the Mother of Empaths.

These are the 65 guardians of the 66 seals, they appear similar to each other with only their unique personalities and abilities serving as differentiators. Created and chosen by the high seraph Siolus to protect the gates of Hell and to stop anything that tries to break the 66 seals to access Belckus’ chambers. Like most guards of eternal gates, they are forbidden to never leave their post. Those that due will turn to dust and replaced by a similar looking individual.

name: Sedma
description: Sedma is the second bounty hunter sent out to kill all remaining angels on Earth and steal the Celestial Stones so that she and her fellow demons can get access to the Garden of Eden which would allow them to gain complete access over Earth.
abilities: Power to influence others; Can create monsters; Can influence war

name: Vestowa
description: Brother to Sedma, he is her twin and often snarky remarks gets him on her bad side. He was the first Demonic bounty hunter to attack the Celestial Guardians. He was partially the understanding reason why the guardians now know of the Dark Force and their plans for the Celestial Stones of which he would meet his fate because of this released knowledge.
abilities: Power to influence others; Can create monsters; Can cause diseases

name: Hygieia
description: An old general of Belckus’ army, he is wise and appears partially cloaked and dark figured. He is usually seen calm and rarely engages in war, he is protected by thousands of a dark spirits at a time. He is considered the horseman of Famine.
abilities: Power to influence others; Can create monsters; Can cause famine

name: Enceladus
description:
Abilities: Can cause a release of negative emotions

Old enemy of Jessana, Enceladus is considered a young demon with a overly cocky and jokster type attitude. Although he is young, his plans of world domination usually succeeds in that he has mastered his full demonic power, being the only horsemen to completely transform and successfully defeat the Celestial Guardians. Although they would be revived by their stones to only destroy him in the end. He is the last to be defeated.
abilities: Can influence others; Can create monsters

name: Oberon
description: Oberon is a skilled dark practitioner of black arts, he has summoned thousands of demons to destroy numerous worlds. Sent to Earth by Montum on Belckus’ orders.

name: Miranda
description:
The oldest living monarch in the magical world and the first queen of magic. Believing she died thousands of years ago. Queen Miranda was one of the most beloved and powerful monarchs in the history of magic. Her appearance at the High Council during a time when the second Dark War was happening proved that she has power beyond that of her successors. Her appearance is grand standing at 7 feet tall, long white hair, fair black skin, a long dress, and two large staffs that can transform into numerous weapons.

Servant to Oberon, she is a powerful witch who uses black magic to fight her opponents. Not as skilled at hand to hand combat she doesn’t need it because of her great pull on black magic that is believed to be from hell. She comes to Earth following Oberon after the defeat of the Dark Force.
affiliates: Old Ones; Celestial Guardians; The Ancient Circle
abilities: Power of transmutation; Creator of longevity type spells; Black Magic

name: Queen Titania
description: Daughter to Lilith, she fell to Earth during the angel vs. demon battle however unlike others during the fall. She didn’t lose her memory only a great use of her previous abilities. Carrying her mother’s ambition to overthrow Eve and any of her descendants including her daughter Araja. Titania has took nearly millions of years’ time to adapt to Earth’s neutral plane of existence to the point where she could use the full force of her powers to defeat her family’s enemy. She would eventually fall during the battle with the awaken Araja.

name: Cosmic Force
description: Arranged by a higher entity, Comic Force are very powerful beings that resemble their siblings Star Watchers. They are six of the most powerful of their kind and helped shaped the physical universe.

name: Titum Radol
description:
Age: 2 billion years old

Born by the power of the World Destroyer, Titum Radol was sent to a far galaxy to assist in finding worlds that aren’t worthy of keeping their lives. He would use the stars around him to detect unworthy places based off of their respective growth, knowledge, strength, and the personality of the occupants. His power included the creation of stars and controlling them at will. He could use them as portals to get to other places. He carries the Omnious Pojarum, a staff with floating stars around it that when touched by anyone else it could destroy them on contact.

name: O’bdard
description:
Age: 2 billion years old

Born outside of reality, similar to his siblings. O’bdard is one of the members of Cosmic Force that can use unlimited power from the Galactic Void. He was one of siblings that were given the abilities to control all substances of magic, matter, energy, reality, and time, thus securing his place amongst the Universe most powerful entities. His powers later grew so strong that even his creator couldn’t contain him any longer, so now the new Kosminen took control of his own life and left for the farthest reaches of the universe, thus leaving the cosmic cult, the Cosmic Force. It is said that Kosminen went back in time to assist with the construction of magic and even releasing the first wave of energy through the young universe, events that were rewritten by himself and fellow followers.
abilities: Total control over magic; Matter; Energy; Reality; Time

name: Avard
description:
Age: 2 billion years old

Avard was one of the fateful servants to the World Destroyer. He was sent on vast missions throughout the universe to collect life orbs from dying planets so that the planet could be destroyed by his creator. However now known as the Blackhole Watcher would use partial amounts of the items known as Life Orbs to create blackholes which in return would give him power to open portals to other dimensions throughout space and time. He is responsible for the first blackhole in the universe. It is said that he created a blackhole that sent him to a similar time and space called the Marvel Universe. (reference of his arrival throughout several issues of both Marvel and DC exists to create the three comic book crossover distribution)
abilities: Virtually Unlimited Ability to manipulate; Create; Or destroy all Matter; Energy at will. Omnipresence

name: Shei’la
description:
Age: 2 billion years old

Seen tall and mostly composed of stars and floating orbs of powerful light energy, this powerful entity was the first to be created by the World Destroyer and for a time served The World Creator until she returned to her siblings of the Cosmic Force. Her return and original departure are uknown at this time since it existed in a pocket world contained of pure mystery.

name: U’vidan
description:
Age: 2 billion years old

During the moments of the first wave of cosmic energy, U’vidan was born with the assistance of The World Destroyer. He was a being of pure cosmic energy, his body destroyed during birth because of the rays omitting from his insides. His new body is made of an unknown alloy that exists in a pocket dimension hidden from others including his creator. He assists The World Destroyer on his conquest to another plane stealing the life from planets and stars of unworthy.
abilities: Unlimited cosmic powers; Like his siblings is omniscient; Nigh-omnipotent; Omnipresent

name: Billian
description:
Age: 2 billion years old

Billian is also called the Silver Blade because of a sword he forged from the power of the first star. He joined The World Destroyer in hopes to destroy other dying stars and planets to gather their energy to make he much stronger. Unlike the other members of the Cosmic Force, he was not born of World Destroyer however to the Ensimmäinen Kuolemattomia “First Immortals”. He uses his giant sword which stretches as far as the milky way and can be used to destroy galaxies, his powers are infinite and from his body he can create other objects made of cosmic energy through mental focusing.
abilities: Cosmic Manipulation; Object creation through Cosmic Energy

name: Cosmic Soldiers
description: One of the teams chosen by the great High Council to protect the properties of the heavens. The Cosmic Soldiers were chosen at birth to unite and protect the solar system from ongoing threats to Earth and its inhabitants.

name: Au Boniku
description:
Age: 28 (at the time of her appearance)

Representing the Cosmos in general, Au is the appointed soldier that was given power over the cosmos and everything in it. She came to Earth to protect it from a giant creature that plagued mankind in its early times. Although she left after destroying the creature, her legend lives on in all future heroes as she along with two others fought this being saved the world for a hundred more years.

name: Draka Pinoune
description:
Age: 26 (at the time of her appearance)

Being able to control the Air, Earth, Water, and Fire, Draka was one of the remaining Martians however when her home world became uninhabitable. Draka left with her people. She found the Cosmic Stone while on a nearby world and return to this solar system in hopes to revive her planet. She partially succeeded and allowed her people a few more hundred years on the now red planet. She became the Cosmic Soldier of Planets and had a post on each planet in our solar system. It is said that she is still out there bringing peace to the planets in this solar system.

name: Dandulus Vilu
alias: Cosmic Soldier of the Sun & Moon
description:
Age: 987 years old (at the time of his first appearance)

He was born on the moon and has taken the name the man on the moon. He was visited by humans once when traveling to the moon. Because of his home being covered in shadows on the moon, everyone would forget about his presence thus considering him a fairytale. His suit of armor contains the power of the Cosmic Stone and would assist in protecting the galaxy from intruding forces of darkness.
abilities: Power of moonlight; Healing; Immortality; Enhancing of other abilities

name: Circus Family
description: A group of kind yet often rambunctious group of young adults with the abilities of animals.

name: Dexter Randers
description: Usually dispelled because of his appearance, Dexter has always been considered the most disliked person. During high school, Dexter’s body begun a transformation mostly because a severe mutation which caused him to become Frogman. During his later years, Dexter also became part of the Circus Family.

name: Jessica Yantis
