description: Wife to Dexter in his adult years while apart of the Circus Family, Jessica Blanks was considered the most beautiful person at her school until her mutation caused her to be dispelled. She hid herself from her friends and family members and left without a trace, joining the Circus Family in the process.

name: Brinda Maydover
alias: Animal Whisperer (rarely known by this title)
description: While playing in the fields behind her house, Brinda discovered her unique abilities to talk to animals after almost being killed by a wild lion. Although keeping it a secret from everyone, Brinda uses her abilities to put on shows and help others with the help of animals. In one story during Chapter 30, Brinda is a part of the Circus Family.

name: Kira Banks
description: Kira Banks was one of the prominent members of The Circus Family and for a while one of its leaders. Born in 2034, Kira took her title as Beast Woman after the legendary Beast Girl before her and knew she shared similarities. The main difference is that Kira could communicate to animals in addition to sonic hearing, smell, strength, & vision.
abilities: Beast like appearance; Enhanced hearing; Strength; Agility; Smell; Vision; Talk to animals

name: Cosh-kitar
description: Once a powerful royal family that ruled over Northern Elitshia. The Cosh-kitar was known for enchanting their belongings and cursing their realms to repel those that wish them harm or to steal from them. The royal family knew of the fall of their kingdom, so they cast a spell upon their kingdom, sending them and their loyal subjects into the future as citizens of future earth. In the modern day society, the Cosh-kitar resides in Sacramento, CA as a wealthy family who owns a clothing label.

name: Kitall-kitar
description:
Age: Varies

Kitall is the king that thought of nothing else but his wealth. Often overlooking his family and even placing them in danger for the price of money and fame. He was partially responsible for his kingdom’s fall. He often can be seen surrounded by his jackals which are made of pure gold and has the souls of actual dogs.

name: Venj-kitar
description:
Age: Varies

Wife of Kitall, she had an affair that Kitall never knew of. Her affair resulted in two children which she imprisoned in another dimension. Her daughter that she sealed away in the dimension got pregnant by her eldest son Perule and to hid the fact that they were related. She killed the infant and locked the girl away within a dimension of which she is now separated from her brother and anyone else.

name: Perule-kitar
description:
Age: Varies

Unknowngst to him, he got his sister pregnant although he didn’t know she was his sister because of his mother Venj hid her away out of secrecy of an affair. To keep his name clean and to protect the image of his wealthy status. He hid the child away but believed the mother’s child ran away with the child, although in reality his mother killed the child once she found out about this.

name: Maura-kitar
description:
Age: Varies

Rebellious, Maura had sex with over 105 different boys from her upstate private school including three of her teachers. She is known around campus but her sex life remains a secret off campus because of a spell she placed on each of the men to not be able to speak of it off grounds.

name: Kiola
description:
Age: Varies

Secret daughter to Venj and a human man she met while shopping for clothes. Kiola was banished to another dimension by her mother because of the fact she was born out of wedlock. She managed to come back to Earth only to get banished again after meeting and getting pregnant unknowing by her unknown half brother.

name: Morius
description:
Age: Varies

Morius was born unable to speak and because of his mother, Venj’s families’ ability to only cast spells by sounding them out. He cannot use his magic. However, he uses this to create a world within his dreams and mind where he is able to speak. With his sister, Kiola he was banished to another dimension by Venj to hide the fact that he was born out of wedlock.

name: Cursed
description: Various coves rose to find the legendary Cursed objects created and hidden by the first witch, Eve after it was revealed that the first piece was discovered. This proved that the objects were real and over seven different covens sent out their best warriors to find the objects to strengthen the power of the respective coven.

name: Soran Rowd
description: Soran was sent by his coven to achieve what his father did before him. Master the arts of physical magic and bestow himself with the strength of a god. When his father died in battle against a rivaling coven, Soran sworn that he would prove himself worthy of his father’s title.
abilities: Specializes in physical magic; Battle magic

name: Candance Gold
description: Part of an African tribe, Candance was a proud member of her coven until one day she lost a battle with a neighboring coven. To prove herself she practice to opposite forms of elemental magic and used it to challenge her opponent again. When it proved lethal, she was banished to the outer regions of her village. She vowed to restore her name by finding the lost Cursed objects of Eve.

name: Gary Rigth
description: A skilled warlock in technology magic. He was sent to an elite school in Northern Tier to advance his knowledge in the rare magic and to prove that he was capable of one day leading his coven although he despises leading anything. He was later sent on the mission to recovering the Cursed objects.

name: Orla Witchstock
description: Born from a tribe of proud and very wealthy witches. She was given her light based abilities by a fairy after it was thought she couldn’t use it on her own. Her real power to bend light was showcased years later.

name: Bow Tethering
description: Skilled fighter and often butting heads with Soran because of their frequent use of battle magic. Bow is a Native American warlock that spent most of his youth learning the most difficult forms of nature magic for one day to compete in the Witch Trials.
abilities: Specializes in acrobatic magic; Battle magic; Nature magic

name: Razen Wilks
description: The quiet one amongst the main group of witches that are fighting to find the Cursed objects. Razen was once dead and was revived by his now deceased lover. To revenge his late husband, Razen studied necromancing and is able to control Spirit magic although no one alive is able to use it.

name: Jaxx Redds
description: One of the main participants that makes it to the end of the Witch Trials. He was given the medal of Trust after saving Soran and Candance during the final trial. He was seen shortly throughout the trials using black magic, a forbidden magic within the trials, but was forgiven because of his athletic abilities and saving the two witches.

name: Heights Vouce
description: During the 4th trial of the Witch Trials, Heights admitted to the other witches that most of what they see are illusions and that he masters it. He falls for Orla because of their similar backgrounds and uses Tarot cards to speak to one another when far away. He was the first to be defeated as part of the 5th trial.

name: Seb Watson
description: From a far away coven that performs many ice magic festivals to locals. He was granted an award for winning the 2nd trial but was the first defeated in the 3rd trial. His clothing and home are made of ice and like Heights and Orla he practices similar light magic techniques.

name: Gabriel Cons
description: Gabriel and his twin sister Gabrielle Cons were selected from their coven because of their dual use of magic they call Twin Magic. Gabriel specializes specifically in energy magic and uses it to use the energy from others and things around him to cast spells. He hair has turned green in process and he often critiques others for their “boring and traditional” use of magic.

name: Gabrielle Cons
description: Gabrielle and her brother Gabriel are twin witches whom practices the use of Twin Magic which allows them to share their magic to become stronger. While her brother uses energy around him to cast spells, she sticks to traditional means of magic for witches which is through nature. Her specific use of Healing Magic has been noticed by shamans across the realms.

name: Gloria Peachfield
description: Opposed because of her traditional upbringing of voodoo. Gloria became known across her village and neighboring ones because of her mix use of voodoo and witchcraft in spells and potion making. She carries a voodoo doll with her and can pull energy from someone to be placed into the doll. Although her habits appears ill tempered, she is quiet peaceful and uses her calm demeanor to effectively fight her enemies throughout the trials.

name: Beauta Olds
description: Beauta is a fast talking and loud witch that uses her voice as ways to control others. She has looked over and performed numerous judging abilities over the last century.

name: Trial Guardians
description:
Age: Varies

Animal morphed creatures that wears different pendants around their bodies. They have small black wings and sometimes white to showcase their abilities and age. They look small but boast incredible strength and enhanced black magic.
abilities: Super human strength; Foresight; Enhanced speed; Magical abilities

name: Goran Ralph
description: Goran is a proud member of the High Council, that appeared throughout the Witch Trials as an enforcer of the trials’ rules and traditions. He is seen as a stalky man with long spikey black hair, black marble skin, a roaring loud voice, and a long golden beard.

name: Dark Prisoners
description: Because of Zon’s constant struggle with his once revered nature, it was caused for a new group of Dark Prisoners to be created to eliminate him and finish his mission of raising Santaniel’s army on Earth.

name: La’vara O Dela
description:
Abilities: Reflexes. Energy manipulation. Immortality. Carries an Omega Rod

La’vara also known as Ketcha is extremely long lived, at the end of Chapter 100; Ketcha is one of the few Descendants to remain and one of the first to enter Chapter 101 alive. With her immortality, she can personally survive almost anything and anywhere.

name: Demetrius Winds
description: Demetrius Winds comes from a timeline where his home was destroyed by an evil alien. From that timeline he met Ketcha and the two formed the Dark Prisoners in order to recreate the world in their images and rule it from that point.
abilities: Super strength; Flight; Invulnerability; Energy blasts; Mecha-empathy

name: Demi Woods
description:
Abilities: Precognitive ability to see into the future; Intelligence. Excellent hand-to-hand combatant skilled in martial arts

In an alternate reality where Elite Force are evil, Demi Woods was the profound leader before Kinestra took power over the team. Demi also called the Black Oracle became somewhat of a popular character in Chapter 81 where she visited the future (with the help of Shecknurd) to battle the demon Nokosha. She returned to the past to only join the Dark Prisoners after learning knowledge of Elite Force in another timeline and of their powers.
abilities: Possessing chemically augmented strength; Speed; Stamina; Agility; Swordsmanship

name: Degenerates
description: Currently only consisting of Kano, The Degenerates are outcasts that are often considered different by everyone and anything that they come around because of their unique abilities, appearance, or way of act.

name: Koy Richenburg
description:
Abilities: Durability Regenerative healing factor Immortality Genius level intellect

Outcasts by everyone he knew at an early age, Koy has always been somewhat of a trouble maker. He uses his abilities to find food and get the things he wants however always with a price of robbing places and eventually stealing from the Under City. He created the team Degenerates as a way to take over bigger places like banks.
abilities: Abnormal sense of smell; Strength; Stamina

name: Demonic Army of the Golden Rule
description: Only consisting of O’bur, the Demonic Army of the Golden Rule poses a threat to Zane as he tries to leave his dark past behind and move onto becoming a hero.

name: O’ bur Alvia
description: Once consort to Zane and mother of Janice, O’bur Alvia unlike other demons, roam freely throughout the human world because of her passion to get to know more about them. Thus taking on human form, she met Zane shortly after his years of assisting mankind and the two briefly fought sometime in the 15th century before actually making love to the ex-demon. She had his child of which later he killed her believing that she would eventually turn on him. O’bur Alvia would later be revived this time without memory of Zane, serving as soldier of the Demonic Army of the Golden Rule.
affiliates: Demonic Army of the Golden Rule; Demon

name: Destructables
description: A duo made up of two very strong men. They came together because of their shared strength to do what they want when they want and leave their lives behind. While in their teens they can be seen as villains while the older they got they became vigilantes making their own righteous laws.

name: Sir Rogers
description: Called Sir the Great by his students, Sir Rogers is one of the strongest men on the planet and alongside Strong Man is one of the only Descendants that can take a full blast to the chest by a comic as seen in Chapter 20. Sir Rogers became a teacher at SAA after he decided to leave the Destructables in his teens.

name: Brandon Craig
description: Since puberty, Brandon Craig always knew he would never be able to be seen by anyone again due to a strange mutation on his skin that caused him to vanish completely from sight. After years of fighting this, Brandon eventually accepted this mutation as a gift and would soon go by the name Invisible Stalker and would soon live up to his name. Robbing banks, traveling the world, getting into any place he wanted and never getting caught. After his trip to Germany to steal a precious jewel, Brandon experience another mutation which resulted in his body changing into a giant rock bodied like creature while steal remaining invisible. After this last mutation, Brandon joined the Indestructables to try and find a cure.

name: Devious Clowns
description: Originally a traveling circus troupe, a chemical spill during one of their tours while in Elitshia caused the group and nearby citizens to develop abilities. However, in the case of the Devious Clowns, many of them developed personality disorders which caused them to take on the personas that they displayed during their circus act.

name: Jacob Tutorini
description: Leader of the Devious Clowns and their ringleader. Using his electric charge rings, The Ringleader is one of the most insane villains which his atrocious sense of humor causes him to lose focus at times and rampage with insane topics and gross ideals of killing people. He is one Elitshia’s deadliest and most dangerous villains because of his lack of morality.

name: Laura Canning
description: The Ringleader’s righthand woman, equally as dangerous, insane, and deadly as her boss. Damsel is tough, skilled at Kung Fu and capable of learning almost any language because of her previous job as a linguist and professor.
abilities: Kung fu; Linguist; Carries a large machete

name: Veron Hops
description:
Abilities: Escape rooms with his book of Riddles

Capable of trapping people inside of mazes, labyrinths, and Escape style Rooms. Riddle Rattle speaks in riddles to the point where in order to figure out his master plan and escape one of his traps. The victim must solve his riddles or run the risk of being imprisoned, tortured, or killed. He was a master riddler before his villain persona.
abilities: Riddles can cause dizzy spells; Can create mazes

name: Derrick Writes
description: Capable of creating temperatures as low as -1000 degrees. His powerful abilities have caused him to become the world’s most prolific villains. He often glides across an ice bridge to move across great distances.

name: Alicia Writes
description:
Abilities: Lower the temperature by almost a thousand degrees

Daughter to Ice Bane, Icestorm is a powerful villain in her own right. After her father was imprisoned, she took up his cause and attempted to freeze the world. She is often anti-environmental and uses her enhanced ice abilities to reconfigure the Earth’s natural climates.

name: Granger Winson
description: A powerful psychic that once battled the famous Kendo Lazaron until he was locked away in his own mind. Before he was imprisoned in his mind, he was a part of the Devious Clowns and attempted to send all of Elitshia into a eternal coma.

name: Karen Stockmorth
description: Dressed as a penguin, Stevie is proud of her family’s history of performing in a circus so much that she attempts to create her own circus of deviants. Her daughter created the Street Deviants and often assists them with advance technology from her tech startup.
abilities: Cane/Sword that can fire lazers; Ice beams; Electric blasts; Cape that allows her to glide

name: Baren Hodge
description: Speaking in a deep Russian accent, Baren Hodge is a touch guy that pumps his overly muscular body with a compound that causes him to enrage and go on a rampage. He is very strong and capable of stopping a move train
abilities: Superhuman strength; Impenetrable skin when on V-drip

name: Cynthia Coleridge
description: A two-faced demon that took over the body of Cynthia Coleridge when she was near death because of the chemical spill that affected her crew. Once an act known for her dual personas on stage. Now inhabited by an unnamed demon, she possesses enhanced intelligence, abilities to create fire, smoke, teleportation, and other demonic abilities.
abilities: Demonic abilities; Teleportation; Smoke manipulation; Enhanced intelligence

name: Damien Roth
description: Even before the chemical spill that affected his traveling circus act, Damien Roth was secretly a serial killer that used rope and wiring to control his victim’s corpse. This act once he went full public villain, coined him the name Puppeteer.
abilities: Uses wiring; Rope to control his victim’s corpse

name: Unknown
description:
Age: Uknown

Born in the dark ages of the Earth, The Master was known as the figure that appeared during all battles. His true identity and origin is unknown allowing many to believe him to be a deity that fell to Earth after the great fight. It is said that he haves the unique ability to gather other abilities near him, his ability showed to have grown in Chapter 20 when he was able to use Weather Master’s abilities although the two were nearly 30 miles apart from each other at the time.

One of the often foes to the Elite Force and Wild 4, Changeler can their form to match that of monstrous reptiles including crocodiles, alligators, sharks, etc and large monstrous insects. Although their true form and gender is a secret, they mostly take on the male form with a slightly feminine voice. Their past is current unknown.

Wearing mysterious jewelry, like the Great Cloak, The Guide has no special powers of his own and possesses a secretive nature. No one even knows his name or at least real name and his origin is also a mystery. He joins the Guild of Super Villians because he hates super heroes believing them to be the cause of so much destruction on Earth. As seen during the Great World War when super heroes caused more damage fighting against bad guys then the bad guys did.

Years ago, The Lost Man was sent into a different dimension by The Craze and has since lost his memories and ability to leave. To make up for this, The Lost Man met up with a mysterious being that provided him powers that could separate his mind from the dimension back into the real world. Since then, he has made contact with his family of which he later forgets who they and him are.

Miracle has been around for millions of years with no proper date of birth. Some believe her to be about as old as Earth maybe older as her true origins appear human but with her original language predating human words. Living near the Pond of Life, Miracle was given the ability of healing anything she passes or touches with one thought and she can never be harmed nor can she die.
affiliates: Devious Clowns; Guild of Super Villains; The Lights
abilities: Collective Abilities; Skilled fighter; Skilled gun user; Knows 18 languages

name: Matthew Wilson
description:
Abilities: Abilities to create deadly serums from his body

A psychotic chemist who invented a serum that can turn almost anyone into a mindless slave of his. While world renouned for his achievements, his experiments caused him to receive expulsion from his study. With no work or money, he joined the circus and after its chemical accident, he gained the abilities to create serums from his own body to control others, mutate people into monsters, change forms, and kill someone instantly.
abilities: His business suit prevents psychic attacks; Poison

name: Diamonte
description: A collection of misunderstood individuals that are not your typical heroes nor villains as they just do things to get noticed so as to not be only looked at because of their mutated appearances.

name: Keon Members
description: Keon Members is very rich, often using his massive supply of technology from his firm to sell it to various people including heroes and villains alike. Unlike other heroes, the Diamonte are only concearn of their separate curses of each member and thus not worry about others, however they collectively been considered vigilantes at times. Keon Members can create a body protective armor like structure on his skin that stronger than anything on the planet.

name: Deon Waits
description: Deon Waits was born with a metal chip in his body that served as a small magnet. It is said that at the emergence of World War 2, he was a weapon built from human remains and stapled together with the brain of a 19th century war veteran. Because Deon’s organs and most of his body are organic, he can live virtually forever through replacing his skin and organs from other humans, virtually making him immortal. His brain serving as his life source, it is known that it’s the only way to defeat him however to do this, you must pass through his hard armor that he attracted in the 1980s and later a magnetic ability he transformed with in the 1990s. He joined the Diamonte after learning that his brain was cursed and that to live he must find the source of the curse before it activates. He mentioned that it his only goal with the group as other members agreed that because they each share a similar curse they will help each other.

name: Vivia Welch
description: Vivia Welch was a reporter that always had to get her story. It wasn’t until one day she was chasing a story and ended up driving her car into a polluted pond off US HWY 1. Months after her death as been declared, she came back to life due to the pollutions in the water which caused her to change the density of her body, thus changing with the environment around her. She could become bigger than a house, or thin as paper, hard as a diamond, or light as air. Her abilities made a force to be reckon with, thus her introduction into the Diamonte. Although because of her own story she assists the other members in destroying their curses although not having a curse herself. At times she works with The Maniacs serving as a prime villain of many chapters.

name: E.L.I.T.E Organization
description: Organizations that watch over and protect the innocence of humanity from threats beyond human control such as super powered threats or battles beyond the Earth.

name: E.L.I.T.E Organization
description:
Age: over 300

A secret society that was formed nearly three hundred years prior to protect human society and abolish criminal threats from supernatural or alien foes. The team was discovered by a group of elite soldiers whom each witnessed a supernatural occurrence. This led to their pitch and funding from virtually every secret agency on Earth. Their constant threat is their opposing force the Reckoning. Their location is hidden and it is reported that over 2.1 million agents participate in the program. Their color of choice is white head to toe including their weapons, vehicles, and base. Each agent is ranked from Alpha which is the lowest to Omega Elite which is the highest command.

name: Pulitura
description:
Note: The Clean Up Crew

A set of highly skilled and advanced technological beings believed to be in great gratitude to the E.L.I.T.E Organization. For the understandings to everyone apart of the organization. No one understands why or where these beings come from. Nor why they are in such gratitude to the Elite Organization. They have been around for thousands of years and are believed to be ancestors to Egyptians. Their language is similar to Hieroglyphics except with Italian integrated into pieces of the alphabet. Their bodies light up to omit burning light. They are considered the clean up crew for all non human interactions.
abilities: Can heal anything; Bring things back to life; Fly; Levitate; Telekinesis; Immortality; Super strength; Technokinesis; Illusions

name: E.L.I.T.E Astrologers
description:
Note: Team 86

A group of scientists, aliens, and a commander who were the first to enter outer space on a long-haul mission. When stranded in space, the group found a gate that can transport them to other worlds through a miniature blackhole.

name: Edmund Jackson
description: Born in Richmond, Virginia, Edmund graduated from Harvard at 23 and has since won numerous awards for his scientific research. Brought into Team 86 by Abel in hopes he can help the team on their first outer space tour.

name: Tila Macklemore
description: Born in Los Angeles, California, Tila was looked at as a typical Hollywood actress because of her attitude. But has revealed that she is skilled in combat when she performed one of her signature stunts from one of her movies. Her extensive combat training puts her on par with Matthew Benjamin several times.

name: Matthew Benjamin
description: Matthew was born in Chicago, Illinois, he was trained in extensive hand to hand combat and is skilled with numerous weapons. He was recruited into the E.L.I.T.E Organization until he was re-assigned to an unknown unit called Team 86. Upon his arrival it was disclosed that he did something to cause each member of his previous unit to unexpectedly die which caused him to become disruptive when anyone brings it up. He is the leader of Team 86 and is respected by all except Tila.

name: Munroe Jenkins
description: Munroe was born in London, England and first register to join Team 86 when he built a dangerous weapon that caused a split in space and time. This device was stolen by the Shadow Unit and later used to transport Team 86 into unknown space.

name: Gabriel Rojas
description: Gabriel was born in Mexico and appeared as one of the many scientists that that died in the explosion of her previous laboratory. She woke up three days later in a hospital bed at Team 86’s headquarters to unknown reasons. It was later discovered that she is half alien on her mother’s side after her father, also a scientist helped her mother to safety from authorities.
abilities: Limited telepathy; Heighten knowledge of dark matter

name: Francesca Armstrong-Heights
description:
Appearance: Wife to Harold, she convinced him to travel with the Elite Astrologers to outer space. She is often his voice of reason.

Francesca was born in Poland and is married to Harold, the general and creator of Team 86. She is often their guide while on missions throughout space because of her extensive knowledge of the worlds and their relative knowledge gathered by her husband’s vision.

name: Varen
description: Varen is a Mornation that joined Team 86 after the group saved his world from a group of rogued stars. He often uses his abilities of light manipulation to help the team but rarely in ways to combat as his race is against violence. He is a skilled mechanic and has a deep understanding of spacecrafts.

name: Galactic Authorities
description:
Age: Over 1000 Years Old

The Galactic Authorities are space troopers that guard the Andromeda Galaxy. They are one of many teams apart of the Cosmic Federation that was formed to protect the universe from threats. Their home base is in the Libra Constellation.

name: Cosmic Federation
description:
Age: Over 1140 Years Old

Cosmic Federation is a powerful group of aliens and humans who form a massive organization that is built on the idea of unionizing the many worlds and galaxies across the universe. It is often believed that the Cosmic Federation is a constant across the multiverse and has deep ties with the alien race Ennsimeum Kouten.

name: Harold Heights
description: Harold Heights was born in Poland and met his wife Francesca when they attended college while researching colonies forming near the Libra Constellation. Harold went on to have an extensive career in the army was given the title of general over Team 86. He formed the team with hopes to travel to different worlds. His team built the 86 Commander, the team’s spacecraft with the help of the E.L.I.T.E Organization.

name: Lei Young
description: Lei Young was the previous leader of Team 86 in the late 90s. His team unknowingly to the rest of the world discovered the Access Gates which are now found on nearly every world with sentient life. He died on their last mission and was brought back to life at the same time as Gabriel when an unknown wave hit the Earth causing over 4000 people to come back to life on the same day regardless of when they originally died.

name: Nuptia
alias: Temporary member of Team 86 and skilled warrior
description: Nuptia joined Team 86 for several missions while she searched for the person responsible for attacking her homeworld much to the dismay of Varen. As a Natayan, her people although once one world with the Mornations, have since become their natural enemies. With moon based abilities, Nuptia great fighting skills rival that of great warriors and mixed with her moon based and aquatic abilities she can even encase her opponents in a bubble if focused.

name: Earth Raiders
description: Chosen by the Earth God, Tur, these humans were given special armor and powers to help protect the world from demons that were bent on stealing the power from the 66 seals placed on Earth to serve as a doorway to release Santaniel. They hold the power of the ancient Earth Crystals which were created by the gods to banish demons from Earth back to Hell. Tur collected the crystals and gave them throughout the ages to young individuals who possessed the values of those individual gods. The Earth Raiders story consists of five different arcs including 1. The Awakening of the Earth Raiders; where the Earth Raiders are introduced and in the first six chapters we learn of each of the Earth Raiders. 2. The Rise of the Dark Ages; follows the Earth Raiders in their final battles against the Arch Demon and the leave of Tur back to the Heavens. 3. Descent; introduces Tur’s long forgotten daughter and her take on becoming a leader and the new advisory of the Earth Raiders along with arrival of Visather. 4. Earth’s Reign; fourth story featuring a slightly new team of the Earth Raiders along with Lady Row taking a more attentive role. 5. The Summoning; features battle after battle of a hoard of demons from Santiniel as the demon god finally breaks loose. It introduces Orlax the new advisor to the Earth Raiders and leave of Lady Row. It also brings back Tur, Lady Row, and other past members for a big battle toward the end of this arc.

name: Debian Fenky
description: Fan of skiing, Debian was on his way to become Ski champion of his local squad before a local tragedy happened and forced him to stop. Debian was summoned forth by Tur to become leader of his new group of heroes. He became the Earth Raider over Ice and uses his Ice Saber to vanquish demons with one blow. His powers are descendant of the Ice Titans.
abilities: Power over Ice; Can create a shield of steel

name: Catie Wenstall
alias: Fire Raider (also has fire bow and arrows)
description: Catie was a born Firestarter that was a much troublemaker in her youth. To the point that when she was 5, she burned down her house and ran away from home only to return a few years later. Her family welcomed her back without hesitation much to her surprise. She welcomed the decision and changed her ways. However, years later a demon provoked her turning her into a Firestarter again. Before she could vanquish him with her powers, she was teleported by Tur to his secret under Earth location where he made her an Earth Raider.

name: Killian Arnold
alias: Rock Raider (also has rock like sledgehammer)
description: A basketball champion who was set to becoming an all-star before he was attacked by a demon. Believing that the demon was a way to show he wasn’t meant to become anything more than a street boy. He went into a depression and sought to work a simple blue-collar job. While out before he committed a devastating act, Tur pulled him away and made him the Rock Raider. Him and Debian often fight over who is the leader of the group. He is second in command after Debian.
abilities: Power over the Earth; Super human strength

name: Misty Omayes
alias: Wind Raider (also holds the Gauntlet of Adv, the sky goddess)
description: Maintaining a busy lifestyle as a young mom and coach over her junior Track team, Misty gave her son a golden dime one day. Not knowing that it possessed magical powers. She later discovered that the coin belonged to a demon. Her son was absorbed into the coin (another dimension) by the demon threatening to turn her son to the dark side unless she finds a way to release them both. Attempting to help her get her son back, the god, Tur turned her into the Wind Raider.

name: Orion Smith
alias: Star Raider (holds throwing stars that lights up and explodes)
description:
Abilities: Later can teleport the team when needed

Orion has always been a star gazer, even going as far as changing his name to his favorite star. So obsessed that he joined NASA to become an astronaut. Although he passed his exam, he failed the physical. Determined still, Tur transformed him into the Star Raider.
abilities: Powers over light; Star like powers

name: Jessie Macintosh
alias: Force Raider (also holds the Spear of Power, handed down by the deity Marmexlade)
description: Jessie joins the other Earth Raiders after their first mission in bringing down Saint Gillord’s army. However, at the time he was unsure about their position in fighting the forces of Hell as they all were young and unexperienced. Before his life as an Earth Raider, he led an expedition to find the lost city of Elisthia which is what the current city of Elitshia is based. Believing that is where many of the ancient stories and his abilities are from. There is where he met the deity Tur who explained the powers of the ancient Earth Crystals to him and explained that they are given to those who can connect to them.

name: Jonas Nupon
alias: Aqua Raider (holds the triton from Crochen)
description: Jonas took after his father traveling the world to become a Guinness world record for best and long-lasting swimmer. He attempted the feat after watching his father drown because of it. However, he was pulled away later by Tur before his own drowning. He became the Aqua Raider shortly after, although he despises being on a team, he often joins the Earth Raiders on difficult missions. He can be found in his own stories as fighting solo. He has frequent story crossovers with the Mermadic Kingdom.
affiliates: Earth Raiders and Mermadic Kingdom; Earth Raiders
abilities: Power over water; Can speak to aquatic lifeforms

name: Kim Plier
description: Kim Plier was a normal teenager who was taken to become a bride to the Arch Demon in the second half of the Earth Raiders’ saga. Here she shed her human exterior and became a demon princess. She often summons demons representing deformed animals.
abilities: Powers to summon; Super strength; Acid like hair; Demonic abilities

name: Cainos Mrood
description: Cainos was abducted from daycare and raised as a demon warrior. He was enchanted by demons to bare the Mark of Lucifer which provides him incredible demonic powers. This also provides him great pain at times and massive amounts of anger which he barely controls. He summons mostly elemental related demons.
abilities: Powers to summon; Demonic abilities; Appearance; Mark of Lucifer; Flight; Super human strength

name: Luvicre
description: Turned into a demon on his 30th birthday, Luvicre was one of the few people who actually asked for his transformation. His brute strength is because of his deformed body that made him appear massive and he lacks intelligence. He is the muscle of the Arch Demon team and often becomes their joking matter when battles need to be fought.
abilities: Power to summon; Super strength; Sound waves from hands

name: Arch Demon
description: One of the remaining henchmen above ground from Santaniel. He fought his back up when he was banished below by Tur. Since then, he holds a vicious feud with the weaken deity.
abilities: Power to summon; Super strength; Demonic abilities; Dark magic

name: Visather
description: After fleeing the Earth during the raid of demons, Visather returned after learning of the Arch Demon’s demise at the hands of the Earth Raiders. Hoping to get back into the good graces of Santaniel, Visather launched an attack onto the Earth with the Earth Raiders his direct enemies. He is a small man with powers strong enough to dethrone a god. His fortress is a giant floating city in the form of a ship and it homes over 3,000 demons.
abilities: Power to raise defeated demons; Break planets in half; Super strength; Psychic scream

name: Litentha
description: Visather’s right hand soldier, her long tentacles serve as an impulse that can control other demons. She is very quick and possesses a master of all known fighting skills on Earth. She followed the Arch Demon at one time until she saw his future demise and thus moved to the side of Visather.
abilities: Power to control demons with tentacles; Psychic visions; Enhanced speed

name: Insectus
description: An insect demon that comes from an insect like dimension. In this dimension he provided insects of the world a power that allows them to communicate to each other and move between worlds, something that goes unnoticed by people of Earth. His metallic armor protects his body from elements and allows him to be able to breathe on Earth.
abilities: Can control insects; Acid breath; Super human strength; Speed; Flight; Enhanced hearing; Sight

name: Bartoose
description: Once a minion of the deity The Dog, he changed his lifestyle when he heard the gods disappearing because of Mostibik. He went into hiding building up an army to impress Visather’s command. His chariot is bronze and is led by giant dogs whose barks can cause thunderstorms.
abilities: Power over dogs; Super strength; God like abilities; Thunder wielding

name: Beta 9
description: A golem created by Tur when he believed that he would be stranded on Earth. He encased the golem into armor and provided it with knowledge of a computer thanks to help from Authora. It has since assisted Tur on his many operations including creating the suits of the Earth Raiders and the base that they live within under the Earth.

name: Lady Row)
description: The secretive daughter to Tur, she was forgotten by the other gods and lived out her life as an actress on Earth. She was once the oracle that guided Tur on various missions across Earth in ancient times. She has taken many names while remaining with her birth name Lady Row. She is pictured on old cave walls like her current appearance as a long white and silver haired woman with beautiful porcelain skin and a flowing dress made up of clouds. After Tur returns to his place amongst the gods, she agrees to lead the new team of Earth Raiders in the third arc.

name: Orlax
description:
Note: born Wilson Graves

During the 5th and final arc, after Lady Row finally earns a place amongst the gods with her father. Orlax a young boy from Highland Grove was bestowed powers by an unknown deity. His actual reasoning was to provide the world with a secret protector of knowledge in case the gods were to disappear again. Orlax born Wilson Graves, changed his name to Orlax on his 11th birthday in honor of the deity whose name he thought sounded like Orlax. He is seen as a ball headed figure, with shinning white eyes, sparkling gold skin, and normal human attire. He doesn’t remember much from his mortal life and his parents considers him dead after being missing for nearly two years.
abilities: God like intellect; Superhuman strength; Power over technology

name: Elite Astrologers
description: Popular astrologers that uses advance government technology to travel through space. Their primary mission is to unlock the mysteries of our own world, the past, the future, and discover other civilizations. Throughout their missions they have encountered various worlds with various inhabitants and has since educated citizens of the earth about other world beings. Using Access Points from around the universe that they installed on every visited planet that they have encountered. The Elite Astrologers has went on over 10,000 voyagers. With existence from various other worlds, the Access Points our now on almost every planet in existence including few stars, asteroids, moons, and three suns. Several realms of existences and alternative universes also contain access points.

name: Harold Armstrong-Heights
description:
Is commanding chief of the Elite Astrologers. He is 50 years old and until his first mission at the age of 39 he was uncertain and unwilling to believe of other lifeforms in the universe. However, he was convinced by his wife that it would be a good idea for him to go along with New Elitshia's space mission to find other life.

Son to Harold, he is a college student who often experiences various alien activities however because of the government cover up he is often overlooked and laughed at by his fellow peers. He later joins the Outer World Alliance team to start a new life. He is very skilled at alien languages because of his experience with them.

name: Gale Drommand
description: Gale is an intelligent research officer that follows in the footsteps of her father that passed when she was only seven. Her stern nature is often at the behest of Andrew’s flirtier and frat brother type of attitude. She discovered a signal from outer space that was attempting to contact the team which led to their first official mission.

name: Andrew Kopping
description: Andrew a flirty, spoiled rich frat boy that graduated at the top of his regimen. He is quick, strong, and acts as the leader of the team after Harold steps back from missions after Chapter One of the Outer World story. His leadership skills have been well received by his teammates including Gale who is secretly admires and has a deep affection for, but loaves him for his simple-minded attitude.

name: Reginald Steeling
description: Reginald Steeling is a brilliant Astrophysicist and research officer. He befriended Gale during their years at Yale and is very fond of her work. Gale was at his wedding to his late husband and there at his husband’s funeral. The two rely on each other often for emotional support, with Gale declaring her empathy and support for him in Chapter Two of the Outer World story.

name: Ga’uld
description:
Age: 300 years old (appears 34)

A Mornation that sent a signal to any nearby world to assist in saving his world from eternal night after an all-out attack by the Natayans. Ga’uld is strong, intelligent, incredible dancer and singer and loves Earth cultures and food. His quiet yet blunt personality often contradicts his overly happy appearances later in the Outer World story. To save his homeworld, was the first official mission of the Elite Astrologers.

name: Felix Cox
alias: United States Air Force Major General
description: Felix is a smart, level-headed general who commands the Outer World team to explore various worlds. He is started the Outer World program and along with the US government hides its existence from the rest of the world. He is the uncle to Julia Sterns from the story Roman and Julia.

name: Corin Illind
description:
Age: Appears 40 years old

An alien refuge that joins the Outer World team later in the story to assist with saving her people from slavery. He is a quick learner and often leads astrological programs while Gale and Ga’uld are away during Chapter 4 and 5 of the Outer World stories. He returns to his world after liberating his people during Chapter 6.
abilities: Enhanced senses; Speed; Knows over 300 languages

name: Davis Brokemyer
alias: General & Leader of the Outer World Alliance team
description: Leader of the Outer World Alliance team, he appears in the final chapter, Chapter 7 of the Outer World story to assist with getting Earth to be apart of the Universal Alliance. He is intelligent, a great leader, and quick thinker.

name: Shi’era Olmackus
alias: Second in Command of the Outer World Alliance team
description:
Age: Appears 40 years old

Assistant and number one to Davis Brokemyer. She is tall, strong, and often mistaken to be a Warein when she is on Earth because of her physical appearance. She leads the team in the absence of Davis and is usually his lead support on difficult and private matters.

name: Keela Zarack
alias: Outer World Alliance team Human Resources
description:
Age: Appears 14 years old

A powerful seer that can see distance into the future yet has no control over her powers. It was predicted by her aunt that she will one day control her abilities at the cost of her sight. She is a valuable member of the Outer World Alliance team although she appears to be only 14 years old.

name: Eugene Smith
description: A con artist that found his way aboard the Outer World Alliance vessel. He is a skilled martial artist and knows various languages. After several fights, arguments, and act of treason with the other members of the team. He was finally accepted for saving Keela from a Galactic Being attack on her home planet. Because of his vast knowledge of trade markets and numerous worlds he has since travelled too, Eugene is valuable to the team.

name: Amanda Wallace
description: A trained pilot that often is seen as a serious person despite having comedic parents. Her training was an attempt to be taken serious and not looked at as her parent’s child. She has long spikey hair and a goth inspired wardrobe.

name: Kenneth Rivers
alias: Outer World Alliance main weapons engineer
description: A skilled weapons master, Kenneth joined the Outer World Alliance (OWA) team to see different weapons across the galaxy. He is the team’s main weapons engineer.

name: Dr. Ashley Rameau
alias: Outer World Alliance main chief medical officer
description: A doctor aboard the Alliance. When call upon for any type of injury or medical question. Doctor Rameau is the person that many goes to. She is levelheaded, intelligent, and quick thinking. She has also served in the field and is well versed in alien biology.

name: Kimberly Stone
alias: Outer World Alliance main civilian nurse
description: Assistant to Dr. Rameau, she is skilled in her duties and has major respect for her crew. Kimberly has been shown as a skilled fighter and often trains in her spare time.

name: Zachary Pole’
description: Zachary is highly trained science offer aboard the Alliance. He is one of the few that understands almost every part of the Alliance and often works closely with Kenneth.

name: Fransis Bowen
description: A kind, loving, and empathic psychologist aboard the Alliance. She is strong minded and willed; she serves as the voice of reason to the crew and assist in the field at times. She is a Chanuga Clan member and boarded the Alliance in attempt to assist the crew in their missions.

name: Space Fighters
description:
Age: Varies

A team of armored fighters with highly advance weapons. Usually, Space Fighters are some of the largest groups of fighters found within the Deep Existence.
affiliates: Outer World Deep Alliance; Elite Astrologers

name: White Helmet Group
description: Basic soldiers typically at the lowest ranks of the Space Fighters.

name: Blue Helmet Group
description: Next level up soldiers that are guards to high authoritative figures and are more skilled fighters.

name: Black and White Helmet Group
description: Highly trained soldiers, usually seen around royal figures.

name: Black Helmet Group
description: The most trained soldiers of the Space Fighters.

name: The Erhyu
description:
Age: Varies
Note: Airyu

Powerful soldiers that hold a varying range of psychic abilities. The Erhyu are trained in prestigious academies around the universe specializing in teaching their abilities, culture, and studies.
affiliates: Outer World Deep Alliance; Elite Astrologers

name: Varus Richter
description: A previous member of the Erhyu that thought their peaceful practices weren’t enough to sustain the universe. He is strong and practices a higher level of telekinetic abilities than his former colleagues. Along with his sister, Varus started a war against the Universal Alliance.
affiliates: Outer World Deep Alliance; Elite Astrologers

name: Mera Richter
description: Sister of Varus, her own path to liberate her people from the confines of the Universal Alliance. Has caused her to master her abilities to become her brother’s accomplice.
affiliates: Outer World Deep Alliance; Elite Astrologers

name: Blackhole Fighters
description:
Age: Varies

A division under Varus and Mera of the Space Fighters. Their ranks are similar except for their team appears almost to disregard the trainings of the Space Fighters.
affiliates: Outer World Deep Alliance; Elite Astrologers

name: Red Helmet Group
description: Replaces the White Helmet Group level.

name: Laison Jackson
description: Wanting to join the Erhyu since he was a kid. Laison learned how to fight and master his limited telekinetic abilities from a young age. When he turned 24, he joined the Deep Alliance team aboard the Confederation.

name: Son Uh Way
description: A trained officer who reports and guides the Confederation on its missions across the galaxy. She is smart, funny, and very honest.

name: Cameron Reeds
description: Leader of the Confederation and its most skilled fighter. He is equipped with knowing numerous languages, trained Erhyu teachings, and knows many poisons throughout the galaxy. He is admired by his crew, mostly Laison.

name: Element Lords
description: A roofless set of villains consisting of elemental controlling descendants that goes after anyone that has done wrong to them or someone that they like. Their powers has caused them to each be unstoppable villains in their own rights.

name: Richie Kindel
description: Richie began his fight with the Element Lords in an attempt to get back to his girlfriend for cheating on him. He burned her house down and murdered her family. After she turned him into the police and left to the other side of the country. Richie escape on a rampage and became apart of the Element Lords.
abilities: Fire body; Fire beams from hands; Eyes

name: Solu Kimbrey
description: During the flood of 2009 in Atlanta, GA, Solu was born during a chemical spill in the waters near the Chattanooga River. With no parents or anyone to raise him, Solu became his own villain terrozing nearby villiages and cities with major floods. He would travel across the country until one day when he came across Black Tornado and the two would share each other’s dream of terrozing humans, as they felt they were inferior.
abilities: Can manipulate water; Stretch his body

name: Mitchell Reggick
description: Mitchell Reggick was called the Black Tornado because of his massive control over the winds. His body would twist as to mimick the tornados of his town in KanSAA. Growing up bored of his existence, Mitchell traveled from KanSAA to places like Atlanta, New York, Los Angeles, & Miami, finding others that shared his similar super-human stature. He first met H20 and later Heatseeker and the three created the Element Lords.

name: Missy Coldren
description: Missy considered herself a true lady, wearing diamonds, long white hair, pretty dresses, and always surrounded by men in waiting. Missy grew up like a true princess because of her parent’s wealth. However after her parents cut her off, Missy started to find her own way to stay rich, she joined the Element Lords and stole what she wanted.

name: Elysian Fairies
description: Magical fairies that were sent to Earth to watch over the various planes of existence that connects to the magical world, Tier. From here each took a different responsibility.

name: Cynthia
description: Born in a magical world, Cynthia came to Earth in hopes to know more about its culture and history. While visiting, Cynthia became trapped there with no way to return home. It was later found out that, Cynthia is a fairy however while on Earth her abilities make her a Abnormal. In Chapter 18, Cynthia returns home but not before help destroying a evil plant creature from destroying SAA.

name: Satalina
description: Born in the magical world, Satalina came to Earth in search of her cousin Cynthia. Once there she got lost in Arizona and for some time forgot who she was. While there she befriended a family who took her in as their own daughter and was raised working in a library where she relearned of her fairy race.

name: Osana Filsian
description: Using the power over the oceans, allowed Osana to surround herself with the most peaceful surroundings of any one of her kind. Born in the fairylands, Osana became rightful queen of the nature there after her mother gave up her birthright to travel the planet Earth.

name: Almonte Some’
description: Almonte Some’ became princess of a small planet just outside of human dreams. From her world she could see the fairylands and travelled there hoping to join the Elysian Fairies. She got her wished when the other fairies were in danger. Her powers are from the elements.

name: Galatic Beings
description: Giant god like robots that are sentient. Their world is large and consists of mechanical buildings and robotic lifeforms. Galatic Beings appear almost entirely as gods in many Earth stories.

name: Omegadroids
description:
Age: Varies

Large robots that resemble passenger vehicles from Earth. Their sentience allows them high level of knowledge for many things technical. Led by Robotus Omega, Omegadroids are often kind and opposite of Alphadroids. Their goal is to unite their worlds and save its people.
affiliates: Galactic Beings; Robotus Omega; Galatic Beings

name: Crane
description: A large crane like Omegadroid, he is the team’s transporter and physical strength.

name: Lanceamb
description: An ambulance vehicle that is the team’s medical help.

name: Racepad
description: A racecar Omegadroid that is fast and quick to act. He is the team’s scout.

name: Heli
description: A helicopter scout for the team and lookout. She and Racepad are in love.

name: Coupe
description: A coupe that is very feminine, he likes Lanceamb, although the feelings are one sided. He is the team’s on the ground fighters.

name: Truckfighter
description: A pickup truck fighter that uses large sword like lasers.

name: Rocketbus
description: A bus like droid that uses large wheels that turn to fire when he is fighting.

name: Boatglide
description: A raceboat fighter that is mostly seen during water missions.

name: Autoshaw
description: An older Omegadroid resembling an auto rickshaw and van mix. He is the oldest and most knowledgeable fighter and right hand to Robotus Omega.

name: Alphadroids
description:
Age: Varies

Large robots resembling army vehicles from Earth. Like their enemies the Omegadroids, their abilities and high intelligence allow them a force of great pride amongst their kind. With the goal to unite their worlds under one rule, their leader Magnus Alpha wants to rule their many worlds with an iron fist.
affiliates: Galactic Beings; Magnus Alpha; Galatic Beings

name: Humvee
description: A Humvee Alphadroid and tactical fighter of the team. He often leads the war planning and is right hand to Magnus Alpha.

name: OmniTank
description: The oldest Alphadroid and original right hand of Magnus Prime. He often thinks Magnus Alpha is unfit to be king of their world.

name: V-Larc
description: Often seen in water based missions. He is a fighter and mostly scout.

name: Oshkosh
description: A delivery mechanic for the team. He speaks with a deep tone and is called on to fix the team’s parts.

name: Terran Vi
description: An All-terrain bike like Alphadroid that is the direct comparison to Racepad with their similar behaviors and quick responses to trouble.

name: Tirian Vu
description: Sister to Terran Vi and acts in a more responsible manner with on occasion similar quick to think attitude. Although, younger than Terran Vi, she acts as his voice of reason and older sister.

name: Van dyne
description: An older van like Alphadroid that is the team’s mentor and voice of reason. Although younger than the leader(s), he is very knowledgeable and is responsible for helping build other Alphadroids.

name: Statgon
description: A station wagon like droid that is old fashioned and likes to fight with old fashion weapons instead of upgrades.

name: Dupree
description: A coupe and mystery lover of Coupe. The two can often seen sneaking off with each other. He is blue, while Coupe is red.

name: Galactic Beings
description:
Age: Varies

The race of large vehicle and mechanical species that resembles vehicles, buildings, and technology from Earth and surrounding worlds. Galactic Beings are very intelligent and have a variety of abilities like lasers and speak in varying languages.

name: Robotus Omega
description: Leader of the Omegadroids, this large robotic Omegadroid resembles a large carrier craft. He speaks in a gentle tone, has leader qualities, and usually proposes a calmer plan against his enemies then his brother Magnus Alpha.

name: Magnus Alpha
description: Leader of the Alphadroids, unlike his brother Robotus Omega, Magnus is overwhelmed with power and the grief of losing his father which he blames Robotus for. The two once were close, even fighting alongside each other against the Omega Wars that separated various worlds. Now he wishes to unite the worlds in an attempt rule them.

name: Magnus Prime
description: Father to Magnus Alpha and Robotus Omega. He was the original ruler of the combined worlds that now operate as separate entities. Upon his passing, his sons began to fight each other for control over their father’s previous kingdom. He was seen as a kind yet strict king and very beloved.
affiliates: Magnus Alpha and Robotus Omega; Galatic Beings

name: Andra Omega
description: Mother of Magnus Alpha and Robotus Omega, she was seen as the most beautiful Galactic Being. A large presence, her appearance was like a convertible, and she spoke in soft tones. Her passing during the Omega Wars is what caused her sons to turn on each other.
affiliates: Magnus Alpha and Robotus Omega; Galatic Beings
abilities: Wind like abilities; Wind laser; Flight

name: Magnus Beta
description: Future son to Magnus Alpha and future leader of the Omegadroids. He is kindhearted and fought to unite his people, although ending on the opposite side because of his beliefs. He came to the past to assist with the fight against the Akuma. He was assumed dead but came back when the future was restored.
affiliates: Omegadroids and Magnus Alpha; Galatic Beings

name: Ultra Omega
description: Daughter of Robotus Omega and leader of the Alphadroids, she is beautiful and often referred to by her followers as Lady Omega like her grandmother. She is strong willed and admires her uncle’s approach to rule and his beliefs. She has a disdain toward her cousin Magnus Beta and father Robotus Omega.
affiliates: Alphadroids and Robotus Omega; Galatic Beings

name: Sentient Omega
description: A large sentient machine that speaks with a deep stern voice. It was created by a small alien race that ascended in the early days of its world. This machine creates others sentient lifeforms with various missions that travel to other worlds to take them over and mine resources.

name: Sentient Ones
description:
Age: Varies

Large machines that speak with confident and autotune voices. These humanoid-like robots are strong, tall as buildings, and have appeared on numerous worlds in search of desolating numerous worlds to harvest their resources. The Elite Force came across these machines on several occasions.

name: Anidroids
description:
Age: Varies

Large animal like droids that appeared on Earth thousands of years ago. Their biological structure allowed for mating with animals of the world thus bringing forth various animal species of today’s Earth. These droids are typically strong, fast, and very intelligent.

name: Galacticdroids
description:
Age: Varies

The gods of the Galactic Being race, they are large and can destroy an entire world with their weapon of choice. Often seen from a distance, these beings were created by the Primordial Ones to destroy a world in case that world becomes to dangerous to its neighbors.

name: Dinodroids
description:
Age: Varies

Prehistoric creatures that are droids that landed on numerous worlds after their initial world was destroyed. They vary in sizes and species and can speak with old world tongue. On Earth it is believed that they inspired the extinction to the prehistoric lifeforms that inhabited the planet.

name: Galaxy Trio
description: Drawn together because of an element from outer space that appears suspiciously in their DNAs. This element provides them with special powers and with it they will embark on a journey to discover just what they are made of and how they will use their powers.

name: Marshall Rinks
description: Born in North Ireland, Marshall Rinks was only 4 when he learned of his mental abilities. He could read the minds of others while at school or for those he wanted to get close to. While at school, Marshall was considered an outcast and was determined to show just how powerful he was. In his late teens, Marshall became Starman and produced a powerful mental shock that placed almost everyone at his school in a deep coma state. Later in life, Starman would join several others like himself, StarMan X, Stardust, & Journeyboy.

name: Jonny Parks
description:
Abilities: Power suit that enables him to travel through dimensions

Unable to adventure like he always dream because of his paralysis. Jonny Parks develop a system or a suit that would enable him to move freely and later unknowingly to his knowledge move between dimensions. Along his journey, Jonny embarked on several missions with Starman & Stardust of who were called the Galaxy Trio and himself would take the title Journyboy. For a brief time, Jonny would join a gang of wealthy vigilantes named the Luxes Gang alongside his alternative self, Journey Man & The Voyager.

name: Stella Vjronka’jue
description: Stela was born on a planet named Mara and has since travelled to earth to enlist several of its most powerful and intelligent humans to assist in battling a demonic creature that travelled to Earth before her from her home world. She enjoys fruit, animals, and water and uses full force to defend her allies and mostly animals as she referred to them as earth spirits.
abilities: Lazer beams from eyes; Enhanced strength; Flight

name: Game Lords
description: Game players who received their abilities from a game called Game Lord. Each found each other after being drawn into the game and naming themselves after it. Here they play out the rules of the game and becomes it’s de-facto vigilantes.

name: Bessie Amos
description: A trickster, Bessie Amos attended Elmitt High a place known to have some of the weirdest students was the place where Bessie learned of her time traveling abilities. She could create illusions to warp time and help her produce a team similar to her called the Game Lords. At one period in her life after graduating Elmitt High, Bessie met Tempus and joined him on his quest to rewrite history.

name: Joetta Lendens
description: Joetta usually wears blue colored pocka-dotted attire with yellow hair and followed by oversized animals. Like her brother she can produce magical objects through the means of some sort of telekinesis. Although shes a prankster and almost no one likes her, she came across Bessie at school and the two created a strong bond. She agreed alongside her twin brother to follow Bessie and become one of the Game Lords.
abilities: Can make objects; People grow; Magical animation

name: Jonete Lendens
description: Jonete is seen with red colored pocka-dotted attire with green hair and oversized floating toys around him. Like his sister, he can produce magical objects and control them through telekinesis. Unlike his sister he can grow anything only strink it which sometimes shows little importance in a battle. So to make up for this he produced explosive toys and would later go by the name Trick.
abilities: Can make objects; People strink; Magical animation

name: Glory of Light
description: A disproportional team of six members of former bad guys who came together after the Rise of the Dead saga to bring order back to the world.

name: Jean Wright
description:
Abilities: Which he can channel through his scythes

During the “Death Rises Saga”, Jean found herself coming into her abilities very fast because of the riots and the dead that cause much destruction during the time.  She joined the Glory of Light because she stated she saw to much death during the raid.
abilities: Generates neurosynaptic energy causing slowness; Paralysis; Nerve damage

name: Zarick Goldrige
description:
Abilities: Able to generate vibratory shockwaves through his swords

A born theif, Zarick has always been a fan of stealing things from people more powerful them himself, somewhat of a mental accomplishment for himself, Zarick stated he took the name of Saber because of his love for collecting sharp objects including his magical sword which he was honored from a high preist who he decided to give all items that he stole back to.
abilities: Superhuman senses; Physical abilities; Accelerated healing; Enhanced cognition

name: Berick Conan
description:
Abilities: Endurance Genius level intellect Accelerated healing factor Supersonic Flight Telepathy Ability to perceive mutant auras

With genius level intellect, Berick Conan built a powerful computer that could detect other Descendants similar to what is located at the TANTIRITH. While meeting with Gadget, the two created a weapon known as the Symulas “a device that can destroy other Descendants regardless of their immortaility and/or abilities”. The device was hidden away from all and given to the ghost of Hanzirith for safe keeping. Berick serves as a intellectual member to the Glory of Light in similar ways as Gadget to Elite Force.
abilities: Superhuman strength; Speed; Agility; Dexterity; Reflexes; Coordination; Balance; Vision; Hearing

name: Jic-Suday
description: Sent from an earth like world light years away, Jic-Suday came to Earth to worn its citizens of a prophecised event that would end all life and turn the planet into the land of the dead. He created the Glory of Light in hopes to stop this prophecy from happening. Jic-Suday found out that it was the Shadow Haven with the power of the Arnoxus that brings the end of the world.

name: Demi Luis
description:
Abilities: Can make karma like actions happen to others when they harm her

A skilled girl of martial arts, Demi Luis has always been a protecter of the innocence, because of this; she was recruited to stand up against the dark forces of the Shadow Haven. Her powers allows her to fend off others by reflecting their emotions and physical attacks back at them ten times as much of effect as reflected upon her.

name: Guild of Super Villains
description: Tired of super heroes always winning, the Guild of Super Villains were formed in hopes to change the odds and finally have a winning streak. Their major opponents are the Armored Guild.

name: Gared Mcaled
description:
Abilities: Lizard like armor that releases a massive amount of acid from its body

Gared’s wife was killed by super powered heroes while fighting a alien force. Since then he has created a vile of liquid that can turn him into a lizard like creature with armor and destructive fangs.
affiliates: Guild of Super Villians; Guild of Super Villains
abilities: Steel fangs; Lizard like skin underneath

name: Harold Boswald
description: Although not a super powered villain, Harold Boswald took on the mantle of Great Cloak as a distraction from several super heroes who were looking for his fellow villians secret hideout. Since then he has caused many bank robberies and pety theif plans throughout Elite City.
affiliates: Guild of Super Villians; Guild of Super Villains

name: Jacob Versiye
description: Born in another universe, Jacob has been one of the most dangerous foes to enter the Guild of Super Villians. Using his powers to open doorways to other dimensions, Jacob known as the Inducer, leads an army of empowered skeletals rampaging throughout dimensions looking for the Key of Humanity. It is believed that he is looking for it for someone however, he never reveals it just is seen talking to himself making many believe that he is insane and not all there.
affiliates: Guild of Super Villians; Guild of Super Villains
abilities: Can open dimensions; Control demons with his mind; Protected against phsycic attacks; Possesses skilled fighting

name: Barb Ohun
description:
Age: Over 300 years old

A great hunter revived from the dead, Barb Ohun has lived for over 300 years and each century he dies and is revived thanks to a deal he made to a demon that he met while fighting in the Desserts of Elisthia. He joins the Guild of Super Villians in hopes to find a way to free his demonic entity.
affiliates: Guild of Super Villians; Guild of Super Villains
abilities: Immortality; Restorative healing abilities; Super strength; Great speed; Animal instincts

name: Killum Xold
description:
Abilities: Only one capable of destroying the Catalyst

Born to demons, Killum holds the distinct natue of not being a demon himself, however he possesses no demonic powers at all just demonic looks. His only known origin is that he was foretold to bring about the destruction of the Catalyst which holds the power once hidden inside of Refridge.
affiliates: Guild of Super Villians; Guild of Super Villains
abilities: Super strength; Lazer beams from eyes; Giant wings

name: Cara Wakes
description: Beautiful, seductive, and insane. This diamond bodied woman has the most beautiful form of any woman on earth. At least as told by any man that lays eyes on her. Her body was exposed to toxin that gave her diamond encrusted hair and a hard diamond body. She uses her diamond body to get her expensive things like a mansion, cars, clothing, and anything she wants and needs. She also holds the power to seduce any known man and sometimes women to do whatever she wants.
affiliates: Guild of Super Villians; Guild of Super Villains

name: Gara and Garon Bispell
description: Mutated at nature, Gara and Garon were born Siamese twins with two distinct powers. One could bring light while the other could bring darkness. Together they could wipe out lands by concentrating, although it has only been seen once in their homelands which is now the Sahara Dessert. To keep them tamed, the Guild of Super Villians made them one of their members and brainwashed them using Madam Gamora’s psychic powers.
affiliates: Guild of Super Villians; Guild of Super Villains
abilities: Power to omit darkness; Light from both joined bodies

name: Jadelin Gamora
description: The most powerful member of the guild, Jadelin Gamora built the guild to stop the Elite Force, however because of her often side missteps, she loses. Her powers are some of the strongest psychic powers in all of the Eliteverse and has been noted as one of the main reasons why she refuses to directly intervene in certain situations. It is known that she created the guild because she despises her once close ally Maida and wanted to oppose the Elite Force because of it.
affiliates: Guild of Super Villians; Guild of Super Villains
abilities: Psychic powers; Levitation; Force fields; Premonitions

name: Hepti Apocalypse
description: Spirit Rider born from neglected parents, became known for his ill tempered start and soon shed his bad behavior to become known as the hero he is today. Saving the world from supernatural forces.

name: Lyon Reeds
description:
Abilities: Flight Enhanced strength Aerial adaptation Peak physical attributes As Hell Rider: Metal wings Flight; Projection of razor sharp feathers Healing factor Enhanced strength Aerial adaptation Peak physical attributes

Lyon was born of a poor father and ill-tempered mother. He considered himself to have always been on his own and used his abilities to escape from home several times. During his moment in Salem, MS, Lyon was found by Bewithia who took his soul and traded it for great power. Without a soul, Lyon became known as the Demon Rider and had black wings instead of white. Kanos fought Bewithia bringing back Lyon’s soul and from that point, Lyon became known as the Spirit Rider with similar abilities.

name: Leric Vonges’
description:
Abilities: Can pollute the air with acid like gas

Reincarnation for the Horseman of Famine, Leric possesses the ring of pollution and usually is an oil typhoon when in civilian form. Seen in his green armor and a steed with fog like mane and rotten egg smelling air that follows him. Leric appears shortly after the Lazarons reappeared.
abilities: Super strength; Speed; Can move between fog

name: Ilia Goldine
description:
Abilities: Can appear in multiple places at once

Reincarnated as the Horseman of War, Ilia is a strategic officer in the Elitshian Army. One day she woke up to discover her ability to start conflict between anyone, even understanding every known strategic plan even without proper knowledge. From understanding games to planning wars far in advance. Ilia is tall with long black hair, and silver armor that protects her from magic and supernatural attacks. She first met the Lazarons while at Tantirith and fought them to prevent them from defeating the end of the world.
abilities: Knowledge of all battle plans; Can create war with her mind; Can learn any fighting skill

name: Agis Dunner
description: Reincarnated as the Horseman of Death, the descendant of the Primordial One of Death. Agis died as a boy, he was playing in the street until a car struck him and killed him. He was resurrected numerous times, but each time died only a few years later. Finally, the soul of the Horseman of Death’ essence enter his body, awakening him. He was given the mission to delay the rise of the Lazarons true power and bring forth the Apocalypse.
abilities: One touch death; Can control the dead; Necromancy; Can freely travel between life; Death; Heaven; Hell; Foresight; Immortality

name: Jaden Wells
description: Bringer of disease, the Horseman of Pestilence has been around since the dawn of humanity, infecting mortals with various diseases that stricken their life. Reincarnated as this horseman, Jaden never was sick not even with the common cold. Realizing he was probably a descendant because of his innate ability to heal from any womb instantly, he later discovered through vivid dreams and shadow meetings with the previous horseman, that he was to become the new Horseman of Pestilence. He brought forth the new disease and killed millions of humans through the act of it meaning his own death if he denied his calling.
abilities: Creates sickness; Disease; Immune to all diseases; Nigh-immortal

name: Insectious 4
description: A comedic group of anti-heroes whom in the 1950s was one of the only known costume wearing characters. Their stories often contained some element to their own crime or hero dynamics.

name: Arick Aims
description:
Abilities: Metal armored suit shaped like a beetle w/cannon like structures on arms

Arick Aims mostly called the Gold Beetle bought the opportunity to start up his own company named the Toy Sanctuary which wouldn’t go as plans. During the process of finishing the project, Arick now by the name the Gold Beetle would have to fight off criminals that wanted to steal his new winning lottery ticket and taking away his future fortune. Most of the stories surround the Gold Beetle set in the 1950s and followed comedic storylines of how he battled many criminals for a ticket that contained millions of dollars which would make Arick one of the richest people in the country if he could finally cash it in. In one short story, it tells of Gold Beetle creating an elite team of insect themed vigilantes that help protect his winning ticket and he would award them greatly if they could finally cash the ticket. The name of the group was the Insectious 4. Over time the 4 members would grow older and finally retire with few members remaining active.

name: Samuel James
description:
Abilities: Make himself as small as an ant

Samuel James became known of his abilities while playing in a sandbox as a child. He could talk to ants and for years throughout school would be called The Hive Master. He would join the Insectious 4 during his early twenties.

name: Jailen Cremroy
description:
Abilities: Can transform into any known animal including extinct ones

Mistaken for the family’s pet when he was an infant. Jailen always loved playing pranks on his fellow family members and classmates by turning himself into animals. For a time, he was apart of Insectious 4 and the Wild 4.

name: Khan's Empire
description: Two powerful individuals who lived hundreds of years ago. They came together to bring the world to destruction and rule over it.

name: Allennia
description: Once a famed princess and later mistress of a king in Troy. Allennia was both beautiful and very intelligent often going overlooked by men of her feats. Allennia was once alone in her room until she was raped and killed by a masked man closely resembling Master Khan. However this is hard to believe since Khan loved the princess upon meeting and killed several others for threatening her life. Khan revived the princess through dark magic and her soul was given to Umbrin, the Dark Lord in exchange for her life, heart, and memories again. Although the Allennia can’t leave Khan’s side, her memories allowed her to remember who she was and thus often is searching for a way to defeat him, his enemies, and enslave those that threatened her.

name: Khan
description: Originally one of the farmers from the same village of Dau-shin, Khan’s desire of world domination proved him to be a tirant at an early age. Khan enslaved his village through lying, cheating, seduction, and even magical entities and would later expand this to nearby villages and later to most of North America. Khan traveled abroad and found ways to manipulate other empires and even bringing them down. It is thought that he was partially responsible for the killing of the Wacked Mistress.
