abilities: Black Magic; Skilled swordsman; Control over life

name: Kiakashi Clan
description: Very skilled ninjas that existed in 1800s Japan. They appeared in current time several time however most of their stories existed in the 1800s and showed their constant battles with various super heroes in 1800s Japan.

name: Morgan Lee
description: Since he was a boy, Morgan has always been known to adapt to his surroundings quicker than normal. It hasn’t been known that he is an Abnormal until his teens when he tried out for football and after watching the other guys training, he quickly was able to beat them at every training session, and the same was for other sports even going as far as going professional when he turned 18. However because of his abnormality, Morgan was disqualified and dismissed and has since been called Chameleon because of his adaptability. He would later Yukashi and become a member of the Kiakashi Clan using his abilities to fight the Bounty Hunters.

name: Yukashi Kiakashi
description: Leader of the Kiakashi Clan, Yukashi has since said that his sole purpose was to create honor and peace amongst all lands. He since made it his mission to rid the world of wrong doers regardless of their code of conduct believing peace is deserve amongst all. His honor code has since been the main reason why many people tests his skills believing that they could take his crown as the Clan King and become a powerful Wakashi clan ruler like himself and his ancestors.

name: The Kiakashi Clan
description:
Age: Varies

A legion of powerful sword fighters, these ancient beings over time have gain mystical abilities such as controlling the aspects of their home lands. This ranged from magically growing crops, creating machinery from plants and trees, gaining enhanced strength from the air around their homelands, and creating powerful spells. The Kiakashi Clan is the direct ancesteral neighbors to the Wakashi Clan and often shared similarities when they were alive. Now the Kiakashi ancesteral members live in a astral existence cloaked by their abilities, sending their knowledge to others who share their honor code.

name: Giundo
description:
Age: Varies

Small elfish beings that once served under the power of the Kiakashi Clan members. However after the ancestors disappeared to the Astral Plane, the Giundo separated across the world with some appearing throughout Elite Comics as servents to many other characters. Because they are branded by the mark of loyalty, the Giundo are loyal until death of their masters and will only serve someone if they feel the particular individual is worth their loyality. The Giundo are mostly found serving at the three schools of the Elite Comics universe, Anura, Hizirinith, and Tantirith.
abilities: Enhanced Agility; Longevity; Strength; Flight; Intelligence; Teleportation

name: Rika Simmons
description: The wild child of the group, growing up a stripper since her 18th birthday, Rika has always been wild and out of control and since she doesn’t know of her parents existence she has no reason to care about much or anyone. Rika adopted the name Butterfly Girl after showcasing her butterfly like wings and rainbow like light powers. She joined the Kiakashi Clan out of fun but has since gotten stricter on her missions.
abilities: Butterfly like wings; Rainbow light that can blind others

name: Roz Wizum
description: Roz joined the Kiakashi Clan in an effort to better his fighting skills after mostly being bullied throughout his life; he was accepted on the fact that he has the abilities to stun others with one single touch. Roz by mistake has since paralyzed over 30 people throughout his youth. It is said that Roz can paralyze others by touching them for to long and even kill them if he touches their internal parts even for just a moment.

name: John Batize
description: John is the newest member to the Kiakashi Clan and has since been a viable member of the group because of his enhanced strength. Being called the group’s muscle, John is also the group’s scientist often taken on numerous tasks at once including building viable weapons to defeat his enemies. He once worked with Valken in an attempt to defeat Anubis and Montum.
abilities: Beast like body; Enhanced strength; Speed; Metal claws

name: Gale Bolken
description: While working with the Bounty Hunters, Gale took on the name The Moniker became she was the team’s strength and often public figure because of her human disquise as a politician. Gale learned of the bounty Hunters plans to destroy an innocent village for their weapons and money, at this point, Gale used her abilities to stop them thus being expelled from the group. Shortly after, Gale became a prime member and again strength and public eye for the Kiakashi Clan, serving to stop the bounty hunters at all cause.
abilities: Steel Body; Enhanced strength; Enhanced eyesight; Enhanced smell; Radiation like bolts from hands

name: Jarold Mi-high
description:
Abilities: Can turn body into durable liquiod that provides him enhanced strength; Can extend body to unknown lengths when in liquiod form

Recently uknown, Jarold’s identity has been a mystery because of his strouded past and hidden face. He would later share his life with Gale Bolken in an attempt to get her help to defeat the bounty hunters. In their joint attempt, they fought the bounty hunters at almost every heist. Their efforts to stop the Bounty Hunters, is the reason that they were allowed to join the Kiakashi Clan, regardless of their pasts.

name: Prince Kyemel
description:
Age: 25 (Part two of story, 35)

Future king to the Elitshian Empire. Arrogant yet with a fierce loyal presence, Prince Kyemel respected his father’s rule over the Elitshian Empire, but doubted his abilities in his later life. Threating to overthrow his father at his mischievous’ grandfather’s command. Kyemel set out on an incredible adventure, learning of his family’s kingdom through the eyes of its people to learn from them. During his findings he finds the love of his life, Ishyani and her love for pottery which she teaches him. It grows into a hidden power of creation he didn’t know he had.

name: Prince Nero
description: Brother of Prince Kyemel and next in line after his older brother reign. Plotting with his brother to overthrow his father, Nero, to his namesake learns about his ability to enter dimensions and directing its energy into powerful weapons. He is the lead general of the Elitshian Empire, much like his brother, he is arrogant, loyal, and very impatient.

name: Princess Aerin
description: Aerin, the loyal daughter to King Koshmel and sister to Prince Kyemel and Prince Nero. Aerin is a dutiful soldier and has armor and weapons that allows her to run very fast. Her latent abilities allow to her move faster than previously thought and the armor was restricting her movements and potential. Knowledge given to her by her mother Queen Malaysia. This drove her to help overthrow and eventually kill her father.
abilities: Can run the Speed of Light; Teleportation; Time travel; Speed Sound Burst

name: Queen Malaysia
description: Queen Malaysia is a powerful and very important figure found within the Elitshian history. She was regarded as a proud figure and noblewoman that often wondered amongst her people and provided them with food, water, and clothing. She was blessed by the gods and given their knowledge. One of those gifts was the power to control nature at great control, making her the on-Earth avatar of Santiyline. Her godlike abilities were passed onto her children. She was so loved that her named was used as the name of the now Asian country.
abilities: Enhanced power over nature; Plant life

name: King Barbados
description: Powerful figure seen as one of Elitshia’s greatest rulers, that is until he began to ruin the country with an iron fist in his later years. Believing that he was possessed by dark forces, causing his changing behavior, his family agreed to overthrow him. This turned into a deadly war, destroying half the kingdom, and causing the first fall of Elitshia. By these mysterious forces, King Barbados received the power to control shadows. Barbados lends its name from the almighty king.

name: Zalrack
description: Zalrack was the high priest of the Elisthian Empire. He often spoke to the king and when the king’s reign ended, he became the high priest to Prince (later King) Kyemel. He has a staff that talks to him, rather its speaking or the shadows of King Barbados has always been up to debate.
abilities: Staff cable of manipulating shadows; Light

name: Princess Nahjia
description: Princess Nahjia is daughter to King Kyemel and very curious of the world around her kingdom. Because of her status as princess, she unable to leave the kingdom’s walls. Even to venture around the kingdom itself, she must be heavily guarded and escorted. She has numerous friends and goes on secret adventures, until one evening she unearths her family’s secrets and becomes the destined warrior.
abilities: Enhanced strength; Speed; Sight; Hearing; Can teleport at night; Powerful magical abilities

name: Lola
description: Friend of Princess Nahjia and loyal servant. She is the princess’ confidant and eager partner in her journeys. She has never left the kingdom’s walls until she followed Nahjia into the Forbidden Lands.

name: Jinnason “Jin”
description: Friend of Princess Nahjia and Lola. Jinnason “Jin” is a curious minded boy and loves “modern” technology, often inventing in the absence of his parents. His family used mysterious minerals to build Zalrack’s staff when Zalrack was a young man. He also built the armor that Nahjia uses later in life to lead her army against invaders.

name: Genyer’
description:
Note: pronounced Jinyear

A banished king that ruled Atlantis before he attempted to enslave its people to build powerful weapons. Genyer’ is a strong and brute man with powerful weapons at his disposal. Believing that the two kingdoms should join forces to rule the world, Genyer’ fought with King Barbados and later his son King Kyemel to take over and enslave the people of the Elitshian Empire.

name: Leoshin
description:
Abilities: Can create a sand army using mysterious minerals

Banished cousin of the royal siblings. He was banished because of wanting the power the kingdom with unknown minerals found within the Forbidden Lands. These minerals would later be used by him to create an army that would nearly destroy Elitshia. He returned to assist Genyer’ to enslave and take over the kingdom.

name: Dayious
description: Cousin of Princess Nahjia and son of Prince Nero. Dayious is a smart boy with a love for astrology, often reading about discoveries that there are gates on different worlds that connect the worlds together. He discovered a gate on the edge of Elithsia, which causes the Elitshian Empire in later years to learn about the world around them and visitors that often come to their world.

name: Kinokitans
description: A group of ingenious people who were believed to be the original inhabitants of the world before mankind got smarter and rose up to existence with various forms of advancements. They have lived in the shadows and has evolved only to speak and stand upright. Their various forms of advancements have been their quick adjustments to their environments.

name: Kinokitans or The Lizard People
description:
Age: Varies

Descendants of the original civilization of beings that existed before the human became prominent on Earth. It is believed that without the gods knowledge, the Kinokitans as they are originally known amongst their own kind found a gateway from another world onto Earth and has since lived underground with some on hidden islands throughout Earth, the Kinokitans are said to be immune to psychic attacks and from the power of the gods. How this came to be is still unknown.
abilities: Lizard like appearances; Acid slime around body; Spit; Can stick to any surface; Extending tail

name: Lazarons
description: Drawing their powers from the Kenoxes, the Lazarons are the most prominent members of the magical world. Their legend started thousands of years ago when the Kenoxes was given to their family to protect. Since then they have drawn from it to make themselves the most powerful coven of supernatural beings in the magical existence.

name: Kayla Lazaron
description:
Age: 19 (chapter 3) 22

Kenya unlike her siblings was aware of her abilities and destiny during an early age because of her foster family being wiccans in the making. Kenya received a message stating that the key to her ancestry and unlocking her true abilities to was located at an old, abandoned warehouse which appears on the outside as burned down until she and her lost siblings open the Book of Magic found in the basement. From this moment, she started to realize that the Kendo & Kain are her little brothers and that with their joined powers; they were the Lazarons, a legendary group of powerful Sondreds. Her abilities started out with the power to see the past, then the world around her, and shortly after the future just by touching things, looking at something, and being in a certain area. Later her abilities would manifest into the ability to create magnetic fields of energy, throw those energy fields in the form of balls of energy, and to create a magnetic shock to the mind. In the future, it is visioned that she would be a teacher at Anura and at a very old age, she would become the headmistress because of her leadership.
affiliates: The Lazarons; Kanos; Teacher at Anura; Lazarons
abilities: Premonitions; Magnetic fields; Mind energy blasts

name: Kain Lazaron
description:
Age: 15 (chapter 3) 19

Kain was only 3 when he froze his first object, this alerted his foster parents, and they later gave him back up to the foster care system. Kain unlike his siblings grew up without a family of any sort and mostly stole things. Although he forgot about his abilities because they never reappeared after he was placed back into the foster care system. It is also shown that he lost the memory of why he was placed back into the foster care system, although this memory is gained back once he meets his siblings. Kain was foretold by his sister, Kenya, that he is destined to replace Sheknurd as the future God of Time. Overtime, Kain managed to speed up the molecules around him, which in return, allowed him to blow things up. His abilities grewagainthis time in combination with his first two abilities, Kain could now warp time and travel throughout time but only to certain major events, this overtime changed as he tapped into the power of the God of Time which was past down from his great-great uncle Shecknurd. Although this ablity was rarely used in his battles with the Belki and other dark creatures, it has been shown in conjunction with his magical abilities to close the Time Gate.
affiliates: The Lazarons; Kanos; the Time Gate; Lazarons
abilities: Molecule Mobilization; Molecule Combustion; Time Field; Manipulation of Time; Time Travel

name: Kendo Lazaron
description:
Age: 17 (chapter 3) 21

Able to move things with his mind when he was still in his mother’s womb, Kendo showed to be the most powerful and the most wrathful of his siblings. For his vast knowledge and quick learning his parents named him after Kylie’s father who also resembled Kendo L. Throughout chapter 1 Kendo like his siblings was separated after his mother was token away by the Sondred Council for giving birth to demi-gods which was forbidden since gods and Sondreds were always enemies. Kendo found out about his siblings and family through a letter telling him to come to an abandon house to find out about his family and his abilities. Kendo with his siblings unlocked their true personalities and abilities while opening the Book of Magic. The spell that unlocked the Book of Magic caused the old run down house to return to its prime and awaken the Kenoxes. Kendo’s abilities grow faster than his siblings because he was born on the Kenoxes and because unlike their’s, his abilities is caused by anger. At first he can only move small objects, however quickly he learns to move people and bigger objects even going as far as lifting cars and houses when in a dream state. He learns to teleport himself and later other people and objects and later can multiply himself and later given each multiplication its own telekinetic ability. In the future, Kenya predicted that Kendo would learn how to use the power of thunder like their father Kanos and would join the Thunder Riders.
affiliates: The Lazarons; Kanos; Thunder Riders; Lazarons

name: Kora Shouts - Lazaron
description:
Age: 15 (chapter 4) 18

Exhibiting powers at a young age, Kora Shouts, showed that she was a very powerful sorceress when she first made pipes burst around her town and flowing waters from sinks that nearly flooded her high school. She appeared three years after her siblings reunited under one roof and first met Kenya while playing with friends in a park when a Belki tried to capture her. Kenya touched Kora and the two were magically linked. Believing her to be a young sorcerer, Kenya took Kora back to her home where the house shook in awakening of her arrival. This made the Lazaron family question who she was and the fate of their meeting her. Rain began to fall hard when Kora’s eyes glowed a bright blue. The family knew that they were being linked magically but didn’t know why. While being attacked, the family went to the book of Magic to read a spell to vanquish the Belki. When all four touched the book all evil in the house was vanquished without even a single spell being spoken. This broke the original bound by the High council and the Gods that the children are not to be allowed to be together or not see their parents. Out of white light Kylie and Kanos appeared to greet their child while Kora met her mother for the first time., their png attacked, the family went to the book of Magic to read a spell to vanquish the Belki. When all four touc

name: Kylie Lazaron
description: Once a very powerful warrior herself, she met Kanos while traveling throughout the Magical Market Place. At the marketplace, the two fought several Belki whom wanted to use the marketplace as a demonic trading zone because of its proximity to the many different outlets of the magical world. Kylie and Kanos fell instantly in love afterwards and the two had their first child nearly six years later. Kylie has the power over water and passed it down to her youngest daughter. During the birth of Kain their third child, both the Royal Circa and the Sondred Council foretold both the saviors of the worlds and to strong to be stopped if turned evil. So both set of entities forbid their alliance and forced both Kylie & Kanos to be separated and forced the children to be split up between homes. However this alliance was reunited when both a god and Sondred broke the rules and sent letters to Kenya, Kain, & Kendo to reunite at the home of which they lived before being split up. Kylie and Kanos met up toward the end of Chapter 1 of the Lazaron Saga. While Kylie was broken up from Kanos, she met Allon Shout, a Domaedian whom she met while saving a innocent young Sondred from a demon attack. She and Allon gave birth to Kara who she passed down her power over water. Like before, the High Council forbid the arrangement until Kara met her siblings and the four touched the Book of Magic at the same time, this broke the counsils forbidden notation and Kylie was allowed to live with her children. Allon Shouts returned to Helliholm watching over Kylie & Kara while Kanos returned to Kylie and his children in late Chaper 3.

name: Jane Debrew
description:
Abilities: Geological manipulation via seismic wave generation from his hands

Age: 16 (chapter 70) 26

Jane was the daughter of the first Prisoner but traveled to the very far future in order to get enough help or powers to save her village from destruction. She appears throughout chapter 2 and befriends Kain but is unable to admit her feelings because she has to leave to return after finding what she was looking for. She only appears for chapter 2. In Chapter 70, Jane is all grown up and has full control over her abilities.

name: Zack Meekes
description:
Age: 24 (chapter 74) 28

Zack traveled from the future assisting in the process of saving the Lazarons from a great threat not to reveal to them that they are the great threat. He later shows them that he is their grandchildren’s close friend and wishes to save the future by stopping them at any cost. He appears throughout chapter 4 and is later revealed to be the grandchild of Kenya's son, Kanon. In Chapter 74 alongside the other Young Gods, Zack help defeat the gods.

name: Allon Shouts
description:
Age: 38 (human form)

Allon appears throughout chapter 2 as the father to Kara and ex-fiancé to Kylie who fell in love with Kylie while separated from Kanos. After their alliance has grown into a romance, the Gods forbid it and forced them to separate. When they denied this ordeal, Allon was banished to Earth without his abilities forced to live his immortality out alone and on a farm. In return Kylie had to give up her daughter or have dire consequences emerge. He was found by a Domaedian who was injured and after successfully getting his powers back he became a Domaedian again and never seen again to only appear in visions.
abilities: Telepathy; Teleportation; Sensing; Magical Spells; Protective Forcefields

name: Kanon Lazaron
description:
Age: 17 (chapter 5) 19

Kanon is five years old at the beginning of chapter 3 as everything has been fast forward five years in the absence of Kentos' coma. From his birth he experienced massive amounts of power probably because of his mixed heritage. His powers include but not limited to Telekinesis, power over earth, air, fire, and water. He can read minds, swap bodies and minds, control people and objects, projection, powerful explosive powers and the ability to vanquish evil by blinking. He is prophesied to have been the Hybrid God that was born of angel blood. One day it is said that he would rise up and conquer the magical world and rid all things from evil.
abilities: Limitless magical abilities; Telekinesis; Power over air; Water; Fire; Projection

name: Tilen Arnols
description:
Age: 21 (chapter 5) 22

Although his past is a secret, Tilen remembers that he once was able to speak to the shadows and control them at will. Whenever he sleeps they sing to him and protect him while he is fighting. Once when he was young, Tilen was sick and a shadow in the form of his deceased mother healed him and gave him the ability to control others like itself. Although he isn’t a Lazaron he often helps them in battles throughout chapter 4. He learns how to use regular magic throughout chapter 5.
abilities: Power over shadows; Magical spells; Flight

name: Dagan
description: During the final years of Elitshia, Dagan was servant to the royal family and was concealed inside a book to forever carry the image and history of Elitshia and its race forever. However once he was released by mistake in chapter 3, he returns to life but this time in a lesser form then in his grand state. It is later mentioned that he was a powerful wizard.

name: Samantha Reed
description: During her teenage years, Samantha figured out that she could control the power over fire after great outburst. Until chapter 4 she wasn’t able to control her abilities. Throughout chapter 4 she learns the abilities of Air bending, Water, & power over the Earth. On issue one of chapter 4 it is told that she woke up in a dessert before arriving at Tantirith and that she at one time wanted to become a teacher at UCLA. Her parents are finally seen in chapter 4 after being killed while she was graduating from high school.
abilities: Power over the elements; Ice; Advance magic; Flight

name: Brenten West
description: At the age of 4, Brenten was able to configure his first car and build his first super computer allowing his parents to enter him in challenges of the brain throughout his life. At age 14 he graduated from high school and graduated from college two years later. By age 21 he was admitted in the Guinness Book of World Records as the smartest person and later called the descendant of Albert Einstein. He is able to read minds and later control them in chapter 4. He also is able to feel others emotions for a moment in mid-chapter 5.
abilities: Telekinesis; Telepathy; Premonition; Brain Shock; Advance Magic; Flight

name: Owen Pents
description: When he was 10 years old, Owen’s parents died and he was left to live with his rich aunt whom collected sculptures and millions of imported books. After he graduated from college at the age of 21, Owen’s aunt died of cancer and left her fortune to him. But after finding himself awake at Tantirith, he awakes to new friends. He often uses his limitless funds and estate to get him and the other Prisoner’s resources to fight evil. One of his biggest passions is the guitar, singing, & fighting. He is also a skilled swordsman.
abilities: Power over the weather; Advance magic; Weather control; Flight; Sensing

name: Lavexian Wilson
description: An often mechanic and trouble maker, Lavexian was born of a scholar and a lawyer living in Manhattan. After he graduated from high school, he left to pursue college but decided to leave to travel the world. He is an avid reader of comic books, supernatural, and action films. His passion besides fixing things is the fictional world that he comes accustom to reading. After finding out about his abilities, Lavexian learns how to use them and advance his abilities a lot quicker then any other Prisoner in history of magic. In chapter 4, his powers advance to the point where he cans Time Travel which helps Elite Force a great deal in fighting dark forces. He also is one of the only people who can understand almost any language however he doesn’t know how he is able to accomplish this until he looks onto a book.
abilities: Power over time; Teleportation; Advance magic; Flight; Molecule Combustion; Time Travel

name: Catherine Hodkins
description: Once she lived with an abusive boyfriend whom she left for college but found herself alone and homeless. When she arrived in California, she befriends Kenya and begins working at the Flower Shop and becoming her assistant. On her 23 birthday, Kenya finds out that whenever Catherine is happy flowers bloom and comes back to life after death and that when she’s angry flowers and plant life dies near her. It is also told that she is descendant and true daughter of Mother Nature, Santiyline. Although she appears mostly toward mid-chapter 3 assisting the Lazarons, she doesn’t join the other members of The New Alliance until chapter 4.
abilities: Power over nature; Turn others into stone; Flight; Advance magic; Speak to animals; Alien species

name: Mr. Kendrick HInes
description: During the early 18th century he was chosen as the librarian of a very well known magical library and the biggest in the world hidden from human eyes in Tantirith. He would guide and protect future magical beings in the request of the High Council. In the issue he was a previous member of the New Alliance that lost his memory and resided as a teacher at Kayla & Kendo’s high school. While on a field trip to the museum, Kondrick found out that he can turn objects to stone. Later in Chapter 4 he would loose his memory again and to live the rest of his life out continuing his teaching at Tantirith.

name: Prince Rocknick
description: Made prince after his parents ascended to becoming Domaedians. He was appointed prince of all magic wielding the Staff of Power in which protects him and gives him magic that existed before the magical world’s creation. He is good nor evil and serves sometimes as both as his only priority is to contain ultimate power and hates others that threaten his authority of being the all powerful such as Zon once did and then the Lazarons after him. He is Zon’s biggest rival next to Belckus.

name: Vanessa Arnold
description:
Age: 19 (chapter 4) 276 years old

Powerful but young firestarter with little knowledge of her past. She was saved by a spirit that claimed to be her brother in whom she killed while a child, by accident. Until her 19 birth date she was unable control her ability. She was founded by Kylie while at a magic convention in LA when Vanessa started a fire while fighting over a water medallion. She would join Kylie & Kanos during their journeys becoming the first members of the New Alliance until becoming lead after Kylie’s departure. She was at Kylie & Kanos’s wedding and watches over the New Alliance (new members) at times.

name: Hoj Benjamin
description:
Age: 18 (chapter 4) 221 years old

Able to read minds, enter dreams, and create objects out of his mind, he was sought out by millions of demons before being found by Kylie & Vanessa in the chapter 3 side-story and again before appearing in late chapter 4. He was able to stop an army of powerful Dager Demons before entering the human world by creating a miniature black hole which from this he became the most powerful Abnormal on earth next to Zon which in reality isn’t a Abnormal.

name: Kora Lazaron
description: Although she is the only character of the Lazaron Legacy arc that appears regularly throughout the six chapters she never truly fight her own battles but assist others in the process. She came close into being vanquished but was saved by Montum upon his arrival on chapter 3. Kora is the eldest sister to Kylie turned evil by Montum to be his Seer and she showcase how powerful she really is when fighting the New Alliance. She is the aunt of the Lazaron siblings & main opponent to the New Alliance.

name: Garnia
description: Female succubus that often falls for powerful and beautiful beings with her first being Zon until his turn of mind to the good side. She was vanquished by a pregnant, Kenya on issue 17 of chapter 2. Before 22her vanquish, she fought many teams found throughout Elite Force Comics universe including Elite Force.

name: Tontolius
description: Second demon to appear as a wizard like sandman that could appear facial in the winds, he creates giant windstorms made up rocks and sand. He is vanquished during issue 20 of chapter 2 while communicating with Belckus. Like other demons, before his vanquish, Tontolius fought many teams throughout Elite Comics universe including Elite Force.
abilities: Able to transform into; Control a malleable sand form

name: Reding
description: A powerful chief of demons that is often considered Zon’s brother turn completely dark by black magic. He is ninth powerful in HELL next to Belckus and to Zon. He is Zon’s second biggest rival after the prince of all magic. He is vanquished after issue 25 chapter 2. He fought many teams throughout Elite Force Comics universe before his vanquish including the X-Team.
abilities: Abnormal strength; Endurance; Durability; Resilience Personal gravity field

name: Mactis
description:
Abilities: Ability to expel gusts of air from lungs

Lizard demon with acid like abilities and controller of the swamps, vanquished by Kara & Jane during issue 16 of chapter 2.
abilities: Abnormal leg; Tongue strength; Endurance; Agility; Reflexes; Coordination; Balance; Leaping ability; Regenerative healing factor; Can stick to walls; Elongated prehensile tongue; Psychoactive venom secretion; Paralyzing mucus secretion; Adhesive spit; Can communicate with amphibious life

name: Carlande
description: She is a sweet but deadly witch that causes great destruction throughout chapter 3, she appears as sometimes a young girl or teenager with little knowledge of either version showing she may be magically schizophrenic.

name: Monique Summers
description:
Abilities: Shapeshifting Abnormal agility Ageless[2] Healing factor Skilled combatant Master Strategist

Monique was childhood friend to Kenya until her parents moved to France for her father’s job. Amid her return to Elite City to visit Kenya, she finds Kenya and her siblings to have age while she hasn’t. Abandoning her notion to revive her friendship with Kenya, Monique leaves traveling Elite City stopping those that work against those who have Abnormal abilities. She for a short time joins The New Alliance to defeat her enemies, however after they are defeated she turns on the New Alliance and several times tries to destroy them and take their magical book. In an alternate reality she fights Elite Force by creating a dark version of them unleashing them onto the regular timeline.
affiliates: The New Alliance; Dark Prisoners; Lazarons

name: Light Feeders
description: Demonic entities that feed off of light and attacks angels on sight. They come in various forms and can be found in numerous situations. They are prominent members of the society of demons known as the Belki.

name: Grim
description: A cloaked demon with several eyes under his garments that are ever watching. His main goal was to please Belkus and is one of the many minions that serve to free him. He believes he will be awarded by helping Soltice in breaking the other temples around the world. Along with Soltice, the two assists other demons like Umbrin although their stories rarely connect.

name: Barrick Dines
description: One of the demonic lords of Hell, Soltice as he is called by his subjects and foes, is one of the first demons to come through the broken temple in Europe. He led an army on earth and with this he countered those that oppose him and his minions called the Shadowrunners.

name: Magnetic Woman & Magnetic Man
description: Possessing the powers to push and pull forces magnetically. They are not affiliated with one another and possesses little knowledge of each other.

name: Debbie Olks
description: Debbie Olks was destined to find her true love soon, traveling to exotic places and even going as far as going to fortune tellers all to see who she will fall in love with. One day Debbie got so desperate that she met with a powerful witch that promised her that she could find the Lost Treasure of Atlantis by the end of the following year she would grant Debbie her wish of finding true love. Along her search, Debbie found out about her abilities to attract objects through a form of Magnetic charge.

name: Jacob Marge
description: Using his influences to travel to Paris, France looking for his true love. Jacob Marge was determined to find his true love one way or another and that he would go to any length to do so. While in Spain, Jacob would discover his abilities to push anything away from his body through a positive charge of magnetic energy. He met a powerful witch while in Spain and was offered his true love if he could help her find a special artifact called the Lost Treasure of Mu’.

name: Mask of the Undead
description: Two unfortunate souls bound together by their familiar circumstances. The two have bought together their shared desires to rid themselves of their inherent destinies through any means possible.

name: Olivia Watson “Ghost Girl”
description: Born to John & Wilma Watson, both sharing similar abilities, Olivia like her ancestors were cursed with powers that allows her to live forever and communicate with the dead. Unlike other members of her family, Olivia manages to defeat the Black Crone, thus relinquishing her from the spell. At this point Olivia joined Elite Force for a short moment until realizing she would never truly be alive and later joining a elite group known as the Mask of the Undead. From this point she used her abilities to take over the group and lead them against the undead army of Montum. While dead for a short while, Olivia is able to travel freely between heaven & hell without harm and can travel back to the land of the living whenever she wishes.
affiliates: Elite Force; Mask of the Undead
abilities: Transparency; Telepathy amongst the dead; Limited control over the dead; Teleportation; Hovering above ground; Control of victims; Immortality

name: Janice
description: Daughter to Zane and a demon named O’bur Alvia, Janice inherited many of her father’s abilities including his fast healing natural ability. Janice was born on an island in the Underworld and was raised as an orphan to a meta-human couple doomed for eternity to be bound to each other by unbreakable chains at the edge of the living and the edge of the Underworld. During her teenage years, Janice met up with Elite Force while fighting the demon Vallah, she killed Vallah to only be equally matched by Vallah’s true demonic form. Shortly after slaying the demon, Janice became a member of Elite Force, later learning of Zane being her father. Outrage that he left her in such a evil place, she fought him, nearly matching his fighting skills to only be defeated by him in the end. Janice left the group to join the Mask of the Undead after returning the Underworld.
affiliates: Mask of the Undead; Elite Force
abilities: Fast healing factor; Great strength; Acrobatic fighting skills; Telepathy; Force fields; Energy blasts

name: Soloman Hollard
description: Soloman Hollard was one of the reasons why the Shadow Stalkers disbanded. During one of their missions, Soloman also known as Shadow Man became angry that they were saving humans when humanity hated them and wanting Descendants dead. Soloman created a plan that his team turn against humanity and join the ranks of the Mastermind Crew. After their final battle, the Shadow Stalkers disbanded with Sanctrum & Shadow Man joining the Mastermind Crew.

name: Zilda Omedge
description: Zilda was never an official member of the Shadow Stalkers because of her thought to destroy her old city. During her youth, Zilda fell for a boy that she thought loved her until she caught the boy kissing another girl. Her anger caused her abilities to come active which ironically is the power to kiss someone causing their immediate death or a slight kiss can cause sickness. Zilda joined the Shadow Stalkers in rage hoping to cover up her true intentions.

name: Jon Ricks
description: Because of his unusual appearance, Jon Ricks’ parents sent him to the harbor of Castle Town where he would be treated and studied. For this cruelty and fueled with anger, Jon escaped and was later wiped away on a nearby island by several Merlantians or Descendants of the sea by nearby city folk. Away in Merlantis, Jon took on the name of Creok and was taught how to talk to fish, control water, and swim faster than anything. In some stories he is considered King of Merlantis and husband of its queen, Nophia.
abilities: Aquakinesis; Ability to talk to fish; Great speed; Strength

name: Nophia
description: Born in a beautiful city located at the bottom of the Pacific Ocean, Nophia’s ancestors built a city of gold and silver and protected by the fish that lived nearby. Nophia and her family ruled the city for centuries and uses her power over the ocean to keep everyone in line and protect from harm. While above ground, Nophia met Jon Ricks and quickly fell for him even following him on adventures across the world. The two married in front of her people and even the Water gods and was given the name Merlantia.
abilities: Ability to control animals; Nature; Aquakinesis; Enhanced strength; Speed

name: Missy Cornor
description: Missy Cornor was born in Merlantis and served to protect Merlantia. During one of her missions to guard the front gates, Missy also known as the Sea Chaser would be confronted by a powerful sea dragon and would learn of her abilities to control the oceans by subtracting negative energy from creatures around her.
abilities: Uses Negative energy to control water

name: Debra Collins
description: Born to an engineerer, Debra Collins wasn’t a stranger to fixing things, when she enrolled at SAA she served as its lead technician going as far as fixing Elite Force Jet on several missions. Debra first distributed her abilities to detect other Descendants when she was 18 and she knew that a nearby student was like her and she tried to make friends with him, it turned out that the boy didn’t wish the same thing and turned on her. The two would later meet as members of a group of vigilantes named the Midnight Warriors who mostly do their fighting at night.
abilities: Psionic detection of mutants; Astral projection/electro-transitional state

name: Victor Nighten
description: Victor was creator of the Midnight Warriors, he bought forth a debate of how Descendants should live when he was apart of the Congress. This caused him to be expelled thus creating his own group of Descendants that would fight for Abnormal and mutant rights. He called the group the Midnight Warriors and first inducted The Drainer as his leading lady.

name: Gallen Reif
description: Gallen Reif first met Debra Collins while in high school, he was a sophomore while she was about to graduate, unfamiliar with his abilities at the time, he didn’t take on her presence very well and shouted out to the school that she was a Abnormal causing a panic attack throughout the building. He would later meet her again at the age of 22 as apart of the team Midnight Warriors and he exchange his apologies with her.
abilities: Razorsharp claws; Fangs; Abnormal senses; Strength; Speed; Agility; Reflexes; Coordination; Endurance; Invulnerability; Resistant to life draining

name: Sarrah Jessica
description: Sarrah Jessica was a beautiful girl growing up; she has porcelain skin and looked as if she was a walking life sized doll. Dressed to impress, Sarrah was skilled at modeling and walking the runway, she could talk her way out of any situation. However as she grew older her abilities and mutant like abilities begin to show itself. Now she had beautiful purple skin and green eyes and contained the abilities to drain life forces substaining immortality and strength.
abilities: Ability to create life-force draining fire; Energy whips; Life-draining gives her Abnormal healing; Immortality; Strength

name: Emily Zack
description: Capable of creating red themed storms anywhere she pleases, Emily died during battle and was trapped in Onur by Montum and her soul was taken away by Soulman. Emily was revived as part of the Negative Fighters and is under the complete control of Montum.
abilities: Controls the weather; Can manipulate weather patterns

name: Jeth Rhodes
description:
Abilities: Can manipulate wind to create miniature blackholes

After being found floating near death into Eternity by Soulman, Jeth’s soul was given to Montum however over time he would become Montum’s soldier in hopes to destroy the land of the living and to take it over in the honor of Montum’s order. Jeth became Spiral because of his ability to create spiral like attacks made of wind and acts like a blackhole. Spiral often leads Montum’s team of villians known as the Negative Fighters to attack protectors of mankind.

name: Jackson Hield
description: A beefy man with long green and black spikey hair, he has a demonic attitude and appearance and is one of the strongest fighters amongst the members of the Negative Fighters. His reddish body and the spikes coming from his arms and back can be used as attacks, it is said that when in life, he was a bully who died unexpected, his persona continues in in the afterlife as one of Montum’s soldiers.
abilities: Superhuman strength; Reddish skin is hot as lava; Spikes that can break through anything; Endurance

name: Lizer Benjamin
description: Lizer Benjamin died in the late 1700s, however up until his death he was a servant to Montum and has since been his loyal servant after death serving as member to the Negative Fighters at various points throughout his afterlife. While in life, he stole things from various places for Montum that otherwise the deity couldn’t enter because of spells, charms, etc. Such items include the Chalice of Life which was buried in a destroyed monastery on hollow ground. While not traveling with the group, he often goes on his own separate journeys such as robbing several banks throughout several cities. He is by far the oldest member of the Negative Fighters.
abilities: Transparent configuration; Intangibility; Superhuman strength; Lazer beams from eyes; Enhanced agility

name: Ark Imit
description: Ark is a proud Filipino Chinese hero that found out about his abilities after saving a bus from steering off the I-191 in Elitshia. His powers granted him powers like some of his favorite heroes and since has adopted their public ideals to save the world from danger. He is often the de facto leader of the New Society of Heroes.
abilities: Lazer Eyes; Super strength; Flight; Ice breath; Enhanced agility; Impenetrable skin

name: Nan Imit
description: Father of Elite Boy, he was a proud hero that primarily was stationed in the Filipinos.  He originated from Saiyu and when under our sun, he has enhanced abilities and is considered a Descendant because of her enhanced powers compared to humans. He disappeared after a war on Earth in 2009, causing his son to take up the mantle to search for him.
abilities: Lazer Eyes; Super strength; Flight; Ice breath; Enhanced agility; Impenetrable skin

name: Mika Hues
description: Snarky, impulsive, daring, and intelligent. Mika Hues is a proud Brazilian hero that carries her culture with her and shows throughout her fighting styles and clothing. Her powers are often seen as a direct comparison of her ancestors who are great warriors, the Wareins. She is often seen fighting alongside Ark and the New Society of Heroes when she isn’t at home protecting it from villains.
abilities: Enhanced Strength; Enhanced sight; Speed; Impenetrable skin; Unbreakable armor; Demon trapping sword

name: Kendrick Lazaron
description: One of the fastest people in the world, Blaze is quick on his feet, the funny guy in the group, and has often manipulated time travel because he can run as fast as sound and later in life, as fast as light. He is often the enemy of the Time Lords and Time Pirates. He is son of Kain Lazaron and is unaware of his father’s history and status as the God of Time. He just believes, Kain abandon his family when he was younger, unaware that Kain watches every part of his life.
abilities: Supersonic Speed; Enhanced sight; Hearing; Limited time travel

name: Jessie Rains
description: One of the daughters to the nymph Aqua. Jessie is half human and half nymph and a great swimmer. Capable of manipulating water, speaking to aquatic lifeforms both on Earth and elsewhere, and enhanced speed & strength. Jessie is the newest member to the team and often follows Blaze as she has a crush on him. She is often seen in her own separate stories and can be known for her often meet with the Mermadic Kingdom.
abilities: Aquakinesis; Capable of speak with Aquatic lifeforms; Enhanced sight; Speed; Strength; Long life

name: Zazie Olmoroth Embrem
description:
Age: 17 (159 years old on Nataya)

A Natayan that left her world out of curiosity to see Earth and its people. She became stuck here and often dream of returning to her world. Because of her appearance, she often hides it by shapeshifting which she developed after the ability disappeared from her people almost 2,000 years ago. She joined the New Society of Heroes and is often their center of hope and love.
abilities: Shapeshifting; Enhanced speed; Hearing; Flight; Immortality; Healing; Lazer eyes

name: Eilan Commorage
description:
Abilities: Super suit that can fire laser beams

An inventor that has already at the age of 15 won a noble prize for inventing a machine that grants anyone enhanced abilities. They built an armor that resembles one of favorite heroes to join the New Society of Heroes. After successfully joining the team, Eilan became the team’s technical support and built many of their armor and weapons. They also assist in the field whenever they are able. Because they are bound to a wheelchair, Eilan’s super suit allows them to walk, run, and fly.
abilities: Flight; Super strength; Heal wombs; Supercomputer attach to the suit; Enhanced speed; Sight

name: Aida Numera
description: Friend to Stardust from the stories Lightning Stardust, Aida moved to Elitshia to find her lost brother who later became Mute. Aida is part android and part human with the android part of her body being replacements after finding mystic objects that attached themselves to her. This allowed Aida to gain great control over the mystic world and conjure incredible mounts of magic. Aida became Mystic Force and joined the New Society of Heroes on some of their missions.
abilities: Mystic Powers; Immortality; Can phase through solid objects

name: Frank Johnson
description: Often feeling left out because of his lack of abilities, Frank created a shield with the help of Eilan his classmate from unbreakable minerals. Those same minerals also are used in his sword, armor, and later his vehicles. He is intelligent and aims to find a cure for Eilan his bestfriend. He died on one of his missions and were brought back to life by Aida, the two would fall in love and in the future birth two powerful children.
abilities: Human with indestructible armor; Shield; Sword; Granting enhanced strength; Invulnerability; Peak human appearance

name: Robin Riverson
description: Daughter of The Electrician, after seeing old footage of their father being a hero and his fall at the hands of Molecule. Robin like her brother Richard became the electrifying heroes Kilo and Watts. The two often work just with each other, however at times they are members of the New Society of Heroes.
affiliates: The Electrician; Watts; New Society of Heroes

name: Richard “Rich” Riverson
description: Son of The Electrician, after seeing old footage of their father being a hero and his fall at the hands of Molecule. Rich like his sister Robin, became the electrifying heroes Kilo and Watts. The two often work just with each other, however at times they are members of the New Society of Heroes.
affiliates: The Electrician; Kilo; New Society of Heroes

name: Brett Solidus
description:
Abilities: High tech weapons with his eagle inspired costume

A masked vigilante that fought to bring justice to the slums of Elitshia. Often seen as a black streak in the night, Eagle is a crime fighter with an eagle costume, high tech weapons, martial art skilled training, and can hold his own against those who are superpowered. To help stop a criminal mastermind, he was recruited into the New Society of Heroes. He was asked to remain on the team which he accepted. He co-leads the team with Ark “Elite Boy”.

name: Moondust
description:
Age: 15 (123 years old on his homeworld)

Stardust’s brother that came to Earth to search for her during the Lightning Stardust stories. He stayed even though she left, after falling in love with Aida. He is highly intelligent and alongside Eilan invents most of the team’s weapons. He also built bionic legs for Eilan and is close friends to Eilan and Frank his teammates.
abilities: Enhanced strength; Lazer eyes; Enhanced speed; Sight; Intelligence; Immortality

name: Tacob Misship
description:
Age: 18 (94 years old on his home world)

Because of toxins found within the waters of his home world, Tacob can transform into a giant beast of high intelligence, brute strength, and immortality. While calm and under the influence of candy, he is unable to transform.
abilities: Enhanced strength; Intelligence; Immortality while in Beast Mode

name: Devin Porbroker
description:
Abilities: Technology allowing him to manipulate his molecules to shrink or enlarge himself

After developing his own molecule manipulation serum after working with Molecule for years. Devin became Omnius to help save the world from Molecule and his son. He is the newest member of the New Society of Heroes and oldest out of the group. He appears when the other heroes are in their mid to late 20s in later stories.

name: Macluther Ronald Reges
description: Inheriting billions from his father’s corporation, Macluther Ronald Reges would begin his own Fortune 400 company the Nexus Corp. In order to not only create his own vision of the world but also take technology into a new world. At one point in time, MacLuther would take on the name as The Brain after using his own technology to give himself a brain that would absorb any and all knowledge he comes in contact with. Over time, the Brain would become the smartest thing in the universe and in many versions of his story a powerful force that created the Alphas.

name: Anterk
description: Anterk has always been seen as a cloaked figure with jewels decorating his robes showcasing his origins. During the age of the gods, his dialect and stories of the past shows both his great intelligence and power. Many believe him to be a god that descended to the earth after the great war.

name: Sarria
description: Sarria has always been a powerful foe and willing ally. She was born in the Amazons near the great Amazon river by a witch and soldier. From her parents, she gained their great magic & physical abilities. In the modern world, Sarria traveled and joined the Shifters and later Nexus Corp in hopes to get enough power and money to help restore her homelands after the great war nearly destroyed it. Sarria while in America goes by the name Amazonia.
abilities: Magical spells; Enhanced cat like reflexes

name: Night Grid
description: Vampiric like individuals, this team of super powered vampires have found their way onto the sights of both heroes and villains because of their abilities and traits.

name: Jane Kalpiton
description: Bitten by a vampire, Jane and her brother Jonus became modern day vampires capable of draining the life force from others, seeing into darkness, moving quickly, and having increase superhuman strength. Unlike her brother, Jane has a high intelligence and uses to enhance her vampiric abilities with technology she creates from her lab in her old school.
abilities: Super strength; Enhance night vision; Speed; Drains human life force; Teleportation

name: Jonus Kalpiton
description: Brother to Jane, he was bitten by a vampire to become a modern vampire that can drain the life force out of anything and anyone. Unlike his sister, he cares less about order and control and more for making others like himself by controlling them and turning them into vampire like soldiers.
abilities: Super strength; Enhance night vision; Speed; Drains human life force; Teleportation

name: Jayson Kane
description: With mixed emotions about returning to his past life of fighting, Jayson realized that it was his blood right to use his abilities to fight against the same dark forces that killed his brother and sister. Jayson met with Alk-shane in an attempt to strengthen his abilities and to find a productive way to release his anger. When Jayson was young he cared for his siblings after his parents died in a plane crash. His grandparents died when he was a teenager and his siblings shortly after from the Dark Forces. Jayson’s life was surrounded by things that would make him a strong fighter and very skilled swordsman. He so far has slain more demons than any other person on Earth. A record that he set after slaying 100 demons in one hour.
abilities: Skilled Swordsman; Enhanced psychic sensing; Strength; Levitiation

name: Vice Kane
description: During his youth, he watched his sister being taken by Belki. On that horrible night he fought to bring her back and from that day he studied the art of immortality hoping to live long enough to bring her back. After he found enlightment, Vice studied powerful magic and fought as a ninja. Over this time he buried his family, married and later watched as they aged, but none of this phased him as his true thought was getting his sister back in his arms. Through magic Vice opened a portal for his sister to return to the land of the living but also releasing the Dark Forces that he now must fight to send back to hell. The two are believed to be related to Korse however this hasn’t been proven.
abilities: Energy Fields; Great speed; Ninja like reflexes; Waves of light; Immortality; Magic

name: Versah Kane
description: Very beautiful and long lost sister to Vice, Versah disappeared from her home during the early 1800s and has since believed to have been sent to Hell where she learned to use her abilities to fight other demons. She got stronger and escaped to find her brother near death. She used her abilities to find him again and thus returning to his side as fighters against the very darkness that once took and enslaved her.
abilities: Healing; Great speed; Ninja like reflexes; Magnetic energy; Light bombs

name: Kendall White
description: Born to mortal parents, Kendall never knew of his abilities and had to find out the hard way of his true past and the truth behind who his great grandparents were. Kendall’s mother works as a night clerk and his father is in the army. The two remained silent about his family’s past and thus was force to find out from his grandfather before his death after learning of his abilities. Kendall learned he could move faster than anything on earth when he was running at night and he ran so fast that he circled the country twice in less than 5 minutes. The second time he ran so fast that he was able to move his body so fast that he could teleport to his determined destination. He met the other Nightwalkers when a Sholl attacked a young couple in a park near his house.

name: Sierra Milowe
description: Raised by her father and trained by her grandmother to become a Nightwalker, Sierra has mostly been secluded from normal life and has been surrounded by dark forces since she could walk. Her family discovered her family ability of big beautiful wings when she got hurt in a training accident. She then was able to walk through walls and control the molecules around her. Her abilities were rare among her relatives and thus figuring she was a true destined Nightwalker. At the age of 18, her grandmother sent her on a journey to find the other nightwalkers and to help stop the Wave of Chaos.
abilities: Big Wings; Molecule Manipulation; Skilled Martial Artist

name: Alk-Shane
description: During the early 1400s, Alk-shane founded the group of Nightwalkers through a test to see who had special abilities like himself. He was at that time father of four, devoted husband and member of his church. He was used as a weapon to fight demons because of his ability to extract demons from their host. Over the course of the years, Alk-shane fought numerous foes including finding himself in various worlds including Aurelia where he assisted the Guardians on their mission to defeat Chaldrone.
abilities: One touch can expel demons; Extract them from their host; Skilled swordsman

name: A’nra “pronounced Ahronya” Kubudi
description: A pottery maker and shaman that befriends Oli early in the Nubian Knights story as the two were neighbors before finding about their powers. A’nra has slight prophetic abilities long before she found out about her newfound ability to bring forth any dream, thought, imagination, and vision. She once appeared to Kendo Lazaron when the two were connected via the attack by the Akuma.
abilities: Premonition; Foresight; Projective thought; Imaginative projection; Dream walking

name: Oli Aolbrundi
description: A bodybuilder from Angola that once trained to be a solider in the Angolian army until his father died. This forced him to move back to South Africa, where he moved next door to A’nra and two became friends. At once the two were closed acquaintance until their powers were awaken and they decided to form the Nubian Knights. Oli is a proud Pro-Africa individual, believing Africa should protect, teach, build, and fight for itself. He also believes in a united African currency, continent wide initiatives, and lacks empathy for other countries and continents.
abilities: Diamond like body; Flight; Ice vision; Enhanced speed; Can create a sword of diamond; Ice from his body

name: Genda Promini
description: A former priestess, Genda is a proud Eritrean woman who believes in order and her GOD. She is one of the few humans alongside Oli that could see the supernatural world before her abilities awoke after the Akuma was defeated. Genda became Portal and now can open portals anywhere even if she doesn’t know if it exists or not.
abilities: Portals; Can prevent portals from opening

name: Erikk Franks
description: From Somalia, Erikk built weapons to protect his family from an invasion. These weapons after the Akuma were defeated were imbued with cosmic energy. Now he is the only ones that can use their powers. With out them, Erikk can take on their energy for limited cosmic energy.
abilities: Cosmic imbued weapons; Limited cosmic energy

name: Ifta Engrafti
description: From Egypt, Ifta can summon the spirits of her ancestors to attack her enemies. She is often seen when in costume as a mix between a famed Cleopatra and a mummy. In her civilian form, Ifta is beautiful and CEO of her own company in Cairo, Egypt.
abilities: Power to summon souls as weapons

name: Jeffrey Somers
description: Waking up in the middle of the night to find himself draining energy from every electronic device in his home. Jeffrey became aware of his abilities while sleeping on the couch after a fight with his estrange wife. His family is unaware of his abilities and usually thinks he is losing his mind. He was abducted into the Nubian Knights after saving them from an Energy Beast. He withdrew from the team after learning he would have to leave his children behind. After they were attacked and his power wasn’t enough, he rejoined the knights. He named himself after his place of birth Zambia.
abilities: Borrows energy; Repels it backwards with enhanced force

name: Energy Beasts
description: Grotesque beasts made up of energy and remanence of the left-over energy from Akuma’s destruction. They are often the reappearing enemies of the Nubian Knights. The Energy Beasts can take on numerous forms and are intelligent enough to trick the knights and others in believing they are humans when in disguise.
abilities: Steals energy; Conducts energy of varying abilities; Shapeshifting; Enhanced fighting skills; Near immortality; Multiplication

name: Aitaria Waynefree
description: A Burkinan woman that moved from Burkina to steal the Nubian Knights powers. Aitaria is a plain appearing woman with no means of standing out, her whispers cause others to perform her duties for her, while her screams can drain someone’s energy. Her gentle touch has the power to cause death, while her punches can destroy mountains. Her powers are re-enforced pockets of energy capable of performing numerous tasks and constant threats to the Nubian Knights.
abilities: Re-enforced energy that allows instant death; Enhanced strength; Energy refocusing; Enhanced life; Sight; Speed; Draining of energy; Mind control

name: Zonti
description:
Abilities: Manipulates the polarity of the Earth’s rotation

Age: appears 32 (believed to be thousands of years old)

Once a member of the Nubian Knights, now lover of Aitaria and her apprentice. He can manipulate the polarity of the Earth on a massive scale and is one of the strongest descendants on the planet. Although considerably stronger than Aitaria, he bows to her every call, something Aitaria takes advantage of often. It is believed that because of his abilities that he is an avatar for a previously forgotten African deity.

name: O.P.S
description:
Age: Varies
Note: Ocean Protective Services

During the leak of an acidic solution that leaked into the world oceans, numerous teenagers were given abilities related to the ocean and its various environments. Created by the Mermadic Kingdom, the Ocean Protective Services often shorten to O.P.S were started to protect the ocean from those that wish to bring harm to it. Although they have never met, members of the O.P.S often receive orders through various technologies given to them via sources like teleporting animals.

Separately, these teens do various ocean related tasks such as being life guards, excellent swim coaches, divers, protectors of the ocean through charity groups, and working at local aquariums.

name: Hodge De’Lord
description: Hodge De’lord is 15 years old and possesses the power to talk to any aqualitic lifeform.
abilities: Ability to speak to Aquatic Life

name: Sarah Longview
description: Sarah Longview is 16 years old and has the power to swim like a fish, she even has small gils that allows her to breathe underwater
abilities: Fish like attributes; Agility while in the water

name: Brian Mayweat
description: Brian Mayweat is the twin of Ryan and possesses the power to transform into any living aquatic lifeform.

name: Ryan Mayweat
description: Ryan Mayweat is the twin of Brian Mayweat and possesses the power to transform into any prehistoric aquatic lifeform
abilities: Shapeshift to any prehistoric aquatic life

name: Davisha Williams
description:
Abilities: To turn that rain into sharp objects

Davisha Williams has the power to turn her body into water like structure.
abilities: Liquid like body; Power to make it rain

name: Christina Frongmire
description: Christina Frongmire is 14 years old and the youngest of the team. She can control any form of water.

name: Old Ones
description: Powerful mages that have lived for thousands of years writing the various laws and creating potent spells for the various communities which they serve.

name: Anvitha
description: One of the oldest mages in history, Anvitha appeared as early -7978. Anvitha created numerous spells and saw the creation of the first witch’s council. Anvitha, is often seen as a heavy set woman with a long draping dress that expands across up to 12ft of space. Her hair is long and tangled with webs of magical string that protects her from dark magical influences.

name: Johnthias
description: A powerful character that appeared almost 9,000 years ago. He was responsible for creating powerful teleportation magic which from it came the creation of teleportation magic. He is often summoned, or his work is used whenever someone wants to move across great distances. He wears a belt of his creation that allows him to phase through solid objects.
abilities: Ancient teleportation magic; Enhanced phasing abilities

name: Sir Nuphorus
description: An old knight that has created numerous battle techniques and the creator of Battle Magic. Even in his advance age, Sir Nuphorus built a high city that trains numerous hunters to this day. Regarded as a monarch in his own right amongst hunters and other type of soldiers. His statue is erected in the E.L.I.T.E Organization base of operations.
abilities: Enhanced speed; Brute strength; Knowledge of all fighting skills

name: Centra
description: One of the first people to ever live in Earth. Centra almost died when she was banished from the Garden of Eden with Adam, Eve, and numerous others. Shortly before her dying breathe, Centra met with a mysterious figure that granted her the power to control and manipulate light based magic.

name: Suroh
description:
Age: 11,000 years ago

A master of discipline, Suroh traveled to the then unknown Aurelia in search of the mythical creatures that lived there. In his search, he crafted the first seal card to tame the creatures. This practice was taught and then passed down across generations.
abilities: Can seal things into other dimensions

name: Grendalia
description:
Age: 4 million years old

The first High Council member and daughter of the first witch. Grendalia was highly regarded as the highest member of the High Council and a powerful force both in terms of magic and respect. She ruled over most of Tier in her youth and started the High Council at the request of the Domi Mages. Her statue is erected in the center of the High Council’s meeting chambers.

name: Jerrickson
description:
Note: the Young

One of the knights that fought against Tonik and banished him to the Shadow Realm. Jerrickson was very young and thanks to drinking from the fountain of youth, he was unable to age beyond appearing as a young 25-year-old knight. Regarded for his esteem presence and knowledge of the ancient ways. He was inducted into the Royal Guard where he served for almost 10,000 years.
abilities: Immortality; Enhanced senses; Acute magical abilities

name: Cain
description:
Age: 1 million years old

Brother of Abel and his murderer. Cain was the first murderer and the first to commit suicide. His soul however was condemned to roam the Earth for eternity. He is seen as a bearded man with giant steel like muscles. His immortal tears can bring any back from the dead, his screams over Abel’s death, can be heard throughout time. He learned magic from the first warlock and fought numerous battles with demons for atonement for his crime. Although he is a spirit, he can propriate and has borne numerous children of great strength and abilities throughout history.

name: Overlords
description: A demonic group that rose to power after the fall of Santaniel. Their goal since has been to restore his power and wrath while taking over his position over Hell. They have grown to power to rival the High Council.

name: Victor Allen
description: During the raid of Elite City in the early 1970’s, Victor Allen could control electronic devices around him mostly video games and TVs. Over the course of time, Video Man lost his powers to only gain them back by Lightning Crow. He joined the ranks of the Overlords as their servant.

name: Vallah
description: Vallah is one of the most prominent demons in the Underworld, acting somewhat as an advisor above ground. She was defeated by Janice, daughter to Zane, and was revived by dark forces as a bigger demonic form and then defeated again by Elite Force and Janice.

name: Inicks
description: A beautiful set of demons called the Inicks. Once called deities and/or maidens as their name is loosely translated, these creatures once dance and sung to Belckus. However due to their father’s slumber, these creatures slowly disappeared from existence until recently they appeared again to meet with other demons to fight the Shadowrunners and free their father.

name: Paradox
description: A powerful group of wizards that have manage to integrate themselves into the depths of the magical force for instance the Perceivable Truth which an all seeing and all-knowing power that was stripped from the world eons ago by the magical elders.

name: Camry Strong
description: Camry Strong joined the Paradox as their most powerful team member while he was still in college. When he was a child, Camry found out that whenever he got sick or hurt; magic would heal his body almost making him indestructible. Shortly after graduating college, Camry became Mr. Wizard and begun protecting others less fortunate them himself.

name: Cecilia Kintowen
description:
Abilities: Capable of seeing the Perceivable Truth which grants her the power to see the truth of everything

Cecilia has the power to see into the Perceivable Truth which grants her increase power and strength. She learned of her powers when she was in a car accident which left her paralyzed from the waist down. Her new active magical powers allowed her to walk even if for small moments at a time.
abilities: Magical powers; Know weak points in anything

name: Vernon Banks
description: Vernon like his sister Vera can control electricity after being exposed to a toxic spill. He always adored his father and helped him on many jobs as a helping electrician. Along with his sister he makes up the joint team, Power Twins.

name: Vera Banks
description: Vera always wanted to be a electrician like her father because she loved working on projects and figure things out. One day she learned that she could control electricity and alongside her brother control electronic objects. With her brother they are called the Power Twins.

name: Victor Romus
description: Born in Sector B, a prestigious neighborhood in the northern portion of downtown Elitshia. Victor’s family moved him to schooling in Sector C hoping that it would help him calm down and to ease his angry state of mind. This only caused him to act out more, often causing trouble for his uncle who is a cop and drill sargent who took the responsibility of shaping him into a nice young man. Like many in Sector C, he was exposing to the dark magnet explosion radiations. He was given the ability to fly and enhanced strength; he would go to create the Pranksters and is the often enemy to Lamar as the two dislike each other in school.

name: Dennis Koo
description: Once a friend to Lamar, Dennis was one of the teenagers that was exposed to the dark magnet that nearly destroyed downtown Elitshia “Sector C”. He since joined his new friends with abilities that were at the cause of the Dark Magnet, his abilities consist of turning his body into slim and taking numerous shapes. At times he remembers his liking of Lamar as a friend and often tries to prevent from fighting him, much to Victor Prime’s dislike.
abilities: Can turn body into slim; Into different shapes

name: Julia Richards
description:
Abilities: Can send microwave like signals throughout the air to cause pain in people’s bodies

Julia Richards has been known to have a strong crush on Lamar, in many instances going as far as to capturing him just to be around him. She has been jailed numerous times because of this and at all attempts she makes, Lamar outsmarts her. Similar to Dennis Koo, Julia came to her fate as Microv after an incident with the Dark Magnet explosion in Sector C. She has since became a villain as part of the Pranksters and at times is their brain of operations with numerous schemes and plans to take over the city.

name: Mishaela
description: Usually found at her post at the edge of Eternity, Mishaela was summoned to create a team of primordial heroes that would save the world from powerful foes that threaten reality on a cosmic scale. She was told not to interfere with the actions of any being within the reality unless all of creation is threatened.
abilities: Power over destiny; Fate; Carries the Staff of Judgement

name: Zachiyus
description:
Abilities: Power to open gates to any reality

Son of a Space Titan, Zachiyus was thrilled that he was chosen to assist with saving creation from threats like Chaos and avatar of GOD threatening different realities. With the power to open gates between realities, Zachiyus is one of the few beings that can freely travel between different realities at will, even capable of traveling to different parts of the Omniverse. On one of his solo travels, he met Ms. Multiverse and the two bonded over there similar abilities. Zachiyus has a child like behavior and easily excited.

name: Valenia
description: An Arcota, that was chosen by Shecknurd and later appointed as Guardian of Time by Kain Lazaron to assist with keeping all time safe. She met the Celestial Guardian of Time when attempting to speak to the great Shecknurd about walking amongst humans after seeing their presence because of Kain Lazaron’s power.  She joined the Primordial Fighters after Ambrosius, an avatar of Chaos destroyed his world in the Universe 908.

name: Alstair
description: A powerful figure that was once hidden from all things. He appears often as a figure that watches from a far and helps to record the moments that are usually happening beyond the existence of non-cosmic beings. His cloaked body was revealed to be space and time itself, while his eyes are two small suns whose light went out eons ago. He was brought to be apart of the Primordial Fighters by the Neither to assist with protecting existence.

name: Dodvda
alias: Dovdan, The Dominus or Cosmic Speed
description: Avatar of Olerta that appears in both male and female forms. They were thought to only exists at the request of Olerta to be able to travel beyond her post in Eternity. Acting as twins sharing the same body, The Dominus is a fast moving being that can destroy stars and planets if they were to move directly at them at top speed. The Dominus is the fastest being in all of existence and outpaces even an Omega Level being. The Dominus is also the creator of the Cosmic Speed which is a massive force of energy that gives all those with enhanced speed their powers.

name: Raftfin
description: Appearing as a little boy with mischievous intent, The Wrath is a powerful figure that creates blackholes strong enough to swallow large galaxies in an instance. It’s appearance as a Primordial Fighter is often debated by the other members.
abilities: Power to create reality size blackholes

name: Norad
description: Although not as powerful as the Primordial Fighters that he serves, The Golden Star is a powerful being that can defeat in raw strength and ability to most skilled hero or villain of any world. He glides across space and time on a small board in the shape of a star, he omits energy from his boots and gloves that are strong enough to rip through time.

name: Knowel
description: Avatar is a great warrior, capable of learning all possible fighting skills, she is also very equipped with all knowledge of wars, varied skills, and cosmic knowledge of any place and or person. Avatar is a servant of the Primordial Fighters and close friend of The Golden Star.
abilities: Omnipotence; Knowledge share; Flight; Enhanced strength

name: N
description:
Abilities: Power to destroy or create realities at will; Capable of interacting with any moment in time; Can move entire realities with a thought

An incredibly powerful entity that is such a powerful force, that the other Primordial Fighters keep its name a secret but call it only by a moniker The Unknown. This being rivals the power of the Ho’zares and is believed to have been created by the Chaos to revive it and remove all creation. It’s true power is unknown and can be surmised as an avatar of Chaos.

name: Rainbow Crew
description:
Abilities: Holders of mystical energy of the Eliteverse

Age: Varies

Responsible for providing the mystical energy used by many organizations like the Black Ring and the White Ring among others. They are intense beings, only speaking to those who they understand to be of extreme powerful. Their origins exist somewhere in the 8th Universe where they are considered gods in their own right. Depicted as small glowing orange men who work in a large factory that makes planets and is powered by stardust.
affiliates: Black Ring; White Ring; others that draws mystical energy; Rainbow Crew

name: Galactic Holders
description: Giant missionaries that possesses massive strength capable of throwing planets into their positions in the galaxy. Existing since the time of the gods, these beings were responsible at one time for positioning everything in the universe. They work for the Rainbow Crew.
abilities: Universe size strength; Gravitational rings that position planets; Other things in the universe

name: Jason Reedes
description: Once a soldier in the United States armed forces, Jason Reedes has always been a quiet and well reserve guy with a war ridden past. He joined the Rainbow Squad because of his appearance and abilities. When he first enlisted in the United States armed forces, Jason was badly burned due to radiation and his skin turned a bright red. The radiation also provided him nuclear level abilities; he covers his body with a technically advanced armor suit.

name: Net Volxen
description: Stubborn and abnoxious, Net is one of the most fierce fighters of the Rainbow Squad and often uses brute force to defeat his opponents. He only tends to use his abilities when he feels he can no longer win the fight with his fists.
