Net is a strong fighter and was train in the U.S Army and several other forces around the world, he used his skills to form a group of superpowered team members that take pride in protecting the USA from threats, calling them the Rainbow Squad because of their appearance of the rainbow.

name: Alixa Mitchelle’
description: Originally apart of the Witches Haven, Alixa met her fate during the attack in Section C in Century City. Through recent experiments with her body, her soul was revived along with giving her purple like skin and technically enhanced magical abilities. She joined the Rainbow Squad because of their similarities and sworn to defeat their enemies at all cost.
abilities: Technically enhanced Magical like abilities; Flight

name: Jigueron Mills
description: Jigueron Mills was a teacher at a local high school in Sector C in Elite City until one day he encounter a science experiment gone wrong which provided him and several of his students weird abilities. He left the school shortly after and became a member of the Rainbow Squad after hearing that they were heroes for hire under the leadership of the United States Armed Forces. The experiment provided Jigueron Mills the power to release green energy blasts from his hands, eyes, and feet allowing him to attack his opponents and to fly.

name: Gizelle Wolmana
description: When she was an infant, Gizelle supported the anti-villian law that was rampant in Sector C of Century City to the point that she partially contributed to the experiment explosion in her school’s science lab. She knew the mixture of chemicals would cause some type of indifference amongst her body would give her abilities or so she thought, the explosion instead gave many others abilities in her town including her old teacher and herself.  Her skin turned yellow and her abilities are activated when her skin turns a bright yellow.
abilities: Her bright skin causes dizzy spells

name: Ladyla Grant
description:
Abilities: Transmutation into a wide variety of elemental compounds

Appearing in several chapters, Ladyla also known as Ms. Neptune appeared as mostly a polite, traveling, kind-hearted, curious girl with little knowledge of her abilities. All of which was altered when she came across her friend being killed by demonic trolls “Sholls”. This angered her, touching a rock caused her to turn her body into the same alloy thus becoming strong enough to defeat the Sholls.

name: Garold Some
description: Garold can turn himself into massive forms of sand. When he turns into this form his shape structures his strength and speed. He found out about his abilities after a toxic waste spilled onto his sandpit while he was playing with his brother at a park. He joined Ms. Neptune as part of a collective known as The Sandbox who he treats as his mother when his real mother isn’t around.
abilities: Control over sand; Can turn his body into sand

name: Eylsian Rivs
description: During the late 80s, Eylsian discovered that he wasn’t human, while playing soccer with friends in a open field behind his neighbors house, Eylsian quickly imagine an explosion and it happened nearly a few seconds later. It came to be known that he has the power to project thoughts into the real world. As time progress, he managed to do a lot of things including building up his life from poor to rich to becoming one of the most powerful men alive. He met Dylexin because of their mutual interests in collecting powerful items. He join Dylexin in hopes to get a piece of power from the Arnoxus.

name: Jake Boyd
description:
Abilities: Can use someone’s soul as a weapon

Jake grew up helping his father do many tasks such as helping his father capture souls so that he could control them, opening gateways to the underworld, and other tasks involving controlling the dead through various spells and rituals. Jake aslo called the Soul King has been the primary reason why the “Dead Rises Story” took place. It is said that during the late 90s, Jake discovered the Pearl of Indomnia which allowed him to rip a doorway into the underworld, allowing thousands of souls and the undead to be freed. The Soul King and Death Master used this opportunity for their advantages by enslaving each soul and undead starting a fight of the dead against the living. Seeing his wrong doings, Jake left his father side to join the Shadow Haven, shortly after leaving them, he joins the Street Riders.

name: Jada Ventura
description: Jada Ventura has always been labeled a very powerful girl, since she was born; flames destroyed everyone in a mile radius from her hospital room. From her teens, she has since been the dominant force that has caused many to fear her. Jada went by the title of the Domina Phoenix and has been labeled a High Level Being. For a short time, she was apart of the Shadow Haven until Gloria found her laying for dead after a battle, causing her to be more reluctant to join those that want to help her instead.
abilities: Pyrokinesis; Precognition; Light manipulation; Telekinesis; Astral projection; Flight

name: Dylexin
description: Apart of the original demons that challenged Michael, Dylexin was one of the first demons to be cast down to Earth, while on Earth, like other demons and angels, he forgot his past however keeping his anger toward humans alive. Dylexin memory was the first of any demons to return and for a thousand years he has been searching for the Arnoxus, a powerful demonic totem that will give him the power of all evil. He begins bringing other fallen demons together in hopes to find the different Arnoxus’.
abilities: Force Fields; Knows someone’s abilities; Controls Minds; Lightning

name: Fara Brown
description: During her moment as a callgirl, Fara has always been classified as strong and beautiful and also a target for men who wanted her. She began training in martial arts and using her beauty to get what she wanted. She met Dylexin at a sex club and after attempting to kill him for his money, Dylexin offered her unlimited luxury as long as she worked for him without sexual favors. Fara agreed and begun killing others in search for the Arnoxus, believing its power could be used for her own personal gain as well.

name: Vince Boyd
description: Since his moment meeting Dylexin, he has met with constant competition in controlling the Shadow Haven. Vince Boyd contains the ability to control the dead through an ability call the “Death Glare” and has since use this as his constant idea to be in charge. During the early 90s, Vince and his son took control over the dead that escape from the underworld in search of living their once forgotten lives (mentioned in the “Dead Rises Story”). Vince also known as the Death Master met Dylexin during a mission to find a Arnoxus, the two clashed immediately. The two came to an agreement to share the power of the Arnoxus.
abilities: Power to control the dead; Immune to diseases

name: Connor Devale
description: Connor Devale join Dylexin during the early 2000s, he since went by the name of Vipor because of his reptilian like skin and look and his acid breath. Vipor’s past involves his older brother who was killed in a lab accident that caused him to turn into a reptilian like creature. He shortly after met Dylexin who promised that with the power of the Arnoxus he could return the way he once was.

name: Lydia Linchfield
description:
Abilities: Shoots arrows that can teleport people to various locations

Her past is for the most part unknown, it is said that her pinkish skin is similar to her tribe. Lydia was abdopted after her tribe came to America, they split up amongst themselves and Lydia was lost shortly afterwards. She was found by a group of thieves and would come into her abilities after robbing her first bank. Her abilities would come useful to her new theif like family. Now going by the name Cycle, Lydia would meet Dylexin on her commute to rob a bank in Los Angeles, CA. The two met and she grew an affection toward him, she shortly after join his rankings and became his sidekick like assistance, assisting in traveling

name: Ain Long
description: Able to control the very shadows of which he speaks to, Ain uses the shadows to spy on others, steal, teleportation, and as his friends. Unable to age, Ain often finds himself alone because he watches his friends and family dies each lifetime. Ain found the Swordsman and found comfort that most of them are like him and are unable to age as quickly as others. Ain stated he cherishes death of the day it comes however knowing that its no known way he can die. Although not a trained swordsman as the others, Ain uses his abilities to teach himself, thus making him a prowd member of his clan.

name: Jenna Bilb
description: Stronger during an Eclipse, she gain her name from this fact, Jenna first trained with her abilities after being nearly killed by several students because of her mutant heritage. Jenna like her father before her fought most of her life defending who she is and her family later joining the Shadowrunners in an attempt to be around others besides her father that were like herself. However later in life, she left the group and attended SAA.

name: Kurk Reynolds
description:
Abilities: Releases diseases from his body when his eyes turn black; Releases a cure when his eyes turn white

A powerful Abnormal with the power to both cure and release diseases, although naturally a hero he however has assisted the Shadowrunners to defeat the like of his enemies and even stopping their other foes on other occasions. It’s known that Kurk Reynolds killed his mom from the womb through a lethal disease that later spread about a block from his room, killing everyone in that range. After finding out his father cheated on his mom while she was pregnant, he later released another disease this time willing of his own power onto his father and all of his father children and new wife.

name: Joanna Bridges
description: Mother of Johnathan, Joanna is aware of the supernatural world although she hasn’t told her husband and son. She first encounters the special forces while traveling home from Europe back to South Carolina where she met her future and now husband. Although powerless, she knew that the forces weren’t after her, only after other special beings like Descendants. Although unaware that his mother knows of what he can do, Johnathan is guided by Joanna on several missions with helpful although Metaphorical advice. Joanna uses books and the computer to help her son on missions to fight dark forces.

name: Dade Conta
description: With the ability to talk to any electronic device, Dade is one of the much assistance to Zenith. His abilities however has their downfall as his body once transformed into a partial spider like machine unabling him to go into public. This however kept him hidden in the shadows working as a liason to the Shadowrunners.

name: Zeanna Gragen
description: Originally a part of Shadowrunners in the mid-1960s, Zeanna Gragen was happy with fighting for a cause until she met Frank and later they started a family. She then became attent in fighting for her child and husband.

name: Frank Bilb
description: During the spike of growing Descendants in his area, Frank felt like he was finally being accepted by others like himself. Through this very moment is when he met a woman name Domini whom he fought with under the original team name Shadowrunners in the mid-60s. The two would marry and fight until Domini gave birth to their daughter and she settled. Frank or Shadow Rage as he was called in his time gave up fighting to train his daughter once she came of age, knowing of her unique abilities before she did.

name: Davidson Kenny
description: Taking on the form of virtually any known animal including extinct ones, Davidson is one of the most formible foes to the Light Feeders and at times he finds himself fighting alongside the Shadowrunners on their mission to stop the Light Feeders. He was born to two shapeshifters.
abilities: Shapeshifting into virtually any known animal

name: Crishna Aloris
description: Considered a High Level Abnormal, Crishna Aloris has the unique power over both Ice and Fire allowing her to exist in virtually every known terrain. Although her parents were mortals, Crishna was believed to have gotten her abilities from the Hozares, whom are believe to work with telepathically, although this unknowngst to her at the time. Crishna when possessed by Armageddon was able to manipulate the temperature of the entire world, atmosphere, and temperature of every body on the planet at the same time. This caused such a epidemic of sickness that many healers worked to stop this, thus even going as far as killing Crishna, releasing Armageddon at the same time. Crishna was revived some time later with little memories of this and joined the shadowrunners.
abilities: Manipulation of Ice; Thermal Sensing; Thermal Vision; Abnormal strength; Hearing

name: Jacob Flanningham
description:
Abilities: Psychic discharge causing his enemies to experience great pain

Son of a missionary, Jacob Flanningham has been subject to fighting his whole life and thus his career in the military as a youth. Now in his mid-20s he is ready to settle down and give up the life of fighting although his timing isn’t perfect. One day while meeting his girlfriend for lunch, he walked up to the restaurant where they were schedule to meet and it exploded. Grieving of her death, he later found out that it was demons that were trying to kill him however he later got his revenge on killing them and joined the Shadowrunners to stop other demons. Demons learned of Jacob’s abilities as an infant and hoped to take him as one of their own.

name: Johnathan Bridges
description: Unknowgst to him, Johnathan Bridges is led by his mother on several missions when she gives him helpful ways of defeating his opponents through Metaphorical terms. Johnathan’s ability is said to come from his father’s side however it has only been speculated since his father doesn’t have abilities but his grandfather does. Johnathan can shoot blasts from his hands that resemble black lightning.

name: Bonca Aimes
description: She uses the powers of light to fight the dormant shadows. She can focus her powers to create weapons that use light such as a gun and a sword. Bonca is very skilled in sword fighting and gun shooting and has been introduced as a skilled fighter and worthy ally to the Shadowrunners. She is daughter of a housewife and bill collector.

name: Vince Valkrow
description: Using the winds and shadows to carry his thin body across the air. Vince is very anxious all the time and uses his abilities to move swifly throughout the world. He first met Night Speed in an attempt to see who is faster, however it prove that Night Speed was determined the winner, this angered him and he vowed to win next time. His anger and competitive nature allows him to be a good ally to the Shadowrunners.

name: Dorith Bandie
description: Given the name Shadow King, Dorith Bandie was one of Elite Force bad guys of his time. Thought to have been dead for almost 300 years along with his villainous group. Shadow King made an attack on Elite City which gained the entire world’s attention that one of the most deadly villains has return. Rumors of his disappearance have led many to believe that he is near immortal since he hasn’t age.

name: Richard Collins
description: Picked on in school because of his deformities, Richard Collins would later leave school to join the Shadow Stalkers after finding out about his abilities. He met with the Shadow King and showcases his abilities to get accepted into the team. He became the youngest member and helps lead the new younger version of the team.

name: Tuchita
description: Tuchita was one of the fierce beings on his planet; he came to Earth during the 1800s alongside other alien mutants from other worlds to assist in finding the Queen of the Cosmos. After several decades, Tuchita memory was erased and blended in with society. He joined the Shadow Stalkers and later the Ardonian Tribe.

name: Margeret Chown
description: Margeret Chown was a beautiful mistress of a tyrant that moonlighted as a soldier in his army. Since the early 2000s she helped to clear his kingdom from their enemies all while going under the title White Shadow. Although possessing no abilities herself, Margeret had abnormal strength for a human woman and advance combat trained talent.
abilities: Advance combat skills; Abnormal human strength

name: Jarold Stalmer
description: Jarold Stalmer since a child considered he a hero. He wore tights and underwear over his garments. It wouldn’t be til his early teens when, Jarold would join his dad at the police academy in Miami, Florida. Here he learned how to fight crimes and learned the law. His girlfriend also a police officer would also share his passion together and the two would work overnight as vigilantes known as Night Man & Night Woman. During a battle of demons, the two joined the Shadow Stalkers to help defend the city.

name: Jessica Riddens
description: Jessica Riddens was one of the most athletic and team spirited kids of her high school. She always believed in upholding justice and keeping the peace. It wasn’t until her early teens when Jessica joined the police academy in Miami, Florida and would later on meet her future boyfriend Jarold Stalmer also known as Night Man. The two joined the Shadow Stalkers during a battle with demons. After the original Shadow Stalkers disbanded, Jessica would become mentor to the new younger team of the same name.

name: Mitch Oldem
description: Mitch Oldem was born with the dangerous abilities of radiation touching. While 17 years old, Mitch learned that he couldn’t touch anyone without special made gloves and even his kisses were deadly. He left to join the Shadow Stalkers only because society was in danger if he stayed amongst humans.

name: Isia Layden
description: Believed to be the daughter of the goddess Iris, Isia is considered one of the most beautiful beings ever to have lived. Her birth right gains her support from many worlds and even granted her princess of the skies. On earth she attends human schooling where she has since adapted numerous friends and living amongst adopted parents. In the year 2020 she joins the Sky Brigade to help fight crimes on Earth.

name: Lisa Gwendolyn
description: In an ancient world, Lisa Gwendolyn is actually a powerful goddess who was sent to Earth before her world was destroyed by dark aliens. Since then she has grown into a powerful member of SAA and has been known as the Storm Watcher because of her abilities to control the weather. In Chapter 20, she marries Zane and the two produce the most powerful Descendants the world has ever seen.

name: Melinda Bines
description: Melinda Bines was daughter to a powerful mogul, always seen behind the scenes. Melinda wanted to be the center of attention and so one day while escaping to go party, Melinda was captured by several men who was going to rape her. In the moment of her capture, her eyes started to glow and a thick fog began to cover the room allowing her to escape. Over time not forgetting this tragic moment, Melinda would join the Sky Brigade in hopes to protect others like herself.

name: Jack Cross
description: Jack Cross was a powerful senator who lost everything when he was found guilty of a crime he didn’t commit. To prove himself innocent, Jack after learning of his ability to turn himself into steam and omit smoke from his body, he would then join the Sky Brigade to get his innocence back and set things right.

name: Harmen Talins
description: Harmen Talins was always picked on because he was considered a nerd. One day he learned of his unique ability to mold any object into whatever he imagines. While away on a field trip at school, Harmen molded a tree branch into a surf board and used it to impress his peers while riding a dangerous wave at a nearby lake. However once the wave got out of hand and started to damage nearby camp grounds, Harmen also known as Air Rider would create a more enhanced board from the rocks on the lake’s bed to help push the water back into its area. In the future Air Rider joins the Sky Brigade.

name: Kyon Arith
description: Kyon was one of the many Descendants that fell to the Earth after the great battle of angels and demons. During his final fight, Kyon summoned one of the world’s most powerful storms to defeat several demons. However this caused him to fall to the Earth in the process. He was revived as a young boy who was growing rapidly into his powers. When he became a young man he became a member of the Sky Brigade.

description: Age: Varies

description: Power Enhancement

description: Tornado Body & Tornado creation

name: Gary Vinkrum
description: Microscopic Vision

name: Space Titans
description:
Abilities: Each have different powers over the elements

Age: No Set Age

Much like titans of Greek mythology and the World Pirates, Space Titans are giant human like beings that were born out of pure darkness. They are controlled by Montum and were given specific orders to destroy several worlds to steal their most precious artifacts. The artifacts would then be used to increase Montum’s power and open the gates of Hell onto the land of the living.

name: Star Core
description: Space guardians whom built a massive spaceship that sits somewhere between the Andromeda galaxy and our Milky Way. It has since served as a galactic gateway to other galaxies across the vast universe. They have created numerous suits that have scattered across the universe including some of those worn by heroes and villains like the Armor Guild, Star Man, Star Man X, etc.

name: Star Core
description:
Abilities: Creates artifacts that can turn into suits of great power

Age: Varies

Formed thousands of years ago, the modern Star Core was designated to watch over the Andromeda Galaxy from intergalactic threats. When one of their artifacts were replaced they went to go find it. Once on Earth, they discovered that a hero name Sunburst had used it to protect his planet, Earth. Believing that it was safe with him and it could help them. The Star Core left it with him, guiding him without his knowledge through his suit. For decades both Sunburst and Supernova believed that the suit was talking to them, although it was the alien race Star Core that was communicating through the suit.
abilities: Great weapon makers of the galaxy; Force beams from eyes; Levitation; Super strength; Teleportation

name: Lelick Humage
description:
Abilities: Suit that provides power beams from hands

One of the most trusted guardians under the command of the Star Core. He has traveled the galaxy protecting it from threats. Although he isn’t known much on Earth, he has made a big presence throughout the galaxy. His suit was design specially for him and has the power to turn him invisible, contains massive powers, and is specific to his DNA only. His past was erased so that he can concentrate on defending the universe. He often battles with trying to find out about his past and his task of being a Star Core soldier.
abilities: Flight; Super strength; X-ray vision; Capable of healing. W/O suit; He has near healing factors; Great intelligence

name: Cuisha Mimora
description:
Abilities: Suit that provides power beams from hands

One of the soldiers’ assign to carry the power of the Star Core’s suits. She has been given this task with her memories always erased. She often works alone but is called upon to help Core Man in his attempt to stop threats that oppose the power of the Star Core. She is from a pink planet that has devoted itself in finding a cure for an illness on their planet.
abilities: Flight; Super strength; X-ray vision; Capable of healing. W/O suit; She has healing factors; Enhanced speed; Hand to hand combat; Skilled gun; Sword user

name: Star Duo
description: Star Woman and Star Duo received their powers from the Star Core however, when they saw the true disguise by some of the elders of the Star Core, they left and went their own separate ways. Since then they have been defending the galaxy from numerous threats.

name: Jisura
description: From a distant planet named Orista, Jisura has been one of the most prominent people on her planet. She was an inventor and powerful lady of her court. Chosen by many to protect her planet from harm, Jisura came to Earth to find pieces to assist in building a weapon that could rid her home world from an alien bounty hunter. While on Earth, Jisura met a young man whom she became captivated with and together they protected the Earth while she was there and later took him back to her world where they married and became proud protectors of Orista.
abilities: Super human strength; Yellow lazer beams from her fist

name: Mich Jaxen
description: Alongside his bestfriend and soon to be wife, Mich Jaxen was one of the most beloved people of his home world before it was destroyed. Like Jisura, Mich made it his goal to build a weapon that could destroy the creatures that destroyed his world while also helping to destroy the creatures that wants to destroy Orista.
abilities: Super human strength; Red lazer beams from hands

name: Star Watchers
description: Ancient beings and believed to be eldest children to the Primordial Ones, they are the embodiments of their respective galactic source including water, fire, etc.

name: Luna Devro “The Wind Valkyrie”
description: Luna Devro as she is called in our world took on her human form after hearing of the return of the Ho’zares, to prevent them from going rogue and destroying the planet. Luna became a watchful eye of the earth known as The Star Seer. In her own realm, Luna Devro watched over the skies, she could manipulate winds across realms and generated the power behind the Wind Gods and beings that controlled the forces of the wind. Her body armor in our universe, keeps a force of wind from destroying everything, it is said that the force while in the universe is strong as a blackhole’s power. In her own realm, her power equals that of others known as The Star Watchers.

name: Vendoron Homru “The Heat Myster”
description: Vendoron Homru can control the forces of heat and fire throughout the universe. Prophecied to have the power given to him by The Ultimate Power, Vendoron mastered his abilities in his own realm and became a Star Watcher after being told of his legacy. He presented his gift to many including the Ho’zares, Domaedians, other beings of the universe and finally Earthlings. Along with Luna Devro, he takes homage in Universe 12.

name: Kandaron “The Water Symbian”
description: Kandaron was born from the creation of the first water supply in the universe. From his power came the creation of water that spilled into every realm and every known place in the universe. As a product of The Ultimate Power, his brethren The Star Watchers & the Ho’zares drunk from the liquiod that flowed from his body and became immortals. It is said that The Ultimate Power uses Kandaron’s water abilities to flourish the natural aspects of Helliholm “Heaven”. Kandaron takes residence in Universe 8.

name: Tiera Domain
description: Born from the first star, Tiera Domain is credited as one of the most powerful elemental beings in existence. With little knowledge of the universe around her because of her secludiness in the Mystic Garden “place in Helliholm”, Tiera can control nature and cause earthquakes on a universal scale. It is believed that from her hair and skin flowes the grounds of every known place in the mulit-verse. She is probably the youngest and most naïve of the galactic beings. She is from Universe 9.

name: Grandi Voloman “The Elder Seer”
description: Grandi Voloman has the ability to control the minds of any living or dead creature in the universe. Cast as the first known telepath and prophet, he was the one that knew and fortold of Belckus’ betrayal. Because of his abilities, he is kept next to The Ultimate Power’s side for all eternity. However it is known in one story, that he left in a projected form and appeared to The Star Watchers as somewhat of a guide, however this form was much less powerful and had limited telepathic abilities. Although this form showcased stronger telepathic ability then any other being in the universe.  He is from Universe 5.

name: The Wiseman
description: The Wiseman has been sought out by many beings throughout existence, mostly because of his vast intelligence and ability to see any instance throughout any moment of time. With the ability to see throughout all existence, The Wiseman also can hear all, feel all emotions, read minds (however unable to control them), posses’ immortality, and is immune to infinite amount of abilities. He lives somewhere on the edge of Helliholm as a part of Universe 7 and serves as a Star Watcher.

name: Street Deviants
description: A vigilante group charged with their own sense of justice. Although often seen as heroes from their followers, this group of mostly teenagers and young adults are also killers. The group mostly take law into their own hand, killing or torturing those whom they believe deserve it.

name: Dalton Creed
description: The Bird is one of the most elite members of the Street Deviants, often considered their leader. His focus caused them to hunt down killers and hard criminals, often disobeying the law in the process. To pay the bills, he created the Street Deviants crime unit serving as an underground hit service. They often profit by billionaires to be hired as mercenaries.

name: Visha
description:
Age: appears 23 (200 years old)

Daughter of a Natayan that arrived at Earth almost five years ago looking for her lost brother. Contempt that she may never find him, El’Lauria vowed she would not return home without justice, spending years looking for what happened to him. She is often the love interest to both Maria De’vough and The Bird.
abilities: Flight; Dark light like abilities; Energy barriers

name: Maria De’vough
description: After forming a thruple with The Bird and Nightlight, Maria De’vough joined the Street Deviants as their powerful master of magic. She uses advance voodoo magic to defeat her enemies who often are shadow creatures and masters of the dark arts themselves. She runs a shop where the Street Deviants often use as a base of operations.

name: Alik Prince
description: Son of the demon Behemoth, he once lived in Aurelia until his father was defeated by the Battle Guardians. He then came to Earth to leave his father’s shadow and become his own man. He fell in love with a young boy who together they fight a part of the Street Deviants.

name: Valiant Algreeves
description: Son of a member of the Akuma Dae, half angel, half human. Valiant is a unique member of the group as he only wants to fight evil but not kill, he also sees himself marrying Alik although the two are only 15.

name: Rayden
description: An android that appears shortly after Lightning Stardust on Earth attempting to take her home. However, when Stardust wanted to remain on Earth to help fight the Akuma, the two argued and later fought. Upon loosing, Android 9 unable to return home joined the Street Deviants to strengthen his abilities to further fight Stardust again. He later enjoyed killing humans, regardless of their prior reasons, which usually causes a rift with his teammates.
abilities: Lazer Beams from eyes; Hands; Flight; Enhanced intelligence; Super strength; Technokinesis; Shapeshifting

name: Linda Bowens
description: Using powerful magic, Modify can change her appearance into anything she wishes although initially she could only change into animals. In her other forms she can even mimic those forms natural or supernatural abilities. This ability makes her one of the most powerful members of the Street Deviants. Although, while in said form, she also inherits their weaknesses and can only maintain those forms for five minutes.
abilities: Can shapeshift into anything; Can its abilities; Weaknesses

name: Caleb Winehouse
description: Earth Breaker is a powerful and deadly strongman that uses his earth-based abilities to destroy anyone or anything that attempts to disturb nature. He once was an environmentalist and often leaves from the group at times to save forests, lakes, and other parts of the Earth’s natural resources. He is a virgin believing that his purity will allow him to protect the earth.
abilities: Earth-based abilities including superhuman strength; Rock like skin

name: Jessica Powers
description: Capable of manipulating reality through her artwork, Jessica creates art that allows her to create a reality of her choosing. Although, she rarely knows the limit of this ability. It is believed by Valiant, Mistress Voodoo, and Hell Spawn that Jessica might be a Djiin.

name: Davisha Henderson
description: A skilled archer, Davisha witnesses her family brutally murdered as a child and has since vowed to revenge them by hunting down and killing their killers. She developed a passion for archery because of her father’s similar passion for it when she was younger. She wears a red outfit made by her mother during one of their Halloween parties. It has since been enhanced and made bullet proof by Android 9 and magic proof by Mistress Voodoo.
abilities: Skilled archer; Enhanced suit protecting against bullets; Street-based weapons like swords; Guns; Etc; Magic

name: Cara Donnings
description:
Abilities: Can control the minds of others through whispers

An absent member of the group that splits her time between being a call girl, avid video gamer, mother, and crime fighter. She says she loves all of her “gigs” and takes pride as a mother because of her own mother. She developed the ability to control people with her words after whispering a command during sex with a millionaire that she wanted more money and his private jet. The affects last as long as she is focused, once over the affected individual can’t remember what happened for almost two hours.

name: Allen Crooks
description: A skilled fighter, archer, and businessman, Allen Crooks became one of the youngest billionaires after inventing the invisibility machine which would later inspire invisibility machines in the future. He invented this by mistake when attempting to create a light based mirror, his invention caused the light to bend which caused invisibility.
abilities: Famed inventor; Businessman; Archer; Skilled fighter

name: Street Riders
description: Ninja like assassins whom primary reason for joining together is to fight and strengthen their skills. Unlike others like them, they have little alternative reasoning besides that.

name: Seth Benji
description: Seth was the last member of the Street Riders to join the rank. He found the Chain of Baldre during a moment of grieving over his mother that died a day before from a fight with a Street Rogue.

name: Will Walback
description: During a street fight in Australia, Will while visiting with his friends, found the fight interesting and thought of joining. Although he was defeated in his first fight, it didn’t stop him from finding the Stars of Kane allowing him to strengthening his skills and eventually joining the Street Riders.

name: Reef Gordan
description: Reef played varsity football in high school and has since been in the major league. His career came to a hault when he killed one of the players through anger. Little did anyone know that the believed killed player was alive and now a Shadow Haven member. Reef used his abilities to join the Street Riders to gain back the trust of people he knew.
abilities: Enhanced Strength; Durability; Body can turn to stone

name: Kenneth Blade
description: During his initial battles in street fighting, Kenneth was a well self trained martial artist that used gifted styles. He was found by Kalle and was told that he was destined for greatness. During the moments of his trials, Kenneth found the Blades of the Street Gods and has since used them in many of his battles against the Shadow Haven.
abilities: Martial Arts skills; Glowing blades which causes electricity

name: Mina Ambsott
description: Mina joined the Street Riders after seeing Kalle and Marsha fight each other in an intense fight during a Street Rally. Mina found the Rings of Padur and has since used them to win many of her Street Fights. The Street Gods used her abilities to induct her into the Street Riders team.
abilities: Glowing power rings around body; Martial arts skills

name: Lee Rivers
description:
Abilities: Symbols over body which can allow him power over water

Lee was train by one of the Street Gods named Gaven. The training tought Lee how to use powerful techniques to defend himself such as enhanced martial arts skills, the power to control the water through tattoos on his body, and the power of ice through mental control over the water he already could control.

name: Monica Bades
description: Living in London, tought Monica how to defend herself with elequonce. Monica left home to train with her friends so they can fight in the Street Fights in her neighborhood. Monica because of her determination found the Power Chakras which would give her power and control over her fights.

name: Bishop Halwk
description: Bishop studied at the Loastasian School of Arts where he later graduated as a teacher at SAA. While teaching at SAA he met Kalle and would for a time be apart of the Street Riders. During his youth, Bishop could emit powerful blasts from his hands through absorption of energy sources while also using optic blasts from his hands while angered. Bishop’s unique abilities would be sought out by the Shadow Haven only to be found by Kalle first.
abilities: Optic Blasts from eyes; Hands; Martial arts skills

name: Teran Midol
description: Found by Kalle while teaching at the Elitshian School of Arts, Teran was merely a boy when he learned of his abilities to transform his body into different forms and even objects. Using his abilities to prank everyone including Kalle. Kalle thought this to be a gift that would help win many Street Fights worldwide, thus inducting Teran as apart of the Street Riders. Teran became the first member of the group and often leads them.

name: Sun Twins
description: Possessing the powers of the sun, Solar Boy and Solar Flare are twins whom were born of the sun god Ohn. When the gods fell, it was left up to them to defend their kingdom on the sun from being overthrown by outside forces.

name: Sean’aj Oloft
description: With parents being the sun god, Ohn and goddess Mua, Sean’aj and his twin brother Ja’sean was very powerful having possess the power of the sun itself. He came to Earth with his brother to explore it and research human life to only fall in love with Earth. He would then remain on Earth with his brother to escape his royal duties back at the Sun Kingdom with his parents.

name: Ja’sean Oloft
description: With parents being the sun god, Ohn, and goddess Mua, Ja’sean and his twin brother Sean’aj was very powerful having possess the power of the sun itself. He came to Earth with his brother to explore it and research human life to only fall in love with Earth. He would then remain on Earth with his brother to be by his brother’s side as he adored him very much.
abilities: Harnesses the power of the sun; Projects fire; Heat

name: Supreme 5
description: From different worlds, this team are a galactic creation that formed together in order to bring down the forces that threatens the outskirts of our galaxy.

name: Simere Ibluisuikenszi
description: Born on a planet named Ilyon, Simere came to Earth in search of his long lost princess to only find out that she has since died in a tragic war that struck the world. His time on Earth found him immortal and given enhanced abilities due to the planet’s life energy, the sun, and the moon. Over a course of time, Simere would protect the planet while in the hopes to find a new queen to take back to his new world.
abilities: Strength; Lazer Eyes; X-Ray Vision; Speed

name: Brian Mont
description: Cousin to Sandy Reonalds, Brian Mont was born to a military father and house wife mother. He was an elite basketball star that was on his way to tryouts at a local college, when his arrival at his cousin’s lab caused him to experience weird molecular composition to his body and mind. Brian would be given the ability to blow things up with his mind directed through his hands and would dismiss the idea of getting a basketball scholarship to join his cousin, her husband, and their friend to form the Supreme 4.

name: Jacob Darns
description: Believed to have been killed off the coast of the Mediterranean Sea by several pirates raiding his ship. Jacob Darns was revived by an unknown warlock of which granted him powers over the oceans, the earth, and the skies so that he could take vengeance on those that killed him. Over the course of a century, Jacob also known as Poseidon would search hard to find those that killed him while also joining The Elementals and the Supreme 4 making them the Supreme 5, assisting fighting in their battles. His cold heartiness toward his enemies however with a kind-heart toward his allies, makes Jacob one of the most beloved characters in Elite Comics.

name: Clark Reonalds
description: Clark Reonalds met with Simere on a mission in Antarctica where Simere was building a house out of ice. Unable to stay in the icy winds for long, Clark was invited into Simere’s new home. Here they discuss the dangers of the world and Clark wanted Simere to join him and several others in fighting the planet’s darkest foes. The two created the Supreme 4 which later would become the Supreme 5.

name: Sandy Reonalds
description: Sandy, wife of Clark Reonalds, was born under the watchful eye of her father who taught her to be one of the world’s leading scientists. She helped created a liquid that if exposed to light could cause a chemical reaction in one’s body, given them strange mutated attributes. Unknowingly of the effects Sandy was going to destroy it until a lab accident caused her, Clark, and her cousin Brian to all be effected by its fumes. Sandy is cited as being responsible for giving the abilities of the Supreme 4.

name: David Borne
description: Since he was born, David experience massive amount of knowledge, some would say more than the greatest minds in history. He could solve problems without much thought and graduated from college at age 18. Now at age 20 he attends SAA in hopes to learn all the knowledge of the world. From time to time he assists Elite Force in their journeys.

name: Wilson Daymen
description: Wilson Daymen is considered one of the most powerful beings on the planet, channeling the power from the sun. Often during the day, Wilson can create a phoenix which is one of his most powerful attacks. Son of the god Re’, Wilson contains powers similar to that of a high level Abnormal.

name: James Tolerman
description: James Tolerman has always been a specimen of great beauty. He won many modeling competitions and has become one of the richest and sought people in America because of this. Once married to a princess, heiress, and supermodel, James is known as a playboy and rarely shows signs of caring for others. While on a photo-shoot in the jungles of Africa, James discovered his ability to fly with the help of giant wings. Unable to hide them, James left the limelight and went into hiding fearing of what the world would think of him. Over time, James became a part of SAA as a teacher after realizing it was one of his only ways to feel accepted. He teaches Beauty and Elegant amongst those less desirable.

name: Candace Zingerman
description: Daughter of a refugee who fought in World War 2, Candace Zingerman was one of the only children in her class that survived an open attack during the war. Candace while living by herself learned of her enhanced longevity and metal like nails while trying to protect her during an alley fight.

name: Dr. Murdock Banes
description: Dr. Murdock Banes was one of the world’s most renowned surgeons until he died of a brain aneurism. During his afterlife, Murdock met a wizard named the Elder that brought him back to life after teaching him powerful spells. Now alive again in a new world, Dr. Banes became one of the world’s most powerful wizard.

name: Semaj Namrelot
description: Semaj Namrelot is the evil twin from an alternate world of James Tolerman. Although noticeable differences of the two exists, Semaj hates the limelight and uses his abilities to stay hidden from almost everyone, he attends SAA as a teacher of combat and doesn’t meet James until the two assists in the fight for the school during Chapter 12. Although his name is Dark Angel, Semaj is a good guy with a pure heart unlike how James once was. However during a brief moment in time, Semaj serves under Armageddon’s plan to destroy the world under a dark spell by The Black Witch.

name: Obessa Munroe
description: Obessa Munroe is a great actress who is known for her beauty and nominated performances until she went missing. During her absence no one knew where she disappeared to or how she returned. Obessa returned to her family with red hair, blue eyes, and new attitude and more aggressive. During her reappearance, Obessa showcases the ability to move through the walls and goes by the name Ghost Woman.

name: Casca Doug
description: Casca Doug is the descendant of Medusa and was the prospect of Medusa and a human teenager. Casca also called Medusa in honor of her ancestor because of similarities of abilities by the original Medusa. During her time in Paris, she created several sculptures and showed them off and is world renowned for her work.

name: Kinra Chapman
description: During her exile, Kinra Chapman has become one of the most wanted criminals in Africa. She used her abilities to capture many precious items across the country for her exclusive collection. Kinra would then go by the name the Shadow Keeper after finding out about her abilities to control the shadows.

name: Wiley Maximillion
description: Wiley Maximillion was one of the creators of the 7 rings of Dealthrope. He gave each of them technically advance abilities that would later be used for darkness. Desperate to right the wrongs of his misdeeds, Wiley created a power armor that would increase his strength and grant him strength, higher intelligence, & speed. However the suit had its flaws as it would decrease his life span and run out of power after a major fight of which the wearer would have to take a week to recharge. Armor Boy also wore a similar suit in the future.
abilities: Powered suit that contains enhanced strength; Speed; Durability; Great intelligence

name: Jack Will
alias: Armor Boy & Armor Man (after the age of 30)
description: Born in the year 3000, Jack Will was one of the users of the power suit created by Wiley Maximillion also known as Suit Man. He fought hundreds of villians before his retirement. His abilities consisted of enhanced strength, speed, great knowledge, & immortality.
abilities: Powered suit with enhanced strength; Speed; Intelligence; Immortality

name: Steve Morman
description: During the great war, Steve Morman was one of the only survivers that originally came from Earth. While recovering and trying to get his life back to normal, Steve came across a pod that made its way to Earth from the great war and later after researching it gave him back his abilities. Unable to watch the world suffer from the backlash of the war, Steve became Starman X. In his honor, Starman was created alongside Starwoman in the near future.
abilities: Star dust like beams from hands; Eyes

name: Castor Kawn
description: Founder of the Water Imbursement Society in order to restore water supplies to unfortunate homes in the U.S. Castor Kawn invented the Nauts a system that could quickly replicate massive amounts of water across the country. Duirng an explosion in the basement of the ship, part of Castor’s body was destroyed leaving liquid like substances to recreate most if not all of his body. After this moment, Castor contained the ability to become water and control it at times.
abilities: Aquatic Reimbursement of his body; Aquakinesis

name: Arnold Bakes
description: Arnold Bakes was just a little boy when he discovered his abilities. He was in the backyard of his house and was playing with his puppy near the pool and as the two got in the water, Arnold accidently caused a shockwave through the water killing his puppy. That same night without telling his mom, he brought his puppy back to life by reshocking it. This caused Arnold to grow up as the Shocker fighting crimes and sometimes causing them for his own purposes usually unknown to everyone else.

name: Eileen Vixen
description: Ms. Eileen Vixen is probably one of the most recognizable teachers at SAA; she was born in a small town outside of Rome and has studied over 20 languages. When she was a teenager she found out about her feline attributes and being a descendant of the goddess Bast of Egyptian mythology.

name: Girly Momen
description: Girly Momen has always had a sunny personality with little anger. It was until her battle with the Belki that she was considered the happiest person on the planet at least known as by her friends and family. When Girly was a little girl she discovered her powers after having to save her younger brother from a fire created by a demon of Hell.

name: Mike Davids
description: During his birth, Mike Davids’ mother almost died delivering him, until a spark of light healed her entire insides having the doctors believe it was a miracle done by god. Since that moment, Mike has always been adored and kept a secret by his mother. Working in her office one day, Mike’s mom didn’t know Mike was on one of his curiosity hunts for adventure causing him to wonder in the backyard and nearly killing him by a sharp object. Minutes later it was discovered that Mike’s healing ability can always keep him from harm and to allow his body to regenerate faster than light.

name: Rina Page
description: Rina Page grew up getting anything that she wanted by seducing the men in her life. She worked as a stripper, prostitute, and even a porn star for a while until she came across her abilities and realizes it wasn’t just on her looks. As time progress, Rina began moving upwards in the world by draining the energy of some of the most powerful men and even some women across Paris. She would then move across Europe getting richer and more powerful.

name: Victor Raxen
description: Victor Raxen was known from around the world as a unique florist. He could talk to plants and even heal them and control them at will, when he went global with his abilities he became the first Abnormal on the planet that showcased their abilities without a secret identity. Victor moved to Russia to further his abilities where he lived in a mansion and suited by hundreds of beautiful men and woman and the world’s largest garden as his backyard.
abilities: Talking to Plants; Healing of Nature

name: Jake Ride
description: Jake Ride was born in a magical forest near fairyland. As a child he would come out to the land of mortals to view their habitats and play with little children that would eventually forget he existed. Now as a teenager he uses magical bow, arrows, & sword to defend little children and goes by the name Centaurus. While in his civilian form hes a normal 13 year old boy however in his normal form he is a centaur.

name: Play Blowe
description: Play Blowe has always been attractive to electronics and was thrill to know that she could control them by simply looking at them. Her ability known as Electric Technopathy allows her to speak to electronics through some form of telepathy. During the great war of Angels and demons her ancestors battled the demons with giant electronic masses which she would inherit.

name: Zack Flow
description: Mr. Zack Flow was one of the most secretive men anyone could meet. He lived amongst trees in his giant mansion at the above of rocky mountains where no one knows of his existence. For the few people that have met him, they consider him the everyday scrooge. During his youth, Zack discovered that he could walk through mirrors or glass to go anywhere across the world which allow him to build worlds hidden from anyone else which also made it hard for his parents to find him.

name: Brent Forman
description: Brent Forman would escape his cell while living at an assisted living facility for mental diseases. After much debate of weather to stay trapped at this place, Brent became Phase and begun using his abilities to get things that he wanted and could normally get because of his mental illness. Admitted at a young age for schizophrenia, Brent as always been a wild character that most people find dangerous.

name: Yonda Holmes
description: Yonda Holmes was known for some time for her abilities to curse anyone she places her hands and eyes on. Sought out for her abilities, Yonda made a name for herself in the eastern parts of the world mostly in China, Japan, & London where her shops for its herbs and spell books became ultimately popular.

name: Pearl Davis
description: Called Miss Pearl, Pearl Davis could reflect anything with her glass like body and could use her abilities as a walking mirror for solid object. Some stories hint at how she was born, with many stories suggesting that she was born out of magic to be a human girl however she was cursed to never fall in love because she was so precious that the gods didn’t want her purity to be lost. However one day in her teens, she would go against this wish and fall in love, thus being turned to shards of glass. One day the shards would be collected and revived by magic and here stood a glass figured woman so beautiful that her body was priced at millions thus making her more precious than diamond.

name: Mr. Carnell Mixen
description: Mr. Carnell Mixen left for SAA admittedly following a chemical reaction that left him with no face. At SAA he studied to see the world without eyes while all the time he would develop the ability to see through solid objects through a form of X-Ray Vision. In public he goes by The Guest and opposes as a vigilante.

name: Fye Blaunt
description: Hailing from a long line of powerful men and women in the business world, Fye Blaunt grew up only knowing of the world as a contest to see who would conquer it first. Using his unlimited resources, Fye would inject himself with ultraviolet toxins to give him similar abilities. Now going by the name X-Runner, Fye would use his new abilities to take on the business world like no one has ever done before, with Abnormal powers.

name: Don Cenners
description: Considered the fastest man in the world, Don Cenners became the well-known Irish hero Speedster during his early teens just short of leaving boarding school. He developed a sense of passion for speed and adopted many titles in his little town; however the term vigilante became his favorite yet. Risking his life to save others while getting everything he wanted was always a way for Don to live above everyone else.

name: William Eamon Winchester
description: William Eamon Winchester often called W/E Winchester by his business associates. Have always been known as a party boy, using his resources to travel the world finding the hottest clubs and women. One day while visiting a club in Los Angeles, CA, W/E Winchester is attacked by mobsters who knowing of his abilities threaten his life, unknowingly to him, he is able to make a car drive over the mobsters killing them instantly. Finding out that he can control electronic objects through his mind, W/E Winchester would now go by the title Weapon Master.

name: Tracy Darts
description: Discovering her abilities at a young age, Tracy has always been secretive in her life due to not wanting people going after her for her abilities. While on a school lunching in the park, a group of thugs tried to attack a woman. Tracy with no other option used her abilities to throw the criminals across the park showcasing her to her entire study group. From that moment on ironically enough to her, Tracy was adored for her efforts and became somewhat a school idol and heroine.  In one story it spoke of how she became one of the Mentals however this was later dismissed because of her apparent lack of wanting to join any organization.

name: Zon Heart
description: Zon Heart haves the ability to multiply him and objects he imagine. He was told by his grandmother that his ability could one day help the world. This never came to fruition as Zon was killed in 2014.

name: Dylan Page
description: Dylan Page was regarded as a demon because of his black crow like wings. His claws like hands are made of the toughest alloy on the planet. Living in a temple near Timbuktu because of his mutation, Dylan became Black Crow and over time develops the power over black electric bolt from his hands.
abilities: Crow like wings; Metal claws; Black electric bolts from hands

name: Caleb Jenkins
description: Caleb Jenkins was born poor with no real powers of his own. He would create an alter ego that would roam the city looking for crimes and even fighting opponents more powerful then themselves. He uses smoke bombs, a mask, cape, gun, and other weaponry to fight his opponents.

name: Nix Armondi
description: Nix has always been able to read the newspapers in his household without looking at the pages through a form of telepathic reading. He would join SAA at the request of his believing he would be better off in a place where he could develop his abilities.

name: Jackson Vanus
description: Jackson Vanus grew up in suburban living with no knowledge of his true abilities. It wasn’t until he went ice skating with his girlfriend that he realized that he could control the ice around him. Scared to return back to school, Jackson left his parents a note stating that he was leaving for a boarding school to help understand what he has become. Going by the name Silver Ice, Jackson has been one of the quickest learning Descendants toward knowing more about his abilities.

name: Baron Silverman
description: Often arch nemesis to Silver Ice, Dr. Frost has been one of the evilest men alive since the early 1920s. To make sure he lived to see the development of his creation the Ice Titan, Baron Silverman trapped himself in a tomb of ice freezing his body. When he was revived by several researchers, Baron or Dr. Frost realized that he haves power over ice as well. Bent on to destroy his old city, Dr. Frost soon met face to face with Silver Ice of which would become his biggest foe.

name: Ice Titan
description: A creature created by Dr. Frost, it is called the Ice Titan of which it adopted its name from Greek Mythology. Able to appear as a normal human, It was created in 1923 and would take about 40 years to be finished. Hoping to see his creature come to life, Dr. Frost froze himself in chemical ice to only awaken nearly 30 years too late. By this time, the Ice Titan was released from its lab tube and was released onto the Earth. It was defeated in the mid-1980s by the Generals.

name: Nickolas
description: A powerful wizard that practiced black magic so strong that it nearly destroyed the world. Fearing that his magic would go out of hand, the gods banished Nickolas into a dark dimension. However, Nickolas proved to be too powerful for even the gods as he returned now stronger than before and going by the name Titum Comon. Titum Comon became the villain of many hero stories even going as far as to destroy some worlds that he manage to come across. It was until his death by the hand of the Lazarons that Titum Comon became one of the strongest if not a High Level Abnormal.

name: Momita Stanlus
description: Momita appeared at SAA unexpectedly with little knowledge of her past. Momita became known as Liore and contains the power to copy the psychical traits of anyone that she comes in contact with including just watching them do acts like kickboxing.

name: Fredrick Bowles
description: Fredrick is a student at SAA that can control other’s bodies through a form of mimicking telekinesis. He was pictured as a minor character that assisted Elite Force defeat The Bob. Sometime in the future, Fredrick becomes The Ringleader.

name: Kendriana Boke
description: Kendriana has the ability to copy the voice of anyone she hears or comes in contact with. In chapter 16, her abilities grow to where she can learn other languages without knowing there meanings.

name: Taylor Keith
description: During his youth, Taylor Keith could always write without touching a pen. He got through writing papers by just thinking of the words. He wrote his first novel at the age of 20 and later would join SAA as a English Teacher who normally is dislike by his students because of his close age to them.

name: Belinda Mohave
description: One of the most talented musicians of her generation, Belinda Mohave has always had a powerful ability to soothe the hearts of many with flowing music that arises from her skin. She joined SAA as its music teacher at the age of 28.

name: Sue Davis
description: Sue Davis always wanted to be a chef because of her rare ability of Perception Tasting. Her abilities allow her taste anything and know its entire history and tell exactly what it is. Sue used her abilities to open up her own restaurant while moonlighting as a food critic.

name: Lolan Hillary
description: Lolan Hillary became a well advanced opera singer. His parents both worked in theater in Australia at the Sydney Opera Theatre. Lolan was transferred to SAA to become the school’s event planner and often voice speaker. His abilities consist of being able to explode things through singing.

name: Samantha Hillary
description: Daughter to Lolan Hillary, Samantha Hillary was only 3 when she found out that through her voice, she could control others. Samantha would name herself Siren at the age 15 and became somewhat of a villain during her late teens. In most stories she joined forces with Poseidon in his efforts to gain throne over the gods.

name: Selectus Ra’
description:
Age: 3 billion years old

Born with a twin, called the World Destroyer, Selectus who goes as the World Creator help keep the balance of the universe going without much knowledge of their own doings. When Selectus was born 3 billion years ago, he assisted in creating worlds under his own image and when the worlds would stop worshipping him or they grew to old to keep a nourished life, his brother would then destroy them. This constant change in the universal environment allowed such worlds as the Earth to come into creation. Although his stories are mixed with that of the gods creation stories, he is indeed the core responsible for such creation.

name: Daniel Zone
description: Daniel use to work for a power plant that had exploded once exposing his mutant abilities. His new deformed state caused his body to morph into a lizard like creature with an overgrown head. He first showcased his abilities battling the Immortals in a fail attempt against finding a cure in their realm to turn him back to normal. How he got there was through the help of a deity he befriended in Chapter 88. Somewhat throughout his story, Daniel manages to become a doctor, receiving his PhD to learn more about the process of mutation, he then works on a way to reverse it or at least control its process. From his oversized brain, Daniel also called Ravage can release massive blasts of kinetic energy from his body.
abilities: Generate massive amounts of kinetic energy

name: Gallop Polch
description: A scientist, Gallop Polch, dedicated his life on discovering a new world beyond planet Earth. Gallop worked for most of his adult life on a fuel that would grant him advance means of traveling through space, altering reality in the process and creating holographic imagery behind him. He later injected himself with the fuel thus turning him into a meta-human in the process. He would later go by the name Holograph Man and use his abilities to transfer himself and other objects into another plane where everything appears as a 3-D image. Over time, Holograph Man got stuck in this world and he could only come back to his own world in the form of a holograhm.
abilities: Capable of admitting 3-D like images; Projecting objects into 3-D like world

name: Obledius Amon
description:
Age: 3 billion years old

Obledius along with his twin Selectus created and destroyed worlds when they stopped worshipping them and/or when the worlds stop providing nourishment to the life on it. He rides with many followers who themselves were given cosmic powers known as The Cosmic Force.

name: Mitia O’vare
description: Elitshians called her Mitia O’vare with her name meaning “the white lady” because of her bright pale skin, flawless skin, shooting stars for eyes, and appearance so benevolent that even gods can’t look upon her without burning. Only those that worship her or ask to see her can see her true form. Once looked upon, Mitia appears as a woman with fair skin, a vale made of stars, and a dress that flows endlessy across the universe. Not much is known of her history nor of her existence however most believe she is one of the first daughters of The Ultimate Power because of her constant referral to such an idea.

name: Davis Broom
description: During the period where his parents were killed in a bad car accident that rendered him partially paralyzed from the waist down. Davis, during puberty body reached levels of the Earth’s core, burning his flesh off, destroying his bones, and eating away everything but his heart and brain. He became Molt and has since fallen for a human girl name Jessica of whom he later protects on occasion from people wish to harm her to get to him.

name: Seora Binjucki
description:
Age: 15 years old “later stories shows her being 22”

Born from the ashes of fallen Domeadians and Belki, Seora Binjucki has been predicted to bring down Sunshot in an attempt to end the Apocalypse from the destroying the world. Her attempts would come close to being unaccomplished by the Time Pirates in their hopes to dominate a new world. Seora since birth has been raised by a hidden African tribe. Her powers manifested during childbirth and have since reach High level status, tribes and myths around the world calls her true savior of our world. As of the arrival of Sunshot, she is solo and at one time saved the Elite Force.
abilities: Unlimited control over Water; Water based substances; Time Manipulation; Bends light; Dimension Warping

name: Gaven Strong-Pumpelnickel
description:
Abilities: Powers to control all substances of heat

Age: 8 “later stories shows him being 18”

At birth, psychics from around the world predicted his power and the wrath that it would bring. They fortold that his power would end the world unless a being of water could stop him. Gaven was born to Light Wing and Time Control and had power over all fire and heat like substances and was also a High Level Abnormal. His powers also shows him controlling both Time, warping dimensions, and bending light to do almost anything he wishes. He joined his parent’s team when he was 18 years old and has since destroyed most of the world. In one story he mostly kills most of the Elite Force until the gods intervened.
abilities: Can manipulate the sun; Hot stars. Bends light; Time Manipulation; Dimension warping

name: Kenya Williams
description:
Abilities: Can release vibrating pulses throughout the air

Born to scientists, Kenya Williams has always been somewhat of an intelligent young woman learning how to build things at the age 9. Her enhanced intelligence is what led her to a deserted alien space pod in the desserts of New Elitshia. Once discovering it, she manage to find a way to open it and use it to unlock its secrets. Kenya would later learned that a powerful artificat that can control kinetic energy and release pulse vibrating energy throughout the air and throughout the body. She made an outfit and place the artifact on it, her curiosity led to her putting on the suit and later it bind to her body giving her the aforementioned abilities. She became Pulse and from this she became New Elitshia’s new anti-hero.
abilities: Releases Kinetic Energy; Controls; The body

name: Lamar Biding
description: When he was younger, Lamar practice many instruments in school and was one of the most prominent members of his band while in high school. From this, Lamar’s grandparents bought him a drumset that had symbols on it, which represented the Earth and Thunder in ancient Elitshian tribes. Unknowngst to him at the time, these instruments were given to him by his grandparents before their deaths as a way to release his dormant abilities. Because his abilities are normally released, he could only release them using a rod or instrument much like wizards with wands. The drums and other instruments over time would be his weapons against those that wish him and his friends/family harm. He became Trummisen “Swedish for Drummer” once he realize how powerful he has become while fighting evil.
abilities: Can produce powerful thunder; Earthquakes using instruments mostly his drums

name: Greg Robert Gogu
description:
Abilities: Can release acid like strings from his hair; Releases sparkling wave of energy from his body

Dancer, singer, hairstylist, and performer, Greg has been called many things throughout his early childhood, but untalented hasn’t been one of them. Greg traveled New Elitshia and most of the Eastern Hemisphere performing and appearing at numerous events. Once apart of a circus as an orphan hoping to cope with not having knowledge of his family. Greg became Inta “Swedish for dreds” after learning of his abilities which alone has attracted the most attention to the circus. He would then leave after feeling he was to famous to be a joint-star with his circus family. His first gig outside of the circus was working with several singers and other dancers in hopes to become a star. He now lives in Hollywood, CA where his dreams of becoming famous has since become a past dream as he now is a star and at every moment reminds those around him.

name: Archie Pembroke
alias: Arkon, Death Bringer, Minister of Sleep
description:
Abilities: He can control how long the coma lasts for; Can use life energy to extend his own life span

Born in the early 1900s, Archie was born to a priest and gospel singer. His parents were strong believers in GOD and thus passsed on their beliefts to their children. Archie seeing the darkness in people’s hearts and the wars going on at the time, witness to much evil to believe in god and his abilities. So at the age of 5, Archie punished those unwillingly to his own knowledge at the time by placing them in a deep coma. He would appear in many societies as the death bringer or the Minister of Sleep depending on the time frame. All of which timeframes he takes on numerous forms.  Archie would go by Akron “the Elitshian word for, Coma”. Overtime, Akron abilities grew to allow him to control how long people could stay in comas and could use their energies to extend his own life.
abilities: Whatever he touches; He can send into a coma

name: Rina Bulford
description:
Abilities: Can control things by talking to it

Beautiful and outspoken, this subtle lady in black is often seen around rich older men, using her abilities which she learned of as a child to get her way and to keep her in high ranks. She lives in a palace overlooking a vast landscape with over 50 men half nude serving as her welcome servants. Because of her abilities she can also control women, however less frequently. She is often considered a Succubus however she doesn’t drain life energy only the will of others through speaking.

name: Jain Wilcock
description: Born to a farmer and self-proclaim psychic, Jain always knew of her abilities through her mother who told her about her gifts before her death. Jain took this as a gift from her dying mother who she believed wanted her to use it to help others. As time progress, she realizes that people weren’t as welcomed to it in the new world and often considered her a freak. Keeping it a secret for most of her life, Jain eventually started to reach out to others that came to her for her assistance including the Elite Force team. She used her abilities for various reasons including locating missing individuals, talking to spirits, and telling if someone is lying.

name: Sjack Amos
description: Sjack began his story as a young boy with a interests in birds. During his 10th grade science experiment, he used an Eagle’s egg and mixed it with a DNA enhancing chemical which would be used to help the egg become a eagle. The experiment went wrong and caused himself to grown eagle like features and abilities. He is able to speak to all birds and appears as a human like eagle with wings, claws, and sometimes a beak.
abilities: Can talk to any flying creature; Can grow; Retract wings; Can transform into a giant eagle

name: Bryson Eagleheart
description: Bryson began to mutate during his teen years, while in high school Bryson would think of a prehistoric creature at random and transform into the creature at will. At first he could only transform body parts or at least appear in full form and forget his actions while transformed. Now at the age of 17, he can now somewhat control his abilities however they are more limited now that he limits his transformations so that he won’t loose control.
abilities: Can turn into any prehistoric creature

name: Archor
description: During the late 1700s, Archor was created by giant frost Valkens whose experiment crashed on Earth and was slowly forgotten. The Archor body is made of harden ice and human skin, his strength is powered from his boulder like fist. During the early 21st century, Archor awoke and begun destroying the parts of Alaska before the gods and Elite Force intervene. Knowing once he is awakened, he could not be destroyed, the Elitshian Gods and Elite Force fought the creature until the gods could weild him back to Lium. It is said that the creature is trapped in a pocket dimension hidden somewhere in Lium. A prophet predicted that Archor would awake again along with his creators the Frost Valkens and try to place the world in ice.
abilities: Giant ice like body; Power over ice; Frozen water; Super strength; Slow aging

name: Anura
alias: The Great Sondred or The Supreme Sorcerer
description: During her times as a traveling Sondred, Anura has since been known by her high level of magical abilities. She trained throughout the raids of the wizard Merlin and his many followers. She started teaching magic to others during the period of time called the Dark Magic Era to teach others how to defend themselves with the dark forces. Anura left for the Eastern Hemisphere where she discovered an island about the size of Australia hidden by fog. She enchanted it with tall pillars and enchanted everything from trees, plants, the grounds; she even created four dragons out of the four major elementals (Air, Fire, Water, & the Earth) to watch over the island. Over the next 1,000 years, she was confronted by six all powerful beings, a Witch, Warlock, Sondred, Wizard, Shapeshifter, & Fairy to create a school of magic on her new property. She agreed believing it a place to continue the growth of magic. She shortly disappeared shortly after, leaving strands of magic on the island named after her to protect it and allowing all residents and visitors to safe from dying.
abilities: Enhanced Magical Abilities; Protection items; Longevity

name: Behema Thorn
alias: Founder of the House of Thorns
description:
Age: 350 years old, Deceased

Behema Thorn was born into a family of nature loving witches and warlocks. She was green haired with big purple eyes, her skin was pale and she always was seen with some type of flowers and followed by animals of all species. It was believed that she had the power to communicate with animals and that she could control nature around her through the use of spells and enchantments. On her 200th birthday, along with five others, Behema help create a massive school for magical beings and she devoted a hall, known as the Chapter of Thorns to it. She decorated the hall with all types of plantlife even those that were considered to dangerous. She was friends with Wilma Oceen.
abilities: Enhanced magical abilities; A witch; Specializes in magical plants

name: Seth Dragonsworth
description:
Abilities: Can control dragons through a magical sword; Can place anyone to sleep with a magical flute. Limited magical abilities

Age: 325 years old, Deceased

Unlike his parents, Seth was limited when it came to magic but he often made up for it by learning to joust and tame dragons much to his mother’s approval. Often winning his father’s permission to enter in dragon riding championships, Seth was known around the world as a rider of dragons and tamer of the beasts of which his ancestors once tamed. It is said that along with five others, Seth founded the school of Anura and devoted a hall of it known as the Chapter of Drake, name of Dragons in Elitshia.

name: Regina Eyis
description:
Age: 800 years old, status unknown

World renowned for her premonitions, during her many years, Regina was sought out because of her talents, she often appears in the dreams and sometimes visions of other prophets and oracles including Kenya Lazaron in hopes to help the seer to understand their visions and to provide more in depth clues. She was the first to state that all visions are handed down from the High Council and prophets, seers, and oracles were beacons of the visions to the world. Along with five others, Regina founded the School of Anura and donated a hall to it called the Chapter of Eyis.

name: Daugus Shade
description:
Age: 430 years old, Deceased

Once friend to Regina Eyis and Seth Dragonsworth, Daugus grew tired of the two and their constant rightenousness. After assisting with creating the School of Anura and donating a hall to it known as the Chapter of Shade. Duagus became known as the Master of Shadows, he resented the school and what it became and the other five founders so much that he launched war among them to take the school over. This proves unsuccessful as they vanquished him or so they believed until his descendant appeared at the school and tried to destroy it. His descendant also failed and Daugus returned to the land of the living through his attempt and is believed to be somewhere hidden in the black Forest.  Duagus was the once holder to the Cloak of Shadows, which now has been given to the School of Anura.
abilities: Power to control the shadows; Use them as weapons; Enhanced magical abilities

name: Wilma Oceen
description: Wilma Oceen and her family lived somewhere in the middle of the Indian Ocean and her lifestyle was heavily influenced by the culture there. Her family was from Ancient India and from there they left behind 6,000 years of history. With her love of the ocean and its lifeforms, a fellow Sondred, her parents encouraged her to learn to communicate with the lifeforms so that she can get a true feel of the ocean culture that lived below. She did and for centuries, she learned the language and presented it to other lifeforms around the globe. Her and five others founded a school for magical beings like themselves and she donated a hall to the school called the Chapter of Oceen.
abilities: Magical Abilities; Can talk to Aquatic lifeforms

name: Kenton Cusage
