description: Kenton died almost 300 years ago and has since been chosen by Montum to deliver souls to the underworld much to his hatred of his job, Kenton does it in hopes that Montum will spare his wife’s soul. Because of his abilities of immortality and quick regeneration abilities, Montum figured that Kenton would be a good person to deliver souls back and forth to Onur. Kenton’s wife died while the two was boating through the Amazon River, but because of his regenerative abilities he was spared.

name: Sheila Bankman
description: With no relation to Ghostman, Sheila Bankman began her journeys as Spirit Woman after she came across an alien spacecraft that provided her with supernatural abilities and nearly ghost like appearance and features. Her skin turned pale and she attracted powers similar to those of a ghost including Telekinesis, flight, transparency, intangibility, strength, agility, and mind control. She encountered the Elite Force and nearly defeated them all with one attack. When she is in her ghost form her heart stops and she becomes near death.
abilities: Telekinesis; Flight; Transparency; Intangibility; Strength; Agility; Mind control

name: Bonji Amanhi
description: Bonji Amanhi was born in the dessert. Left there by his mother in an attempt to kill him by thieves who invaded the area often. However, the attempt was thrawted by the boy when he was able to stop the men by breaking their bones through his own mind. He appears like a boy with middle eastern descent and bone like fractures around his body.

name: Dethora Zanchis
description: A powerful psychic that went into hiding over 13 years prior. Since then the girl has had to find a way to pay for her expenses. Since her hiding she has paid her way to find secrecy. Her actual appearance is unknown and not even the E.L.I.T.E originization. She is believed to be one of the most powerful psychic recorded in over 20 years.

name: The Vedendo
description: Found in a white room somewhere in Oceania under 100ft of water. No one knows of its gender, name, age, or appearance. Some believe its existence is to keep a watch on the world and guide it through visions given to other psychics from its own mind. It believes that it was sent to Earth to provide information from its home to psychics on Earth.
abilities: Clairvoyance; Can send visions to all psychics; Levitation; Psionic fields around body/perimeter

name: Sebastian Gage
description:
Abilities: A magical book that predict the future

Age: unknown (appears 16)

He thought he was like everyone else. Young, knowledgable about the things around him. He was outcast however, bullied, a loner. It wasn’t until his teen years when he begun to write stories about creatures and different worlds. Adding in heroes, gods, angels, and demons. He grew older and turned those stories into movies and great works of art. Sebastian didn’t know however was that everything he was writing was real or at least similar to actual things and events in reality. That he remembering something that was told to him long before he even knew who or what he was.
abilities: Projection; Clairvoyance; Magical writing; Reincarnation; Skilled fighting; Healing

name: Villia Brooking
description: Villia was a young girl when she discovers her descendant gene. She would speak when angry and thus loud burst could level an entire city. She always wanted to be a scientist. Using her knowledge, she created a mask that could help her control her abilities and a suit which could help amplify her abilities at will. She gave herself the name Atomic Girl in honor of her love for science.
abilities: Creates atomic blasts from her screams

name: Grander Smith
description:
Abilities: Manipulates massive screeching soundswaves through technological gloves

Born in a time of great famine and war, Grander developed a high tolerance for pain and manipulation. His parents were killed in front of him and their ghosts haunted him until he hit puberty. He later came to assume he was destined for hardship. He whipped himself each night for obedience and to build his tolerance for pain and abuse. During his adolescent years he met a girl name Abbie, of whom he would marry and then kill out of insanity. In his adult years, he murdered their three children thinking they were demons, when his insanity continued he met a shaman from India which embowed him with immortality. This was to punish him for his wrongdoings. When he turned 90 still appearing in his 30s, he turned to death again only to be denied. He became Geist once he learned that his immortality came with other abilities thus calling himself the name of a spirit.

name: Ra-leef
description:
Abilities: Power to create gateways to different worlds

Age: 59 (deceased, died over 700 years ago)

An ancient being that gave his suit down to the tribe of the Gamuga people. During his reign as their first king, he was endowed with the power to travel between dimensions by the gods. Believing that he was chosen because of his heritage as king. For a while he believed that he wasn’t worthy to carry it until he saved his village from a reign of bad guys that promised to destroy the crown. On his death bed, Ra-leef took to his local shaman to cast out his abilities into an object to be given to his people for protection and relief. The suit eventually made it to Distort.
abilities: Times; Planes of existence; Enhanced fighting skills

name: Kintalia Days
description: Kintalia has always been in love with insects since she was a young girl. One day a science experiment caused her to actually get the power of a spider. Throughout the nights, she would use her newfound abilities to train and eventually become the Atomic Spider. Her suit consists of liquid acid to protect her from high and very low altitudes. Although she is unaware of it yet, her experiment was actually meant to happen.
abilities: Abilities of a spider; Creates webs from her body; Can see into the dark; Enhanced strength

name: Yamu Ohishuta
description:
Abilities: Suit that can be used as a gateway to different worlds

Yamu was visiting his home in the Gamuga, Africa where he discovered that he was enchanted by his local shaman to carry the suit of Ra-leef. With it he can use his body to transport anything anywhere including to different dimensions. It is believed that his suit contains a magical essence to serve as a gate to different worlds.

name: Camen Zuuts
description: Born to very rich parents, Camen has always enjoyed the high life. Until one day his parents died leaving him without much options as all of their money was borrowed and he lost everything. He later grew up in an orphanage and disappeared later. Reappearing as the Evolving Leech a primary villain to the Atomic Spider.
abilities: Can absorb energy; Release it through his hands

name: Banyald Graye
description:
Age: 64 years old (deceased, lived during the 1700s)

During the 1700s a group of bandits carried out a plan to take over a small town south of the Mississippi River. However, one man stood up to them and his name is Banyald Graye. Given a whip that is supernaturally charged by negative energy to rid the town of the bandits. Banyald made it his goal to defend his home and safeguard the secrets of the shadow like beings that provided him the whip from which the town holds their deepest secret.
abilities: Supernaturally charged whip; Skilled weapons master

name: Alim Makayas
description: With no superpowers, Alim has taken over the Elite City Low Lands with his wealth and quick talking ways. Becoming a major villain in his own right, Alim has an entire army on his side.

name: Low Land Fighters
description:
Age: Varies

A group of skilled fighters who wear leather and metal suits. To join their legion, one must kill someone when asked by the Central Lord on command and show that he or she has the skill to fight off three of their future brethren.

name: Michael Lendinhall
description:
Age: 29 (died in the early 1700s after the war, deceased as of 2016)

Born in the 1700s, Michael Lendinhall was given an exterrestial suit to help defend America during the war. He was given instructions during the war with then President George Washington who instructed him to take on the mantle of a soldier to become less obvious to the opponents. The origins of where the suit came from remains a mystery to everyone.
abilities: Super strength; Agility; Inpervious shield; Sword; Giant gun with perfect shot; Bullet proof suit

name: Dymos
description:
Abilities: Has unlimited powers while in his own dimension

Age: Old as human creation

A mysterious being that can open doorways into an unnavigable realm. This place has been home to those that can move between worlds even for just a moment. This dimension is a place where every dimension meets although it has no open doorways. The being has since existed since the dawn of creation and its powers are said to have extended to allow others the ability to move through dimensions making him the reason behind many to be able to teleport.
abilities: Can open doorways to different dimensions; Levitation of other objects

name: Kylur
description:
Abilities: Can absorb time to direct it at a specific object or person

Age: Old as time itself

During the moment time was created, this creature was created to observe it. Shecknurd knew of its potential and gave it to the other gods as a peace offering to stop Mostibik. However, this failed, and Craze was sent to Oblivion still managing to continue its mission at observing time. From there it can manipulate others and different dimensions.

name: Kerry Wilton
description:
Age: 36 (deceased as of 2016)

Neglected by his sense of duty and cause for complete domination of anything and anyone that he considers a threat to him or his plans of dominance in taking over the world. Kerry took on the persona Skullface to continue his training under the evil organization.
abilities: Enhanced fighting skills; Abnormal strength; Skilled gunsman

name: Dama Rhodes
description:
Abilities: Ever growing hair that is sharp like a sword; Uses hair as a weapon. Screeching screams

A mischief maker in disguise, Dama took to her powers early on and created the persona Blonde Psycho in her attempt to disrupt the women’s movement in the early 1950s. Making numerous TV appearances and news headlines across the world, Dama became the first published superhero person in modern history since the 1800s.

name: Zohait Misunkitahowke
description:
Age: 19 (died in late 1400s, deceased as of 2016)

An early superhero that was remembered because of dazzling appearance and powers with light. Zohait was born in Africa and came to Elite City in hopes to escape her poverish situation. During the late 1400s, Zohait manage to get a job in Elite City escaping the racist woes of other countries, something that wasn’t a major problem throughout Elite City.
abilities: Omits light balls; Daggers; Other objects made of light

name: Jenla Canes
description:
Abilities: Has super strength. She also uses nut like bombs which she made

Age: 3 (appears as a 26-year-old)
Note: human name

A collection of squirrels that when combined can turn into one mischievous villain that uses her powers to scatter poisonous venom across Elite City. She appears like an anamorphic squirrel with human traits. Her history shows that she was several squirrels that were exposed to toxic that leaked into their home, causing them to be able to mutate together and become one being. How this happened is still a mystery as well as where the toxic came from.
abilities: Squirrel like traits; Enhanced hearing; Sight; Agility. Can control other squirrels; Can eat through almost anything; Can climb; Releases from her belt

name: Billy Wysick
description: A pest control manager in Elite City, Billy was working a normal shift when he was exposed to a venomous rat that turned him into Rattrap. Since then he took on the mantle to become one of the newest villains to Elite City and frequent ally to Canine and others with similar animalistic personalities.
abilities: Enhanced strength; Rat like attributes; Night vision

name: Venule Strain
description: Venule placed on his first dog suit as a gimmick to be a goofy villain. He took on the mantle seriously after the Elite Force destroyed his home during one of their battles. He started by robbing a few banks just to get the Elite Force attention. Then it went mainstream after the Rainbow Squad made a personal attack on him because of his racist comments in recent media.

name: Jacobi Smithson
description:
Abilities: Can move time differently around him. Slowing time for his effects

Age: 38 (in the 1920s, deceased in the year 2016)

Once originally apart of Shecknurd’s elusive team of time gods. Jacobi turned to deity in an attempt rescue a mortal woman that he loved while back in time. Shecknurd declared it was too dangerous to tamper with history as it was told that she became a successful doctor that saved countless lives while being stranded in the past. When he attempted to travel back to the early 1920s to rescue her, Shecknurd blocked him from ever coming back through the gates of time. Feeling betrayed and unforgiving, Jacobi became a notable villain and often foe to many heroes. After the woman of his dreams died, he became a notorious hitman and constant con man.

name: Joe Mcintyre
description:
Age: 41 (in the 1860s, deceased in the year 2016)

During the early 1860’s a great academist name Joe Mcintyre proved his theory that he could manipulate animal DNA and produce an effect that can cause animals to speak human language. Also for animals to walk and act like humans. However, one day his experiment went wrong and his experiment mutated his body causing him to become the Alligator Man. One of the earliest mutated villains, he took this apparent moment to use his experiment to make others like himself producing a worldwide range of villains resembling animals.
abilities: Super strength; Giant claws; Alligator like attributes; Acid from claws

name: Gamus Jones
description:
Age: 43 (in the 1870s, deceased in the year 2016)

Joining Joe Mcintyre while spending his time in America. Gamus used his scientific know how to produce his own variation of the serum that made Alligator Man into the Jumping Marvel. Over the years, he battled with the constant neglecting of his fellow peers turning him into what he became.
abilities: Enhanced agility; Can jump really high; Can stick onto walls; Frog like attributes

name: Kyle Revins
description:
Age: 70 (deceased as of 2016)

A born astronaught, Kyle Revins has been looking for the opportunity to go into space since he was a young boy seeing his first telegraphed space mission. Since then he worked hard in school and went into the space program in hopes to get to go to the moon. His dreams would come true, on his first mission to the moon, he became the first Elitshian person into space. While on the moon, he came across a weird glowing rock which when touched gave him powers from another galaxy. A mysterious symbiote attached to his body and he was granted alien powers. On his return, the citizens of Elitshia praised him and granted him with gifts and has since lived the life of a rich guy. While at night he became known as Sunburst a new superhero trying to learn more about his powers.
abilities: Super strength; Suit that grants lazer beams; Ability to understand any language; Speed; Protective against psychic attacks

name: Son Chi
description: Son grew up watching his favorite all time hero Sunburst, use his powers to become a staple of superheroes. Part of a distinct traditional family, he thought that he would never get to see his dreams come true as anything other being a dentist or a doctor was just a pipe dream. One day he came across a hurt Sunburst, eagered to help in anyway he could, Kyle Revins told him that the alien power needed to live on and couldn’t die with him, so he gave the power to Son and Son became known as Supernova in return. Continuing his heros dream and taking up the mantle. He continues to study hard during the day while becoming a hero at night.
abilities: Super strength; Suit that grants lazer beams; Ability to understand any language; Speed; Protective against psychic attacks

name: Salazar Bain
description: Salazar Bain best known as one of the creators of Hizirinth. Was one the direct competitor to the Founders of Tantirith as he wanted to be known as the greatest dragon slayer in history. He was eclipsed when the Dragon Tamer came about and fought him to a standstill. He disappeared shortly after that. His appearance was that of a tall brute man with spiky back hair and a whip that could control dragons.
abilities: Whip that can control dragons; Omit fire from mouth

name: Gildred Du’Change
description: Gildred Du’Change is one of the founders of Hizirinth. She was a cold woman that used her powerful black magic to place an entire village on ice. She specialized in ice magic and whenever she was confronted she would start a blizzard to increase her own magic while in battle. She disappeared shortly after Hizirinth was built.

name: Malcom Bloodspell
description: Malcom Bloodspell was known for his use of deadly poisons that were banned from across Tier. He dislikes that his most prized animals were being hunted and killed although they were responsible for nearly 400 deaths during a 20 year time frame. For his play in raising and training the animals, he was placed to death by lethal injection of his own poison. He died smiling while stroking one of his creatures of which was buried with him.

name: Countess Bruig Strife
description: Countess was a beautiful woman who was adored by many across her lovely reign. She always smiled but lied a dark secret beneath. She had over 15 abortions and only kept the most powerful child. She slept with numerous men and housed a place for women to sell their children for profit. She fell in love with only man, Daugus Shade. The two met at her house of abortions and she swayed Daugus to betray his friends and help build a school for delinquent magical beings, she was joined by others and founded Hizirinth.

name: Virginia Jones
description: Often a lone hero that was one of the few black superheroes during the 50s, 60s, and 70s. Never married, Virginia was mother to four children, one of which would birth The Electrician a great hero himself. Virginia died during a fight with Dr. Combustion while saving her daughter. She was 99 years of age at the time of her death, a memorial service and statue was made in her honor in Marion, South Carolina.

name: Clea Mainstay
description: Appearing temporary in the Elite Force, Lightstorm began doing missions on her own after saving a boy from a burning building after the larger team was too busy to notice him. This wanted Clea to want to take on missions that involved the community and not major battles that often ignored them.
abilities: Light based abilities including absorbing light; Flight; Mild radiation blasts; Light shields; Immunity to radiation

name: As Shadowstorm
description: A vigilante that has the complete opposite powers to Lightstorm that appears during the attack on the city caused by the Akuma’s arrival. This version disappeared back to her own universe once the veil separating the realities began to be repaired.

name: Audilane Richards
description: Bronx is the often villain to Lightstorm when she is fighting crimes on the streets. She is brute, strong, and has hard diamond skin. She is usually ordered by others to fight or steal.

name: Ambrosius Riveton
description: Bullied since he was a child, Ambrosius possessed an incredible power that grew inside of him since his teenage years. Hiding his anger became less of an option in his 30s. When one day Ambrosius started to experience frequent dreams of a powerful being that once was born from the primordial darkness. Whispers filled his head with thoughts of destroying the world and its people after feeling abandoned and hated by them. It was later discovered by the Primordial Fighters that Ambrosius is one of the reincarnated forms of the Creation Chaos that was banished by GOD during the birth of the universe. Ambrosius succeeded with destroying the Earth until his own destruction by Elshack, when Ambrosius, now the new Chaos killed GOD and the Neither in their lesser forms. Elshack recreated GOD and the Neither and destroyed that universe where Ambrosius inhabited in hopes to stop the rise of other Chaos avatars from being born.
abilities: Primordial chaos; Omnipotence; Cosmic power; Power to destroy the Creation Trio

name: Chuck Samuel
description: An avatar of GOD that appeared in Universe 908 as a figure that destroyed several realities before setting his attention on Universe 908. He was stopped by a powerful Nephilim and two hunters.
abilities: Powers of GOD; Omnipotence; Capable of destroying entire realities

name: Gregory Pines
description: Blind since birth, Gregory has always had keen senses, capable of moving as if he was able to see the world around him. Because of a red tint in his lower pupil, Gregory developed the ability to see the world in a red tint, with red the only color he can see. To disguise his red colored eyes, he often wears dark red tinted shades. Gregory adapted the title Owlman after stopping a gang of street thugs from attacking and raping a young woman in the alley by his job.

name: Marshall Streets
description: Marshall Streets is a mob boss that lives in Elitshia and has since created a large following because of his ruthless business practices. Because of his large size weighing in at almost 500lbs, he is sometimes seen sitting in an electric chair. When he stands and fights, his strength is known to be more powerful than many superheroes and street level people. He has a cane that is also a gun, a cape that is bullet proof, and wears shades that can feed him information about a person and/or object. He is often the villain to Owl Man.
abilities: Enhanced human strength; High advance gadgets

name: Lana Kane
description: A great martial artist trained at a Buddhist temple when she escaped from the world she knew. At the temple, Lana adopted the moniker Lana Row from her birth name Lana Kane to help stop criminals in mainland China. She returned to Elitshia when her mother and brother died in a gang related violence. She began protecting her neighborhood from street criminals and gang leaders.

name: Itchira Cho
description: Lady Scorpion is a venomous person that developed a serum that allowed her to develop scorpion like abilities including venomous acid from her saliva and fingertips. She oversees a large gang of street thugs that terrorizes the neighborhood of Lana Row. She is the main villain of Lana Row.

name: James Wilderson
description: After the Akuma was destroyed, James woke up with supernatural abilities to be able to astral project himself across great distance, he also gained super strength. With his development, James became the vigilante that fought the rich for the poor, thus adopting the title J Hood as a dialect of Robin Hood.

name: Ms. Janina Thompson
description: Looking for powers of her own. Ms. Janina Thompson created a vast organization to gather superpowers and super powered individuals for her own purposes and profit. Janina is the main villain of J Hood and two often clash with their conflicting interests.

name: Teen 8
description: Teenagers with extraordinary powers. They formed to fight back evil doers in their home city.

name: Solland Grocha
description: Solland Grocha was born a rogue as his parents died in a car crash. Since then Solland became known as Bi-polar and used his abilities of Light and Shadows to save others like himself. He joined Synthia (Lavagirl) to become Teen 8.

name: Vince Jagins
description: Vince was apart of his bodybuilding club in school and could lift up to 100lbs making him the strongest teen in the world. He would then use his abilities to fight against the dark forces however unlike his friends; he would also attend college in attempt to appear normal and to finish his education.
abilities: Muscle body w/glowing neon body; Super strength

name: Synthia Hedwick
description: During one of the moments of the raid in Elite City, Synthia Hedwick was one of the many super-powered humans that were captured by The Enforcers for the Anti-power Act. During her late teens, Synthia became Lavagirl and would travel Elite City finding others that are sought out by the Enforcers.
abilities: Power over Lava; Turn body to lava

name: Shae Shaman
description: Born in Mermadia, Shae traveled to Elite City nearby one day while curious about the world above. Alongside several others, Shae was the only one not to return after being caught by The Enforcers. Rescued by Teen 8, Shae became known as Sea Lad and would be one of the only members of the group that leads the group while on mission dealing with water or traveling over seas.
abilities: Ability to breath under water; Talk to sea creatures

name: Richa Rintenin
description: Richa traveled around the globe with her parents, unable to stay in one spot because of her slowing aging process, Richa finally gave up traveling after meeting the Teen 8 and joining their ranks to help save others like herself. Her family supports the group with funds such as their very own tower erected on a mountain near Elite City.

name: Glenda Ralph
description: Along with the other Teen 8 members, Glenda was cast out by the Enforcers who believe her to be a danger after she supercharged cannon on a ship to destroy their personal home base. She escapes their grasp and left to join Teen 8 in hopes to bring them to destruction.
abilities: Enhances attacks; Shoot blasts from body

name: Teen Hero Squad
description: Products of an experiment by the Nexus Corp, these teenagers were given powers representing the elements. They were given secret identities and tasked with fighting the enemies to the Nexus Corp.

name: Troy Ressin
description: Troy was captured by the doctors at Nexus Corp. at the age of 10 stolen from his parents who later stopped looking for him presuming he was dead. Since then Troy thought of ways to escape by using his ever growing abilities. Once a fellow teenager joined the doctors’ lab experiments, Troy assisted in their escape and shortly after returned to his family while also creating the group with Jasmine “Firecracker” known as the Teen Hero Squad and himself Lightning Boy because of his abilities over Lightning like beams.

name: Erica Danes
description: Erica always wanted to be a hero; she even went to the lengths of leaving her parents camp grounds one summer to stop hunters from killing a deer. While in the forest, Erica came across a mysterious circular object which gave her the ability of water through the form of bubbles. Over time keeping it a secret, Erica by the name of Bubble Girl would fight crimes while going to high school. At one time in the near future, Bubble Girl joins the ranks of a group of fellow high schoolers with special abilities named the Teen Hero Squad.

name: Jasmine Olson
description: Captured by several doctors who found out about her abilities, Jasmine learned how to fight for herself at the age of 12 and fought to return to her parents. While captured, Jasmine met with Troy who together helped her free herself and him from the doctor’s control. The doctors were found out to work for Nexus Corp creating the group’s first arch enemy. Later the two would become Firecracker & Lightning Boy.

name: The Almighties
description: Called the Almighties because of their raging powers and deadly consequences of their actions have made them a threat to many on Earth and elsewhere.

name: The Almighties
description:
Age: Varies

High deities who are believed to have existed before the gods. They are considered one of the many children of the Ho’zares and siblings to the Domaedians. Their pale orange skin symbolizes their home world of Kree and its orange like structures and landforms. The Almighties as they are called by Elitshians are powerful monks that created the balance of good and evil and set forth the many laws of the universe and preset many rules that are followed by many beings of both good and evil. Of such stories it is said that they created the curse amongst vampires and werewolves or at least assisted in it. A vampire and werewolf are weak amongst the day while strong at night, however their weakness would be of each other as vampire blood can kill a werewolf and a werewolf’s claws and bite can kill a vampire. They live in a plane existing in Olerta’s ancient realm and watches over the realms by her side.
abilities: Advance knowledge of the universe; Star manipulation; Force fields; Mental blasts; Elemental control

name: Aerkelium
description: Working for the Almighties since ancient times, Aerkelium has been featured in many fan fiction across the world including inspiring ancient stories including the idea of Heracles in ancient Greek. His long hair is like iron and his skin is as tough as he is strong.
abilities: Super Strength; Invulnerability; Immunity to human diseases

name: The Ancient Circle
description: Considered ancient benevolent descendants whose powers contain some of the darkest magic in existence.

name: Asjan Rufhar
alias: The Ancient Word or Word King
description:
Abilities: Can make anything come true by writing it into a book

Chosen as a young child to protect his people, Asjan was given a magical book handed down from Bewithia that would grant his people the power to protect their homelands in return their loyality to the witch goddess. Asjan was given the book, with his people believing that he has magical abilities to make anything that he writes happen, something that usually of the direct descendants in the village of Bewithia held. After the last descendant died and no other was born, Asjan took the responsibility. He would later join The Ancient Circle that watch over all magic under the guidance to Bewithia. After the Ancient Circle started to abuse their abilities for evil, Asjan left and went to become a powerful wizard of his own right.

name: Imtut Kunoman
alias: Imtut or God of the Dead
description:
Abilities: Magically bestowed aspects of mythological figures that include Abnormal strength

Born from the ashes of the human race that lived before our current existence. Imtut showcased strong power in both strength and magical attributes. With his many items in his arsenal, Imtut uses his abilities to control the dead in hopes to revive the dead, taking his once love, Nokosha as his bride. Together it is predicted that the two will rule over the new world and banish the old world underground. In an alternative timeline, Imtut is the God of the Dead while in another he is one of the few remaining members of the Ancient Circle.
abilities: Speed; Stamina; Physical; Magical invulnerability; Flight; Fearlessness; Vast wisdom; Enhanced mental perception

name: Guy Gordon
description: Guy Gordon was born to a poet and a singer so being in the limelight was always something that he adored as a child. However growing up his moral changed and he begun wanting adventure so he help create several advance weaponry including a highly advance bow & arrow with a metal plated armor. He became the Silver Archer and joined the other Archers.
abilities: Highly advance armor w/bows; Gun; Arrows

name: Armen Howell
description: The Golden Archer has been one of the most talked about heroes in the late 1990s. With his highly advance technology, Armen Howell uses technology type bows, arrows, and armory to defend the city he grew up in. Over a course of time, Armen would go by the title Golden Archer along with several other recruits to form the Archers.

name: Billa Banks
description: Billa Blanks worked for Armen Howell on a number of projects including the one with creating the highly advanced Archers. Billa would use that same technology for her own armor, bows, and arrows to help defend the city she and Armen grew up in.

name: Robert Imoff
description:
Abilities: Contains special arrows that can do various activities including exploding

During his teen years, Robert created his alter-ego Black Arrow while stealing things under the title. He would then create a small league of vigilantes who would still priceless artifacts all while under the appearances of the 901 year old Roven Holden “The Original Robin Hood” as he is called. Robert has two children and his wife is also one of the Arrow League members. His team is famiously called The Arrow.
affiliates: The Arrow League or The Arrow; The Arrow League

name: Vile Pembrook
description:
Abilities: Part human with arrows coming from his hands with explosive mechanical enhancements

When he was 16, Vile was in a severe accident that almost cost him his life until a weird man saved him. He never saw the man once he awoke but it is believed that when he woke part of his body was destroyed and his parts replaced with robotic body parts and was done by the hands of the mysterious man. After years of traveling, he came across Robert and shortly after joined the Arrow as a theif.
affiliates: The Arrow League or The Arrow; The Arrow League

name: Crystal Dixon
description:
Abilities: Giant Arrows with several techniques including tracking

Although originally a soccer mom, when her husband Robert Imoff begun recruiting for a secret team of bandits for a get rich scheme. Crystal then thought it best to make ends meat and protect her family by collecting artifacts on her own. One mission she created her costume and went by Red Arrow in honor of her husband. Unknowngst to him at the time, Robert later found out after running into Crystal at a bank robbery.
affiliates: The Arrow League or The Arrow; The Arrow League

name: Frank McGee
description: Before joining the Arrow, Frank McGee was a skilled inventor often creating weapons for the rich or anyone that paid him a great amount of money. Frank was sought out for his skills and eventually becoming very wealthy for it. He was in and out of jail several times throughout his youth and often stole to finance for his inventions. Frank joined Robert mostly for the fun and excitement of traveling and robbing those that are often rich
affiliates: The Arrow League or The Arrow; The Arrow League
abilities: Long arrows with unbreakable steel; Explosive points on the tips

name: Roven Holden
description: At the age of 901 years old, Roven Holden first met his destiny at the hands of a witch which was later found to be Bewithia, who gave him his abilities. Roven Holden inspired the original Robin Hood stories created by William Langland and several others afterwards. For the next 800 and so years after he was given his abilities, Roven went by several names including Robin Hood, Robun Hood, etc all to disguise his true appearance and to disguise the fact that he doesn’t age. In the 21st century, he would inspire Robert Imoff to create the Arrow League. He often watches over them and guides them as he thinks they are exactly how he was during his years as a bandit for the poor however in a more modern twist.
affiliates: The Arrow League or The Arrow; The Arrow League
abilities: Slow Aging; Enhanced healing factor; Supernatural arrows

name: The Balancers
description:
Age: Varies

The balancers are powerful entities that live beyond time itself, they often travel to the realm of Olerta to assist in keeping balance with our current dimension. In some instances most believe that they spread out Olerta’s word across the galaxies and across timelines to insure that everything gets put into place so as if time is not disrupted. Neither is shown apart as they appear as beams of light that share one face. Many think that Secreta are one of them because of her unlimiting powers however it was discovered that she exist before them and beyond their realm.

name: Smith Lee
description: Cousin to Victoria Lee, Smith like his cousin possess no abilities of his own however he has a gun called the Barrell which can shoot giant cannon ball like objects that once explode can destroy massive amounts of land at one time. The gun itself is about 10 feet tall and Is said to have been made by Valken. Smith created the Bounty Hunters in a mission to defeat his enemies feeling that he would never be able to stop them alone nor keep running.

name: Victoria Lee
description: Victoria has always been known for her sex appeal, appearing in revealing outfits and long color changing hair, although she doesn’t possess abilities of her own, her skilled martial arts has been one of the reasons she was abducted as part of the Bounty Hunters. She carries the Shigunku Sphere which can cut through any man made object and pierce through demon skin. Her hair is sharp and contains a mineral that is harder than steel and is often used during her fights.

name: Jane Lurow
description: Oldest of the group, she is also the wisest, believed to be descendant to Valken and Authora, Jane has the ability to create icy winds and blizzard like weather powers. Jane was last to join the bounty hunters and only joined to avenge her daughter whom was killed in their backyard by reptilian enemies of the bounty hunters.
abilities: Icy Winds; Blizzard like Weather powers

name: Kenneth Ulridge
description: Born to a fugitive and skilled swordswoman, Kenneth has been trained since birth as a skilled bounty hunter and the first member of the Bounty Hunters to be assigned. He is seen with long blonde hair with spiked edges and armor like robe. Like his mother, he carries the Bigusku Power Blade which can absorb attacks. He has healing factors that can also make him very hard to defeat in a battle.
abilities: Healing Factor; Slowed aging; Bigusku Power Blade

name: Brad Dobson
description: Known for his skilled gunsmanship, Brad can shoot anything within almost a 100 mile radius. He contains skin that is bulletproof and can also be used as armor itself. Called Cutthroat because of his aggressive nature and sharp tongue, he joined the Bounty Hunters in a route to kill those that killed his family when he was a kid.

name: Jennie Ore’
description: Cursed by a powerful magician, Jennie was born over a thousand years ago. Living most of her life as a Genie serving others, she joined The Captains in hopes to break the curse and one day to be free. Her powers range from magical spells to powerful acrobatic skills. In one vision by the Oracle, she was born to powerful royalty and lived her youth in peace until she fell for a black magician that placed this curse upon her.
abilities: Magical Abilities; Wish Granting; Enhance acrobatics

name: Jaxun Fifth
description:
Abilities: Can gain the powers of any animal that exists or has existed on a planet

Similar to the Ancient Circle, The dark circle consists of Jaxun and several members that exist primarily to keep magic secret and balance between the realms. However the Dark Circle main attention is to steal the power of the Kenoxes and mix it with Secreta in order to take over all realms. If this happens, Jaxun and his Dark Circle would succeed in destroying everything in the universe today and start completely over in their image.

name: Blane Wilkinson
description: Due to a freak accident, Blane’s body became hotter than the inner core of the sun. During his final sighting he nearly destroyed his sister’s home. After being found by several members of the Elite Force, Blane became Fire Blade and learned to control his abilities at SAA. However once he grew stronger and angrier at his accident, Blane decided to inflict the same terror on others joining the cause of the Dark Curse in the process.
abilities: Ability to rearrange the atomic; Molecular structure of matter; Can alter the density of objects; Including his own body; Render them intangible; Can project bolts of nuclear energy; Flight; Absorb explosive force; Radiation in to his body harmlessly

name: Fredrick “Freddy” Prickson
description: Fredrick or Grave King main mission is to reshape the universe; he uses his power over the dead to help push his plan forward. He died centuries ago and was resurrected with powers given to him by an uknown figure which also created the power of the Dark Curse.
abilities: Solid energy construct; Flight; Invisibility; Teleportation; Ability to heal; Reanimates the dead; Resurrection of the dead

name: The Demoys
description:
Age: Varies

The Demoys existed since the early 1100s and shown great power over the dead, from their reign they partially took over the Underworld and watched over the living. Protecting it from the dark forces that leaked from Hell. The Demoys appeared mostly as paled skinned men and women whom had symbols of ancient magic embroided onto their bodies. In the late 1900s, the last Demoy named Wilma met John Watson and the two gave birth to a daughter named Olivia Watson.
abilities: Transparency; Communicate with the dead; Various powers over the dead; Teleportation; Flight

name: Glinda Pennan
description: Glinda Pennan has always been on her own, her main focus was to live alone and die alone. That is until she came across an underground society known as Under City. Here many others with mutations and special abilities were outcast or ran away from their homes and met at this place where Glinda would one day lead it above ground. Destined to make sure the people don’t live in fear anymore, Glinda would soon go by the name Dark Seer because of her abilities to see through the dark and her athletic skills and take the people above ground to take back their cities.

name: Blane Markus
description: Blane was one of the most popular people of his school before his mutation. Always wanting to return to his lifestyle, Blane now a part of the Drones because of his mutation and powers, travels through the upper city to watch over his old peers and family members.

name: Aine Mills
description:
Abilities: Able to trap life forms into inanimate objects

With a unique ability, Aine who also goes by La Capture came from France in search of the Dark Seer to join her team. Knowing of her purpose in life, Aine knew of no other way in life but to fight against those that didn’t want her or others like her around.

name: Deboie’ Hisani
description: Deboie was one of the most deferred soldiers in the Soviet army. His brute strength granted him a place among Elite Force members of his group and could cause him to be placed among the first in fights. Once his mutation caused him to grow incredibly, Deboie left Russia in search of The Drones believing they could help him return to normal. However once at their location Deboie would quickly learn that he was stuck the way he was and that his only home was with the Drones.

name: Yin Lo Chow
description:
Age: Uknown

Yin Lo Chow never knew life outside of the Under City however it didn’t stop him from researching the world. Yin Lo Chow since he was a child could always learn every language he heard and watched on TV.

name: Shira Dome
description:
Abilities: Releases an instant killing disease from her body

Unlike her fellow members of the Drones, Shira is very beautiful uses her looks to help get her brethren things like food, clothing, and other materials to make their lives comfortable. Because of her disease like powers, Shira doesn’t want to take the risk of hurting others unless it means protecting her family in the Under City.

name: Mitchell Wu
description: Born in Under City, Mitchell Wu’s parents were killed when upper city bank robbers mistakenly killed them during a bank heist. Now at the age of 8, Mitchell has developed a unique appearance mostly making his body mud like appearance. His body is able to stretch like liquid and create cement like puddles under objects.
abilities: Mud like body; Mud like puddles

name: Armstrong
description: Armstrong was a gentle scientist that hated being picked on and wanted to make a way to become stronger. He used several chemicals together to make a potion that would make him more powerful, faster, and smarter which in return would turn him into a giant creature with little human emotions. Although he got all of the compounds that he wanted to get, it caused a mutation that didn’t agree with Armstrong’s original plan of fitting in. He went into hiding joining the Drones in the process.
abilities: Transforms between brute giant muscled demon; Scientist

name: Genita Villub
description: Genita’s body is made of pure electrified neon that allows his body to glow intensely. Because of the negative energy that makes his body glow caused children in his school to get headaches. Genita was shipped to SAA by his parents however along his arrival the same thing happen there causing him to run away to Under City and become a part of The Drones.
abilities: Glowing body due to neon energy

name: Belkrow Ridge
description: Belkrow Ridge appears as a normal human with weird signs around his body until one day while angered at school. Belkrow released a wave of sonic energy that nearly killed all the students in his school. To stop himself, Belkrow left to the Under City where he became a part of The Drones.

name: Desdia Buggum
description: Desdia has always been known in the Under City because of her special abilities. Her abilities are similar to fireworks and illuminating flashes in the sky. Her birthday is July 4th and during her birth, the sky lit up like a celebration.

name: Kindley Tetrum
description: Always outcast because of his dinosaur like appearance, Kindley is a super powered human that has great agility and sharp claws.

name: Cala Benjamin
description: Cala joined The Drones after looking around the world to only find out her mother, also a super-human died because of her appearance. Wishing to bring the world to justice, Cala knew her place was in Under City amongst others like herself. She became Stalker after she learned she could know where everyone was located just by knowing their face and name. As she grows older, her abilities allow her to sense things around her and even go to the lengths of blocking out mental attacks on her mind.

name: Zayden Green
description:
Abilities: Giant bulky scaly beast like boy w/sonic blasts

Zayden was born in the Under City with no parents by his side, because of his look he has since only been in the Under City often going to the upper side of the world when the others need his strength and abilities to get food and fight battles. Because of his eyes, Zayden also called Beast Man only can appear at night.

name: Tay Woods
description: Tay Woods was raised by creatures of the forest in Africa. No one knows much of where his parents are or how he came to come about the lifestyle he is in. Tay learned of his abilities after being approached by Ned & Vendra during one of their exhibitions searching for others capable of joining their team. He would then take on the name of Aqua Teen because of his water abilities.
abilities: Power over water; Ability to talk to animals

name: Ned Cohen
description: One of the Elementals, Ned Cohen has always been a brute individual whose personality has caused many to believe him to suffer from bi-polar disorder. To contain his abilities, he wears armor and calls himself Earthshaker.

name: Vendra Poro
description: Vendra has always been angry, especially as a child, one cry would burn down her house. Vendra was then sent away where she learns how to control her abilities through the help of psychics. She joined the Elementals in hopes to take vengeance on her family for sending her away.

name: Christofer Maxendius
description: Born on a distant planet near the Triton galaxy, Christofer Maxendius came to Earth looking for a magical jewel that could save his world from an invasion. However unable to find the jewel on his own, he enlisted several powerful Descendants and named them the Elementals with his own name Element Man.

name: The Entity
description: Siblings to the Star Watchers and children to the Primordial Ones, they are the personification of their respective titles such as Destiny, Death, Time, etc.

name: Destiny
description: Destiny represents the power that can create decisions based off of limitless actions. Destiny appearing as a woman covered in a flowing robe holding a libra scale. Possesses the unique abilities to no someone’s action before they take it without being thwarted by a sudden change in the person’s next or otherwise unplanned risk. She is one of the members of a family known as The Entity.

name: Death
description: Probably the most powerful being of her siblings. She made a remark that “after all is said and done, I will take even The Ultimate Power and his first children to their graves and only I will remain in existence”. With this bold statement, many believed that because of her title, she not only take beings to their respected afterlife but as well take exists during the first death and will be in existence until the last death. Although she can’t die, she can feel pain as seen in Chapter 14 while battling the demon Narxus. Her parent, like many of her siblings are unknown, probably because the only shared link to them is that she refers to The Ultimate Power as her sibling too while considering the other Entities as her siblings. The final chapter, Chapter 100 states she was born from nothing alongside The Ultimate Power, however because of the limitless creation stories of who created her could go on forever, it is often less implied.

name: Mother Time
description: Some what of a foreseer, Mother Time bare the resemblance of a hippy woman dressed in bells and sparkling crystals, while smoking what appears to be a firey comet. Her appearance is inspired by the fact that time is repetitive and shares culture with things that otherwise doesn’t exist in time itself. Although a powerful foe, her existence isn’t as enduring as her family. She is one of the youngest daughters of The Ultimate Power and wife to Father Creation.

name: Life
description: His birth timeframe in the universe is unknown as he would have been born at the creation of his elder siblings Dark and Light or even The Ultimate Power itself. Life stated that he existed at the time of the Ultimate Power’s creation however this has been contradicted stating that his creator created him to give birth to the next creator. Which story is true, is unknown, however it is written and foretold that he along with Death are going to outlast even The Ultimate Power.

name: Father Creation
description: Believed to be one of the first 7 children of The Ultimate Power, Father Creation boasts the powers over all creation, everything within and outside of it is in his utter control. His main goal is to ensure that existence stays in tact. His main enemies are the direct children of Belckus and Belckus himself. When all in existence cease to be, Father Creation will be the remaining being, some believe that he and his siblings Death and Life will be the only three remaining even if the Ultimate Power dies.

name: Rêve
description: Existing long before mankind, Reve was created during the first imagination of the Ultimate Power. From his words, Reve came to life and was one of the 7 beings in existence. It is speculated that in his kingdom all dreamers go to, his castle lies above the Dreomede.

name: Layton Brandon Sr
description: During the great Britain war, he was one of Elite Force generals that help protect Britain from its enemies. No one knew that he attempted this feat through superpowers. Before his final battle, Layton married and had a son name Layton Brandon Jr.

name: Sindia Ogon
description: Sindia was one of the only female Generals, brought up as a fighter and an army brat. Sindia became the Air General after discovering her unique abilities to control the winds.

name: Asheed Balcom
description: Asheed was one of the most formable allies of the Generals, serving as one of them for years, Asheed retired during the early 70s. He continues to fight however not as much.

name: Calcum Totrum
description: Calcum along with his allies, the Generals, fought to save the world after the great World War 2. After retiring at the age of 58, Calcum was known as the Ocean General among his peers.

name: Ambel Page
description: During the battle of the Elite City Union Force against Descendants in the city, Ambel was the first in command over a team called the Black Phoenix and from them he led them into battle against the government. He fought them until his final breath, through the use of black magic he was brought back to life to defend his cause yet again this time under the power of the God’s Club as Roswin.
affiliates: The God’s Club; The God's Club

name: Santel Rice
description: Santel was a great writer that spoke of an upcoming war in his books. He stated that the war would last for almost 3 years and many would die. For years many people thought it to be fiction and adored his work; however no one knew that he was channeling the mind of an oracle at a nearby mountain top known as Melphi. After the first battle against the Elite City Union Force, people begun thinking he was predicting the future or causing the events to happen.
affiliates: The God’s Club; The God's Club
abilities: Abnormal physical attributes Telepathy Telekinesis Animation; Powers

name: Synthia Silon
description:
Abilities: Flawless diamond form impervious to destruction or emotion

Synthia shared the soul with two brothers named the Sun Twins through a cursed by Bewithia. The curse came about when she came across Bewithia torching her village for not worshipping her. Synthia used her powers to stop Bewithia but not without a price, to share her mind and soul with two others that denied Bewithia’s wrath in another city. Synthia joined The God’s Club in hopes to find a way to rid the curse and to stop the Elite City Union from imprisoning Descendants.
affiliates: The God’s Club; The God's Club

name: Inga Old
description: Inga was abducted at a young age to be apart of the Russian gang The Hell’s League. She found out that her ability to create high pitch and explosive sound blasts from her screams allowed her to be a formable foe. Inga would become Screech and as time progress would receive gray hair and a somewhat banshee like appearance mostly because of the sonic rays going through her body.
affiliates: The Hell’s League; The Hell's League

name: Jason Myers
description: Jason Myers died during the 18th century while robbing a house of lords. Because of his leadership, Jason was revived from the dead by Michael Onon hoping that he could continue his leadership over a new army. Michael endowed Jason with the abilities to shoot Energy Beams from his hands while also bearing immortality through a ring.

name: Michael Onon
description: Michael Onon was one of the 7 demons that could come to the living once a year during the 31st of October to collect souls so that they can revive their father “Belckus”. During many attempts, Michael eventually got fed up with serving someone else so once Michael was on Earth on Halloween, he revived several powerful leaders and used their original souls to stay alive. In Chapter 12, Michael revived Oken the most powerful demon in Hell and used his abilities to become immortal and ruled the underworld.

name: Nex Bixtrax
description: While on her rampage throughout southern Europe and most of Africa, Nex was one of the most feared people in the world at that time, she was responsible for the death of several powerful leaders including King Tut. She ruled over thousands by taking over their kingdoms. She was ambushed by her followers and murdered; she was revived by Michael Onon in hopes to join his army. Once revived she was given the abilities to control the dead.

name: Kevin Blackwell
description: In 1901, Kevin Blackwell was considered one of the worlds most feared serial killers, going through several names including Jack the Ripper in London. He was born to a hostel living and watched his father kill his mother and brother while killing himself. Kevin grew up knowing only how to kill and never to love and so he adopted the name Night Killer because of his tactics to kill throughout the night. Kevin killed several security guards while on watch and was later killed that same night in 1931 at the age 59. Michael revived Kevin and provided him with one of the most deadly abilities which was called the death touch, the ability to touch anything killing it instantly.

name: Calsius Dines
description: Calsius Dines was one of several slave owners who were killed during the 1800s raid that made headlines in Southern USA. His death brought much attention to ending slavery and providing equal opportunities to take place. Michael knew of Calsius’s ability to command others and thus gave him great power over Mind Control.

name: Victor Pride
description: Victor Pride was one of the most powerful people in the 1700 and before his death one of the most feared as well. It was believed that his troops discovered a great oil mine that could make him one of the richest men in the world however the mines collapsed on him and his troops. Michael found Victor’s corpse and revived him and gave him the ability to control metal & steel objects. In the year 2020, Victor became one of the most powerful Descendants alive and contained a army more powerful than Elite Force named the Almante.
abilities: Power over Metal; Steel; Flight; Limited Telepathic abilities

name: Disca Reeds
description: Disca was the mistress of many leaders during her time, after killing each of them to gain control over their fortunes, Disca finally met her own fate by the hands of one of her step-children. Disca became the second person that was revived by Michael. Disca joined the Royal Family after the separation of the Immortals in hopes to continue her reign of power. At this point she took upon the Italian name, Diamante.

name: Jisabo Haynes
description: Jisabo was considered one of the strongest men alive, before his death, he could lift mountains if he wanted and was considered a Abnormal before the name was justified 200 years later. Jisabo was revived by Michael as the final piece of the Immortals and given immortality and enhancing his strength. In 2016, Jisabo now called Strong Man joined the Circus Family in hopes to live amongst others that care for him and leave the destructive life behind him.

name: Baemen Sticks
description: Baemen Sticks was born in the mediaeval times and was killed in a violent war. Brought back to life by a powerful wizard that died shortly after to assist in the battle of the angels and demons, Baemen now known by his fans & peers as Wonder Man. Was given the Magical Sword & Shield of the gods to protect mankind and stand up against the dark forces that was challenging the world. He created and leads the Justice Knights.

name: Blur Rad
description: Blur Rad was born in a small island off of the new Delphi. He was both highly intelligent and could turn his body into harden diamond. Known for awhile as the Man of Iron, Blur officially adopted the name of Diamond Boy when he was 16 and kept it since. He protects his village from harm and occasionally assists in fights with The Justice Knights.

name: Sage Starter
description: Sage Starter has been loyal to his country since the early 1400s. During his last battle he was killed and he was buried where now a church in his honor stands. Through a powerful wizard that is now dead, Sage came back to life now known as his hero name Romen and weilds the Magic Armor & magical weapons and is apart of the Justice Knights.

name: David Arnold
description: David Arnold was one of the most athletic guys in his high school and even in college and most thought him to be abnormal. He would then join the national football league however was dispelled after word got out about his abilities over light which allows him to travel at speeds faster than anyone on the planet. After being cast out of society, David would become Light Racer and would join the Justice Knights where he felt he would be needed and no cast out.

name: Trance Lee
description: During the great war of North and South Korea, Trance Lee was one of the suspected spy of the opposing country. Outlawed and hunted down to be killed by both countries, Trance realizes he was framed and set out on a mission to find those responsible. On one of his missions he finds a magical artifact in Cairo, Egypt that granted him with a powered golden armor. With this armor he would be granted eternal youth, the gift of flight, and highly intelligent weaponry. In another mission he would go by the name Golden Justice and join the Justice Knights.
abilities: Golden Armor with enhanced intelligence; Flight; Weaponry; Eternal youth

name: Redge Arnamen
description: In the year 1621, Redge Arnamen fought bravely in the war against the demons that was plaguing his village. A year later he met his death by the hands of the demon army’s leader. In the year 2011, Redge was brought back to life and was tought about the new world and how to survive in it. For his bravery in 1600, Redge would be honored the Sword of Volcanoes and the indestructible armor of the gods. Later that same year the mysterious force that revived him brought him to meet several other knights called the Justice Knights.
abilities: Sword made of fire; Fire proof armor

name: Jane Vines
description: Born on the island of Invasia, Jane was born of great Invasian descent and bore favoritism from her gods. When her home world was overrun by an army of shadows. Jane invoke the help of the gods to provide her with the necessary means to defeat her opponents. She was given a magical lasso that could bind anything magical while a magical pole could extend to the heavens. Her cape protected her from attacks and her skin was bullet proof. Jane would meet with the Justice Knights and join their ranks as she felt she needed their assistance to defeat her opponents.

name: Misha Jones
description: Running away from home at 12, Misha Jones would find herself coming into a battle with death. Several guys came in contact with Misha, raped her and burned her body to ashes. From that moment, Misha came back from the ashes with a burst of light and killed the men that killed her and would then use her abilities to protect other women in violent situations under the name of Light Girl.

name: Council of Light
description:
Age: Older than time

Created from the gods before all else, The Lights are powerful metamorphic beings that rule over all time and would later take the place of the gods after the great war. Their first human which they use to defend their new world “Earth X” from dark forces was Misha Jones as Light Girl. They are often seen as beings of pure light with voices that can cause earthquakes.

name: Vondra Hikes
description: Serving as one of the many members of The Lights, Vondra Hikes until she came to Earth was a political figure amongst her race. Making decisions for mankind and deciding the future of billions. When she rebelled against the others because she believed the world below deserved to make their own decisions, she became a fighter against The Lights and for some time would join SAA.

name: Arny Stage
description: Arny Stage has been for his entire life as the most sought out being on the planet because of his unique ability to cancel any ability on the planet. Dressed in all white with decorative symbols around his body, Arny also known as The One has since been considered the most powerful Abnormal reaching ranks pass that of a High Level being all at the age of 5 years old. For his protection, Arny has been sealed away in a locked dimension where no one knows of his existence.

name: Matt Lower
description: Matt Lower and his family have been giving special powers through an experiment that would help them against a group of terrorists that wish them dead. In 1989, Matt and his family went on a journey in South Russia to visit several of his college peers. His children witness several men killing some exchange students and were seen by the men and were threaten. Running from these men ever since, the Lowers grew tired of running and Matt devised a plan to stop the men and anyone from threatening them. Matt and his lab partner begun using minerals to build a weapon that would give them a fighting chance. Unbeknownst to him, Matt would give his family super powers in the process.
abilities: Ice Breath; Touch can turn anything into Ice

name: Lydia Lower
description: Wife of Matt Lower, Lydia Lower was given the unique ability to others abilities and use them as her own temporarily which came in handy when defended herself against stronger opponents. (read Matt Lower for more information on history)

name: Dola Lower
description: Daughter of Matt Lower and Lydia Lower, Dola Lower could touch any steel object and control its substance; if the object was bigger she could get bigger and vice versa. She could enhance her strength, weight, height, and see through anything that was steel and sometimes metal. Unlike her family she doesn’t like their new life and wishes to return to her normal lifestyle with her friends and going to school instead of being homeschool and fighting crime.

name: Stirn Lower
description: Considering his abilities and what his family does cool, Stirn Lower has had many faults in his life and was for a moment considered the loner of the family. Stirn also called The Phantom can levitate himself and the things around him using limited Focus Levitation. To some resources, his abilities are considered the strongest mostly because he practices more with his powers than his family does.

name: Herbie Oshcock
description: Herbie has always been a pushover to everyone that met him even while in school. However now that he has grown into his powers as a mimic telepath, Herbie is now more powerful and much feared amongst his peers. At one time in his life, Herbie was a member of The Mentals and used his abilities to create mindless soldiers. Later in life after the fall of the Army of Chaos, Herbie becomes a member of the Circus Family.
affiliates: The Mentals; The Immortals; Circus Family

name: Kinda Jockae
description: Kinda Jockae could always know when someone was hurt or was sad through the use of her Empathy. During her years as a social worker, Kinda discovered her abilities and started to go by the name Empath to help others in need of her assistance. She would then join The Mentals in hopes to further develop her talents and help out people on a wider scale.

name: Sondra Elitae’
description:
Age: 91 (appears 26)

Sondra Elitae’ died during the early 1900s due to a head trauma caused by skiing. In the late 90s, Sondra was said to have been seen by a local school boy who described her as being dressed in white covered in what appeared to be clouds and floated across the ground like an angel. While in her induce coma like state, Sondra reached a mental level where she could transport her body to another plane known as Dreomede. There she met another mental that could bring dreams to reality and the two started The Mentals. With their combined efforts they returned to Earth only in spirit form trying to get enough dreams to become alive again.

name: Dao Gow
description:
Age: 67 (appears 34)

Dao Gow was punished to a place of nightmares because of his dark magic. However he vowed that one day he would come back to the land of the living and place everyone into a coma state controlling them through their dreams. To cover up his plan he created The Mentals and made them appear as heroes protecting others while draining everyone they save of their dreams. This plan however was unknowingly to Empath & Minerva.

name: Sara Blink
description: Often mistaken to be the descendent of the goddess of the same name. Sara Blink also known as Minerva has the ability to see into the future and predict it accurately which caused her to be sought out by some of the world’s most powerful forces. She would then hide away at SAA to only leave months after her arrival to a secluded location known as the new Delphi. Minerva joined The Mentals because of their similar abilities and was considered the replacement to Oracle.

name: Layton Brandon Jr
description: Following in his father’s footsteps, Layton Jr. knew of his duty of leading the new age version of the Generals and making sure that Britain and most of Europe was being protected from outside threats. His daughter showcased similar attributes as he do.

name: Amber Ildriegch
description:
Abilities: Blackouts of which she gets another personality that gives her superhuman strength

Amber Ildriegch was found next to her girlfriend’s dead body who was murdered the night before while they both were sleeping. Amber believes she was saved because she was the one that killed her girlfriend that night. She explained the story to the police and later to New World group and it was confirmed that it’s her abnormal abilities which causes her blackouts and the death of her girlfriend.
abilities: Speed; Intelligence; Giant wings; Poisonous spit; Burning light

name: Sarah Coleman
description: Sarah Coleman worked at a camp when her friend’s daughter died in a lake on her watch; she encountered Soulman taking the little girl’s soul to the afterlife when she started to attack it using her abilities. This made her realize that she has a unique ability and after failing to get the girl’s soul back, she made a promise to herself and others that she was going to protect others at all cost, as a openly accepted lesbian, she knew it mostly meant for her to protect others that were different believing they were in the most danger so she joined the New World group.
abilities: Can shoot black; Blue lazer beams from her fists; Eyes; Superhuman strength

name: Jayden Humoge
description:
Abilities: Releases it as massive waves of attacks

During gay pride in Century City 04’ Jayden Humoge learned that during a fight he experienced his first abnormal outbreak. So freighten by his supernatural abilities, Jayden ran away from home and was founded by a guy who befriended him and the two became boyfriends. His friend told him that he was special and that there was a group of people just like him that he should joined. He would come across the New World group and join their ranks after seeing what they were capable of.

name: Prenda Holmes
description:
Abilities: Releases black rubber like structure from her hands; Can use her body like a rubberband

Prenda Holmes is Litan’s right hand woman, a lesbian herself, she knows how her sexuality can cause hatred among others including her own family so she joined Litan on his mission to protect people who are usually hated and outlawed because of their sexualities.

name: Litan Armstrongham
description: Leader of the New World group, Litan also known as Ruzne’ leads this group of gay vigilantes across the world protecting individuals whom have been attacked or cast out of their societies because their differences mostly sexualities. He formed the group in the late 90s and has since brought them to dominance in some countries including the U.S and the U.K. with several of their more prominent members being on most of their missions.

name: Alala Benjamin
description: Alala is one of the most athletic girls in her school; she is the leader of the cheerleader squad, first girl to be in the football league, basketball champion, and class president. However one day she realizes that she haves natural acrobatic abilities that helps her to become Lady Ninja by 2020.

name: Bret Willis
description: Alongside Kitana, Bret was at the school under the training of a martial artist. He developed the unique ability to throw energy powered stars that would explode when it touches a solid object. Like Kitana he too grew up in a boring lifestyle and wanted more and left after high school to become a fellow ninja. He often leads the group The Ninjas.
abilities: Enhanced Acrobatics; Ninja Like skills; Longevity; Energy throwing stars

name: Kitana Arnold
description: Kitana was born in the late 1980s to a farmer and actress. She always knew that she was meant for more than just going to school and working on her dad’s farm. One day she ran away from home and left for New York where she met a skilled martial artist that taught her how to protect herself. While in NYC she came across a witch that cursed her with the abilities of a ninja.
abilities: Enhanced Acrobatics; Invisibility; Ninja like techniques

name: Danielle Jane
description: Danielle Jane is a skilled martial artist, she has developed a high mental awareness of everything she comes in contact with her and for a while worked alongside The Ninjas. After discovering that she could become any known object by thinking of it, Danielle became known as Dapple and joined The Shifters to better improve her new gift while also working at times with the Ninjas.

name: Bill Lender
description: During his moments at Bel Air high, Bill Lender became confident in the fact that he has known to learn his abilities to sense someone’s chi and use it against them. After graduating, he went on a mission to train with the Ninjas and later join those fighting demons that escape Hell. In the future it has been foretell that Bill would become a powerful Chi Master that could destroy people by destroying their chi.

name: MeMe Vasquez
description:
Abilities: Has the ability to take control of others bodies by making contact or being within proximity to them

Meme has been called a mischief her entire life and in her own words “just because I’m 40 doesn’t mean I have to stop having fun” uses her abilities to steal identities and shares some similarities to many comic villains in the fact that she appears sweet and innocent at first look until she finds an opportunity to take advantage of an situation. She was once part of the team The Originals until the team disbanded in 2011.

name: Killip Hardrow
description:
Abilities: Has the ability to transform into humanoid versions of a bat; Or an amphibian of some kind. In these transformed states he is also able to take on the traits of these animals

Killip is a descendant of the Elitshians and uses one of their items called The Rishwod (a device that can detect special beings, including meta-humans) provided to him by his father before his death. Killip used this device to search for others like himself, thus finding the other members of his new team the Originals. However because of their differences, the group disbanded in 2011. Killip became Haiwan and worked as a teacher at SAA in the Transfiguration department. The item is kept in SAA library of Abnormal events.
abilities: A wolf; Such as flight; Enhanced smell

name: Minya Wavus
description:
Abilities: Subconsciously chooses the best course of action for herself from these possibilities

Minya Wavus has been an agent of numerous teams including The Originals until their disbandment in 2011 and before the group she has been a part of The Immortals until their missions grew to dark for her and other groups including Elite Force 4.
abilities: Can psionically view multiple possible timelines

name: Bishop Onald
description: During his years as part of the Regenegade, Bishop was considered to always have been an outcast because of appearance and hatred toward mankind. Bishop became Sacrum and begun using his abilities to terrorize neighborhoods. He joined the Outcasts under the lead of Jorul.
abilities: Enhance Durability; Agility; Bone like spikes from body

name: Daniella Arnu
description: Daniella was daughter of a priest and housewife and knew of nothing different than her religious upbringing. However one day while after school, Daniella notice a girl being beaten to death by several other girls. Mad at her god because of letting such things happen in the world, Daniella would soon go by Magna and joined Jorul as part of The Outcasts.
abilities: Absorbing of other Abilities; Releasing them back onto opponents

name: Tela Budrome
description: Tela Budrome was someone who always knew her place in the world as an asSAAsin; she worked for Lord Dupree who assigns her to kill the president in an effort for super-humans to take over. Tela serves as a part time member of The Outcasts.

name: Jorul Davidson
description: Jorul created the Outcasts in effort to show mankind that super-humans are not to be in the background. He originally led a similar group of super-powered villians before they disbanded. Jorul first met Daniella and later Tela while on a mission through Elite City to stop the President from signing the Anti-power act of 1989.

name: Cory Bryans
description: Cory was always a hothead because he believes that he should be on top and not outcast like other super-humans. He joined Jorul during a rampage in Elite City of super-powered humans. During one of his most famous fights, Cory encountered Elite Force and at one time the Lazarons.

name: Tydarn Peterson
description: During his youth, Tyrell’s friends were killed while at school by a shoot out, when in rage he learns about his abilities which nearly destroy most of the school and the shooters. As one of the only few students alive, The Enforcers sent out to find him only to find no trace of his existence. At the age of 12, Tyrell now known as Specks (called at an early age by his siblings because of his unique glasses) attends SAA.

name: Marvin McCoy
description: Pressured to finish his first book, Marvin discovered his ability to create anything from writing. Furthering his book’s inspiration and speedy release, Marvin enjoyed major success and with it the attraction of The Enforcers. Intrigued by his abilities, The Enforcers found Marvin at his hotel room on Central Island. The group tried to capture Marvin to no prevail, using his abilities to escape, Marvin traveled to SAA where he became a teacher in Computers and the Battle Room.

name: Aliyah Grant
description: Aliyah was a famous musician who attended the Elite City Music Academy to further her singing talents. At the time of her 2009 acceptance dinner, Aliyah was about to make her acceptance speech when a nervous breakdown caused her to give everyone  in the room a massive stroke through some form of psychic flashes to the brain. After years of hiding a way from the public eye, Aliyah returned as Motion and soon began her music career again.

name: Landon Bricks
description: Landon worked as a construction worker for years for his father until his father almost died from an accident. Landon used his ice abilities to rescue his father which caused him to be cast out of his family because of this. He kept in contact with his father though messages and received money from him through Western Union. For almost 7 years, Landon has since been called Frost Man and assisted with Elite Force.

name: Lisa Black
description: Lisa Black was once apart of an elite group of mentals that was watched over by Jonun & Authora. She was protected and kept a secret to be one day sent out into the battle to save mankind from the new war of the gods & supernaturals known as Mostibik. Inside of her lied the sleeping phoenix god, Viginarah and it is said with his power she would become the world’s most powerful super-human.

name: Alexandra Hope
description: Alexandra Hope was one of the most prominent members of her high school. She was in several clubs and on several sport teams, one day while training for soccer practice.
