Alexandra sprunge her leg and from the pain, she caused sonic waves to come from her hands which nearly destroyed the soccer field. From that day, Alexandra went by the name Sonic Wave from her peers. While Alexandra was hanging out with friends at a local juice bar in Elite City, she witnessed several people saving downtown from a terrible alien. She instantly knew she wanted to be a hero and so she traveled to the Tower of

name: Zachary Forcen
description: In 1967 a child in Detroit Michigan lost his parents to a mysterious phenomenon that resulted in them and several townspeople being sucked into a distant void that eclipsed the northern part of the sky. Zachary however, survived and was taken into custody with no one to believe it was him. Years later he was discovered by a secret society believed to help use him as a weapon against an opposing government society. It is believed however that Zachary can produce gaping blackholes causing the disapperances throughout most of his life including those of his family.
abilities: Can open blackholes; Relinquish them onto numerous realities

name: The Reckoning
description: Formed over hundred years ago by several masked men who have been on a hunt to find and replicate powerful objects from across the world. Some believed that they are servants to a demon. However, they each seem to act without rank and without a general command other than to find all known magical artifacts. Their base of operation is unknown but the inside is said to be a complete resemblance of the Elite Organization. They are often the enemies of most of the heroes within the Eliteverse including most importantly the E.L.I.T.E Originazation.

name: Mandivole Henkings
description: A cyborg like man that was manipulated by the Reckoning as the ultimate weapon. His body was mostly damanged and was given highly advance alien tech to heal himself and provide him with enhanced strength, speed, and intelligence. He is considered an immortal because of his ability to withstands the effects of the Dugarda.
abilities: Super strength; Longevity; Agility; Technological enhanced body parts

name: The Rifters
description: United to judge those on Earth, these group of psychic teenagers were brought together by The Groners in an attempt to continue their legacy. The Rifters as called by those who know what they can do, live in a cavern surrounded by manipulated webs that serve as viewing fields for different dimensions.

name: Garrick Talen
description:
Abilities: Capable of seeing probabilities from different possible futures of the gods

Born in North Atlantis, the Groners took Garrick when he was a young boy because of his power to be able to see the many possible futures of immortal beings like the Gods, beings of both Heaven, Hell, and other forces beyond the mortal realm. The Groners calls him Mystic Flare because of his abilities.

name: Monis Broeman
description:
Abilities: Capable of seeing probabilities from different possible futures in different realms

Capable of seeing different futures from across this realm. Many call him the White Code because of his white suits and going by the code.

name: Jonnae Milyen
description:
Abilities: Capable of seeing probabilities from different possible futures

Token from her home in an alternate world. Jonnae was living in the life of luxury however couldn’t escape her powers so slowly her life became a constant temptation for others around her including her parents. She has the power to see the possible future of different dimensions and its citizens but not Earth. Jonnae goes by the name Madam Red because of her long red hair and proud nature.

name: John Wintwright
description: Probably known as the greatest thief of all times, John Wintwright has been known as the master of thieves by newspapers across the world. John discovered his ability during his youth while away at boarding school. It is believed that he was once the leader of the Shifters alongside his girlfriend Seile.

name: Kain Osmond
description: As leader of the Shifters, Kain Osmond had to always protect those he watched over even as a kid. Like many leaders of such groups, Kain wasn’t accepted amongst his family and peers and so he left home living a life of homelessness and poverty. Reverting to stealing and hiding away in gutters. After a while, Kain became stronger and used his appearance to cope with others like him, eventually creating the group Shifters.
abilities: Enhanced strength; Agility; Bear like appearance

name: Amanda Debose’
description: Amanda has always been a wild child. Since her birth, Amanda has run away from home numerous times even once to avoid escaping punishment by her parents. When she learns she could turn her arms into that of falcon wings and contained extraordinary hearing & flexibility, she used it to her advantage. One day while she was away in the city, she met Kain who introduced her to a life without rules and complete freedom of which she adored greatly.
abilities: Extraordinary hearing; Flexibility; Falcon like wings; Legs; Agility

name: Marsha Ambeliangela
description: Believed to be one of their gods, Marsha is a powerful being with the true power to control virtually every aspect of the weather. On top of this, she can also go hand to hand in combat with other swordsmans, for a time she fought as part of the Swordsmans and proven to be a valiant foe. When her village was destroyed by dark forces, Marsha left persuing the dark forces thus meeting the other Nightwalkers whom each were affected by the similar forces.

name: Ka-kishi
description: Born to the Chanuga Clan, Ka-kishi is a prowd member of the Lion Blade a group of members from her tribe. From her training with the group, she learns to master the power of the lion thus taking the spirit of the Lion into her body. This caused her to receive Lion like reflexes and several body similarities to that of a lion. Ka-kishi was found fighting a demon in the woods near her village and was invited to join the other Swordsmans in a attempt to defeat the Master Khan, a demonic swordsman.
abilities: Lion like reflexes; Ninja like fighting; Skilled swordsman

name: Sam-hon
description: Of the Minushi Clan, Sam-hon has been trained as a Spirit Shaman most of his life. His people devoted their life to protecting the well being of the planet through meditation and spirit guidance. Although of his origins he is a shaman, Sam-hon thought it best to find his own calling, thus becoming a skilled swordsman and using his training as a shaman as a mix of highly skilled combat. He can call on spirits to fight his opponents. He often rides the demon beast, Aurora Hound.
abilities: Spirit controlling; Skilled swordsman; Magical abilities

name: Honna
description: Known throughout the lands for her great psychic powers, Honna is a skilled swordsman and demon hunter. She has traveled to many places using her powers to fight demons and even spirits and performed many exorcisms. Honna is currently the only American and youngest member of the Swordsmans.

name: Jakai
description: Skilled at the art of fire throwing, Jakai mistakenly killed his entire tribe. This caused him to go into depression; to help him a wondering Dau-shin found the boy and tought him how to fight using a sword and his abilities. Jakai became the first member of the Swordsmans and has since grown greatly as a swordsman.

name: Dau-shin
description: Dau-shin grew up in the same village as his enemy Khan. He watched as his village perished in flames through the hands of Khan. This act of violence led him to collect a group of skilled swordsmans to fight Khan and defeat him. He created the rule that if you are defeated you must give your sword to the one who defeated you. This rule became known worldwide and even Khan, Belki, and beings of different worlds recognizes this rule. This rule became so popular that the gods of almost all realms implemented this and if the sword is not given, then the holder of the sword dies.

name: Marshall Maden
description: Marshall was a loner, basically living in his room for most of his life; he was homeschooled and never left the house unless it was to go on errands with his mom. Because of his fear of the outside world, Marshall would create an alias under the title the Transformer because over time he has learned to transform into Technological objects. As he got older, and his mom no longer could watch over him, Marshall had no other choice but to venture out into the world, he would then create a team of vigilantes that did whatever they wanted to do under the title The Techno Defenders.

name: Tarnan Trell
description: When Tarnan was 4, most of his body was ripped to shreds and not to live life deformed. Tarnan using his highly advance intelligence to create a mechanical body similar to that of a cyborg. Under the name Control, Tarnan would join his neighbor Marshall in their new team The Techno Defenders.
abilities: Half cyborg like body; Enhanced digital intelligence

name: Brandon Soul
description: Brandon Soul watched his parents get killed by several criminals of who attacked them for their money. After this, Brandon would train to become a well-trained soldier; he met with the members of the Techno Defenders and developed a bullet proof suit. He created a gun that could create sound speed bullets that would go unmatched.
abilities: Bullet Proof checker board suit w/gun

name: The Wakashi Clan
description: The yang to the yin of the Kiakashi Clan, this group of super powered individuals are each from a respected clan that sole goal is to rid the world of the Kiakashi Clan after the two clans have been in war with one another for over 700 years.

name: Lena Chou
description: On her death bed from a deadly plague, Lena Chou was given a second chance at living when visited by a demonic being called Spellbound. Seeing her potential, he turned her into a paper goddess, capable of using her body as a paper like weapon. Her new body was also lightweight and could easily move in the wind if she choses. She made a pledge that she would always follow Spellbound and protect him at all cause even if she in the future doesn’t like it.
abilities: Body can turn to cloths; Used as extensive weapons

name: Ru Clannigan
description: One of the newest recruits to the Wakashi Clan, Ru became known as Ice Shard after coming across his abilities while fighting a demonic entity. Ru boasts the power to breathe ice and control the air around him to create powerful substances of ice. Ru met Solan while training at the Wakashi Temple at the edge of New Elitshia, there the two fought and Ru learn to control his abilities, thus causing Solan more reason to recruit him after their battle.

name: Shadai Uh
description: Shadai Uh bares the symbols of the original ancestral Wakashi Clan that has since disappeared from existence after the fall of Elitshia. Going by the name Red Phoenix, Shadai knew she could control fire and heat around her, thus protecting herself throughout from danger. Her attacks are also known to appear in the form of a Phoenix that can cause fires when it flies above an object and/or area.
abilities: Power over Fire; Creates Phoenix looking attacks

name: Seri Inch
description: During the trials of New Elitshia when scientists were working on an experiment to rid humans of the ADX Genes, Seri Inch offered himself as a lab rat to find a cure. Although with no proven abilities of his own, Seri had a long line of Descendants in his family, thus the genes were found in his body however not activated, in return giving him no abilities. However the experiment went wrong and his abilities were activated and his ADX genes were mutated causing his skin to turn red, his hair fibers to grow at great sizes, eyes turn black, and body to increase in muscle mass, this alerted the government officials, opting for the experiement to be shut down. From this, Seri now known as Blanco was to take his revenge out on all those that were involved in the experiment, this caused him to appear in and out of the Wakashi Clan stories as he was involved in his own solo stories.

name: Solan Humbrick
description:
Abilities: Magical Spells through the use of spell cards

A powerful Sondred that uses his staff to cast spells, his many rings and charms around his body has since been cursed to forever be bound to his skin to protect his magic. He joined the Wakashi Clan to help fight the Angel Slayers and has since been a powerful force against any demonic army or allies. He is considered at times the leader of the Wakashi Clan.

name: Lodi Reeves
description: Once a mystical eqomancer, Lodi reeves uses plants to communicate with objects around her and uses water to read the drinker’s mind. She is a powerful witch that uses her magical water abilities to appear 29 when in reality it is believed that she may be over 2,000 years old.

name: The Watsons
description: A family that has been known for them enhance magical power specializing in Spiritual Magic and power to raise the dead. Their powers are increased when they are near a lot of spirits. Like the Lazarons and the Demoys, they are pictured quite often within the Sanctuary Stories.

name: The Watsons
description:
Age: Varies

The Watsons are a 700 year old race of meta-humans with a long and drawn out history of curses and mishapenings. In the year 1300, a young Misho Watson (the first of the clan) met a powerful witch named the Black Chrone, they fell in love until Misho betrayed their love and fell for his then wife, Berra. The two would produce a line of powerful meta-humans and from them each would share the legacy of a curse. As time progress, they were stricken of their immortality and died off because of the Black Chrone’s curse. The clan would eventually become down to one man named John would marry Wilma and they would produce the last member of the Watson & Demoy clan, Olivia “Ghost Girl”.
abilities: Transparency; Communicate with the dead; Various powers over the dead; Teleportation; Flight; Immortality; Telepathy amongst each other member

name: The White Ring
description: Collectively a group of powered individuals given extreme control over the mystical power of the White Force. This power has been passed down by the elders of the universe, the Primordial Ones as their historical stamp. This power acts in retroactive against the Black Ring. The white rings are eight powerful beings that use positive white energy to move through realms and become stronger. Their home worlds had devastating things happen to them and the rings chose them to protect them after witnessing death.

name: Sir Von Heights
description:
Abilities: Fueled by the emotional spectrum of willpower or the power of death; Both rings are able to create solid light constructs limited to imagination; Energy absorption. Both objects require periods of recharge

Sir Von Heights received his ring under the guise that he could use it to hunt down and kill the hunters that killed his family. Looking for his race’s unique healing scales, Sir Heights discovered the ring and used it to kill others. He became the first barrier of the Black Ring. However, once seeing the destruction he was causing, he reverted to become a part of the White Ring and wears a body suit with a cape both made of platinum bearing a ring on his chest.
abilities: Power of positive white energy; Will; Flight

name: James M. Powell
description:
Abilities: Fueled by the emotional spectrum of willpower or the power of death; Both rings are able to create solid light constructs limited to imagination; Energy absorption. Both objects require periods of recharge

James discovered his ring while trying to protect two children from a burning building. Although he was to late, he was awarded the ring for his bravery and was instructed to be prepared to unite with the other ring barriers when called upon. In the meantime James became The Guardian using his ring to create a shinning silver and white armor which also turns his skin bright and hair pure white. He now protects his homeworld.
abilities: Power of positive white energy; Will; Flight

name: Reginald Holmes
description:
Abilities: Fueled by the emotional spectrum of willpower or the power of death; Both rings are able to create solid light constructs limited to imagination; Energy absorption. Both objects require periods of recharge. Power over light

Reginald discovered the ability to control light when he nearly died in a cave in while hiking with his friends. He was the only survivor and used his power of light to blast his way out of the cave. The ring appeared before him and he used it to become the Masked Protector wearing a white tuxedo like suit with short silver hair, a mask, and pure white eyes.
abilities: Power of positive white energy; Will; Flight

name: Mista Wells
description:
Abilities: Fueled by theemotional spectrum of willpower or the power ofdeath; Both rings are able to create solid light constructs limited to imagination; Energy absorption. Both objects require periods of recharge

Orphaned at birth, Mista was left for dead on the doorsteps of a nearby church. Taken away before her death by a mysterious wearer of the White Ring. It was given to Mista while an infant and since then she was given good luck and protection from bodily harm. She grew up to become Silver Reign and saved her homeworld from numerous outside threats. Although the youngest of her allies, she is the most experienced on the secrets of the rings.
abilities: Power of positive white energy; Will; Flight

name: Roberta Highlandale
description:
Abilities: Fueled by theemotional spectrum of willpower or the power ofdeath; Both rings are able to create solid light constructs limited to imagination; Energy absorption. Both objects require periods of recharge

Wearing a silver dress like armor. She can move fast as sound and steals light from nearby places. She gave up hope for living when she was near death due to her husband slitting her throat. The key appeared to her which she used unknowingly killing her husband. She key made her forget about that moment and she became a hero named the White Wraith for the ring saving her from unbeknown to her, death.
abilities: Power of positive white energy; Will; Flight

name: Gerry Riverons
description:
Abilities: Fueled by theemotional spectrum of willpower or the power ofdeath; Both rings are able to create solid light constructs limited to imagination; Energy absorption. Both objects require periods of recharge

Using his ring to win races and various money laundering guises. Gerry’s ring was almost taken away from him unless he made up for the bad deads he committed. Saving the life of a young couple proved to be the right thing to get him on the right track. He became Lightrace after seeing the true power of the ring and what it could do to help heal his dying world.
abilities: Power of positive white energy; Will; Flight

name: Sabrina Toasthell
description:
Abilities: Fueled by theemotional spectrum of willpower or the power ofdeath; Both rings are able to create solid light constructs limited to imagination; Energy absorption. Both objects require periods of recharge

Age: Varies
abilities: Power of positive white energy; Will; Flight

name: The Youth Arch
description: A group of young superheroes that respond to illegal activities found throughout Elite City, they are one of many youths inspired teams. They are usually a comical bunch with the life of being teenagers getting in the mix of saving the day. They are led by Zaden whom fights alongside them on the toughest missions, otherwise he acts as their guide from their base of operations his home at the edge of Elite City.

name: Cynthia Arnos
description:
Abilities: Hyper sensitive screams can make others dizzy

Born to a rich family in Richmond, NC, Cynthia has always been able to make use of her time. She could sing hypnotizing songs that could leave her listeners dizzy. She participated in a local talent show where she was sought out by a man named Gilian. From this moment he inducted her into his secret group of young heroes called The Youth Arch. She is now called Dazelle and wears a zig-zag costume with bubble like objects circling her body, the bubbles hover by the hyper sensitive sound patterns released from her body.

name: Zaden James
description: Zaden James, is a member of the original Youth Arch. He left to America to find others like himself to recruit to become a new Youth Arch. He first found Layden and then began creating the rest of the alliance. Zaden stated his goal is to find youngsters under the legal age of 18 because of their ability to act quickly, response to environmental changes, quick acceptance of their abilities, and their abundance of personality traits.

name: Graham Beleign
description:
Abilities: Can reflect energy back at opponents stronger than arrival upon him

Left as an orphan to die, Graham Beleign was born to mysterious farm folk who left him at a orphanage to be adopted however because of his mutant appearance, he was discarded by the orphanage in a river. Graham called Beleign because his name means “chosen” in Elitshian times by his teammates. It was later revealed that Beleign is one of the few remaining Elitshians left on Earth and that his people traveled to the now Americas after Elitshia was destroyed by the gods.

name: Alyssa Page
description: Alyssa Page is probably the most valuable member of the team, not because of her abilities but because of her stealth training as part of the X-Rogues when she was 11. Her parents were killed when she was 7 and since was sent to a school of young meta-humans (not SAA) that was later burned to the ground. Instead of being transferred to SAA like the other students. Alyssa became Nonage and left to join Zaden after hearing of his revival of The Youth Arch.
abilities: Genius Level Intellect; Instant touch knowledge; Memory erasing

name: Layden Rivalri
description: Layden discovered at a very early age that his body was a virtual time ripple. When anything approaches him he can control it via a gravitational pull that allows him to control any instance of the object’s mass through molecule manipulation. This ability would then be use to allow him to travel through time for instances, until he was strong enough to go almost 60 years in the past. However once in the current time, he wasn’t able return home. He met Zaden of the Youth Arch in hopes to assist in the creation of the new alliance, knowing of their future existence. It is at sometime mentioned that Layden is related to an original member of the first set of Youth Arch somehow, however its unknown at the present time how.

name: Dyna Pane
description: Part of an elite group called Diamonte, a group of diamond skin bodied meta-humans; Dyna also called Diamonta is their most fierced member, often leading them onto many missions. Their goal is to defeat an ancient curse that has been plaguing each member’s family for centuries. Diamonte came across the demonic entity, Belckus for a brief moment after trying to find a way to stop her curse, however she was easily defeated. Knowing of the dark forces out there, she retreated and thus became apart of the Diamonte after learning of their shared legacy and similar abilities. During her teens, Dyna was once a part of the original Youth Arch, however after their final fight with the Godzilla creature of Japan, the group disbanded and never spoke to each other again.
affiliates: Diamonte; Youth Arch; The Youth Arch

name: Benjamin Rightworth
description: Benjamin Rightworth was a highly esteemed man who never let his pride get the best of him. Thus being called by many as Merendah, Malay for humble. Serving as the oldest member of the original Youth Arch, Benjamin gave up crime fighting in hopes to start a family and his own superhero museum. He started his museum known as the Chronicles of Descendants. His museum was so popular that it has even been visited by even the gods and alien races because of its vast records. The museum would also serve as a Abnormal library, containing nearly all recorded knowledge of the Abnormal events on Earth. His museum because of many attacks was moved to its own island and later to a new hall in SAA which became the world’s largest such library.

name: Jerald Holse
description:
Abilities: Icepick can absorb heat from his surroundings; Creating ice. He can also emit absorbed heat as blasts of energy

Jerald could always manipulate the cold air around him, he could kill things by freezing it to death, and even reverting the cold effects thus heating things up as well (although very limited). Going by the name Icepick later in his teens, he formed a group of young super-heroes originally known as the Youth Arch back in the mid-1970s. The group protected parts of North America from their worse foes until their final mission and eventual defeat in the late 1980s. From this point of his group’s defeat, Jerald, fled to Europe where he attempted to create a new group call The Originals. However he was killed during one of their missions and his son took his reign as leader of the group by the early 2000s.
affiliates: Youth Arch; The Originals; The Youth Arch

name: Joan Rivera
description:
Abilities: Emosi has the ability to manipulate emotions or feelings of others. She also has strong telepathy

Joan was a tomboy that could sense the emotions of others, she knew from early on that she could use this to her advantage especially when in love with someone. She later that she couldn’t just feel other people’s emotions but also control their emotions and even listen to their thoughts and move objects with her mind. Being sought out by so many in her time, Joan joined Youth Arch as an escape of feeling lonely as she was because of her abilities to sense other’s emotions and their mind.

name: Thunder Riders
description: The Thunder Riders are a collection of members that are usually apart of another team or work solo from outside of the group. However, they are called together when Kanos, the Elitsyian God of Thunder needs their assistant with matters usually related to Eartlhy matters that because of his status as a deity, he himself cannot intrude. Such matters include the illegal shipping of the Golden Apples to Elite City via a dimension portal. The Golden Apples are food to the gods and if ate by a mortal could turn them immortal, something the gods forbidden.

name: Cascade Blanch
description:
Abilities: Microwave radiation manipulation Flight Electromagnetic energy wavelength disruption

Cascade was one of the many people that was founded and saved by Kanos. Her story begun when she was 8 and was captured by the Enforcers for her superpowers. While experiementing on her, Kanos came through the room with whirling thunder and bright light expelling all those that wished harm on her. From that point, Cascade became Kaboom and joined the Thunder Riders in hopes to rescue other super-powered people in danger.

name: Lundrow Galds
description: Ambitious and to prove himself to Kanos. Lundrow thought the only way to do so is to steal the thunder deity’s thunderbolt and take down a band of demigods gone rogue. However, the thunderbolt accidentally  exploded because of improper use. Luckily no one was harmed. Worried that Kanos would punish him, Kanos instead greeted him with armor that can produce small amounts of electricity which grows stronger only if Lundrow learns how to wield it’s power. Promising to teach Lundrow now known as Crackle after the sound of thunder. To use a thunderbolt only if he learns how to control the power within the armor.
abilities: Gauntlets; Helmet; Ring; Boots; Contacts that can produce electricity

name: Crystopher Hilmet
description: Crystopher Hilmet is a star athlete who witness both his parents being killed by a unknown creature that can produce electricity. Praying to the gods for help, Kanos met with Crystopher and granted him the speed of lightning to help catch the thing that killed his parents. He joined the Thunder Riders to help in his search of the creature.
abilities: Super speed; Limited enhanced strength; Intelligence; Teleportation; Time travel if ran fast enough

name: Time Lords
description: A vicious group of war lords whom have used their powers and technology to manipulate time, causing much friction between many dimensions and timelines. One of their most diabolical missions was the greeting of Hitler and causing his rise to power. In the original storyline, Hitler never rose to power and was killed as a young boy during a freak accident.

name: Dr. Non Chow
description: Dr. Non Chow scientist at the Dorman Labs. Found a way to move through time and space by constructing a machine that would allow him to produce magnetic fields strong enough to make ripples in time similar to black holes. During one of his procedures he attempted to test his machine by sending himself 5 minutes into the past, however it sent him almost 29 years in time where he discovered the lost city Trone. Shortly after he mastered the machine’s power, Dr. Chow created a suit with the machine’s technology and called himself Tempus. Tempus went as far as the past to rewrite stories calling himself a God of Time and eventually a powerful foe to anyone that stood in his way.

name: Deblin Helios
description: Capable of growing to massive sizes, Deblin Helios, Deblin known as Cronos would use his sizes to conquer cities across time and with the use of his creation a time traveling ring he would become a god in many mythologies. During one of his riots, Cronos met Dial, Diaggler, Spot, & Tempus and they would become The Time Lords.
abilities: Changing sizes of his body; Time Traveling

name: Lidia Bankhead
description: Lidia Bankhead was a powerful inventor but even more creative artist. She would invent several objects however only one was considered her most prized possession, the helmet of time. Over a course of time, her traveling through time would cause mental issues which would result in multiple personalities. Some of which would take on their own forms. Throughout history she would be called many things even a queen by one account. She met Spot & Tempus while in Ancient Egypt and formed The Time Lords.

name: Kline Koldel
description: Able to morph into inanimate objects, Kline Koldel would escape bullies and often hide by becoming small objects. While in his state he would sleep until awakening years later finding out that the world changed around him. It showed that because of his inanimate forms couldn’t age, while like this he could technically live forever. After meeting Tempus he became one of the first members of The Time Lords next to Tempus.

name: Jamie Stills
description: Jamie Stills began his active duty as a Time Lord shortly after Tempus was lost in the Ancient Egyptian age. Since then Jamie and his sister would soon develop a proud sense of their abilities and would soon leave to work alone. The two would go far through time to find ways to bring their parents back to life and even at some moments better their abilities.

name: Jamia Stills
description: Jamia Stills began her active duty as a Time Lord shortly after Tempus was lost in the Ancient Egyptian age. Since then Jamia and her brother Jamie would soon develop a proud sense of their abilities and would soon leave to work alone. The two would go far through time to find ways to bring their parents back to life and even at some moments better their abilities.

name: Time Pirates
description: Similar to their mentors, the Time Lords. The Time Pirates main objective is to travel through time aboard the Time Roper their vessel that can transport them anywhere in time. It was built by the Time Lords in an effort to spread their influence across all time. At one point it was used by almost all major war lords throughout time including Alexander the Great, Ramses 2, and Hitler.

name: Vanessa Strong
description:
Abilities: Can manipulate light to use as wind

One of the few Descendants that remembers her legacy as a direct descendant of angels. Vanessa’s memories has since made her a powerful ally as she can harnest the true potential of her mutant abilities through the Angel Mark on her arm. She created the group Time Pirates to discover others that bare the Angel Mark symbols to create a powerful team that would be able to take what they want, whenever they want. In the far future she marrys Dave Pumplenickel and the two have a son, one of the most powerful beings on the planet.

name: Gary Rosen
description: Knowing of his legacy as a direct descendant to angels, Gary cared little about his legacy and more about stealing powerful totems and/or artifacts to become stronger and richer. He uses his abilities for that exact reason and is one of the few Descendants that received their abilities under the age of 13.

name: Candace Wrightwood
description:
Abilities: Giant arms that can absorb any material

While she was a teenager, Candace Wrightwood also called Candy, has always been a considered a tomboy. She competed in contest and championships with other basketball players, female bodybuilders, and even arm wrestling champions. When she discovered her abilities to control matter and reuse it, she has since used it to her advantage, taking things at will. She met the other Time Pirates while trying to steal a artifact that they were after, shortly after because of her strength, she was given a place amongst the team.

name: Dave Pumplenickel
description: With the other Time Pirates, Dave is the 2nd in command after Light Wing. He uses his abilities to steal artifacts from around the world and is consider the teams’ strongest member in use of abilities and one of the strongest in the world. Unlike the others, he is the direct descendant to Shecknurd the God of Time. In about 25 years, he and Light Wing haves a son that becomes the strongest being on the planet. When his abilities are used in conjunction with the Time Medallion, his powers allows him to travel through time, thus giving the group their name as the Time Pirates.

name: Vince Redwood
description: Vince was born in a small town outside of KanTantirith City and was found by Dave on one of the Time Pirate’s many missions, he was the youngest of the group and the most inexperience. Dave stated that the reason behind Vince becoming a member of the team was because he was powerful and would be useful in stealing artifacts without causing a scene. Vince was killed by mistake by the Elite Force when the team attacked the Time Pirates in one of their missions to stop the pirates from stealing a powerful totem. The Time Pirates used the Time Medallion to go back into time to save Vince, however it proved to be useless as time proved that Vince was meant to die and yet died by the hands of the Immortals instead in a new time stream.
abilities: Creates a blinding fog around him; Can control mist; The wind

name: Unatamables
description: A group of mischiefs who friends long before they found out that they had powers. However, once they found out about their abilities, it took them no time to get into trouble. At school, on the playground, or even with local bullies. Because of their age and limited reach, they don’t fight crime outside their own neighborhood.

name: Jennings Craigens
description: Joining the mischief group of deviants with the only mission to cause trouble. Jennings found out about her abilities when she was in school one day, thinking it was her menstrual cycle beginning. She ran to the bathroom, it was actually an upset stomach, when she felt the pain, a blast shot through her stall door and through the brick wall out of the bathroom coming from her stomach. She since ran from school and never returned home.

name: Mack Goles
description:
Abilities: Enlarged feet that allows him to walk great distances or used as massive attacks

He met Jennings when the two met near each other when she called for him to meet her at their hiding spot. She wanted to meet to tell him of her powers, little did she know that Mack had his own secret power that he wanted to tell her. He has the power to enlarge his feet to monstrous proportions which he uses in various attacks and to walk great distances very fast.

name: Damison Mcquire
description: Jennings’ cousin met up with her at her hiding spot on accident, thinking that Mack was going to be there alone. Having a crush on Mack since the two met in 1st grade, Damison knew Mack may not like him like that but wanted to persue him anyways. Although its obvious that Mack has a crush on Jennings. Damison also holds a power to release massive screeching sound waves by clapping his hands or farting which he does by mistake. His powers however isn’t shown until Mack is in danger by the group’s first opponent.
abilities: Releases soundwaves from clapping or farting

name: Vampire Hunters
description: Very skilled individuals whom collectively came together in a mission to fight off the growing hoard of vampires that are spreading throughout the world. Their most prominent base is the vampire hideout in Elite City.

name: Sophia Winters
description: Born of a powerful legion of monster killing slayers. Sophia was 18 years old when she came into her abilities and quickly destroys her first vampire while drunk. The next day her mother told her of her families history and how thousands of years of strength was past down through several families including their own. Each generation, a Vampire Hunter is born with key abilities and can take the form of any gender but only one of such great power can exist each generation.
abilities: Super Strength; Enhanced speed; Enhanced intelligence; Psychic visions; Can learn any language

name: Dodona
description:
Abilities: Can locate any known thing and/or item

Descendant of a powerful line of oracles who receive their visions from the High Council of Domaedians. Dodona is the current day version of the Oracle Hunters and is the 9th generation hunter which is located in her family. Dodona supports and guides Sophia throughout most of her journeys.

name: Oracle Hunters
description:
Abilities: Can locate any known thing and/or item

Age: Varies

Oracle Hunters are powerful oracles that once themselves were Vampire Hunters however over time have become more passive in fighting the forces of evil. Their visions are given to them by their parents the High Councils. Until the late 1700s, the Oracle Hunters were angelic like beings taken human form; afterwards they became humans whom contracted their abiltiies around their 16th birthday. At first their abilities are very painful, often resulting in bleeding and headaches, however as they grow older and have more visions, the pain disappears.
abilities: Visions of the Past; Future; Present

name: Vampire Hunters
description:
Age: Varies

A group of fighters that experience enhanced strength, speed, knowledge, psychic visions, advance longevity and are most appear in the forms of humans either as man or woman however never at the same time in the same generation. It is believe they are the direct descendants to the first Vampire Hunter.
abilities: Enhance Strength; Intelligence; Speed; Enhance longevity; Durability; Extensive healing factor

name: Alers
description: Born with no specific gender, Alers was a powerful fighter with enhance speed, strength, extended knowledge, and enhance healing factor. Alers receive most of it abilities from the High Council and from them it was given an Oracle Hunter which would direct it across the world to fight demonic beings. After Alers was killed by a Demon of Hell, the High Council projected his soul and abilities into its children and from their soul and abilities were passed down. Alers, due to it having both genders of a male and female, gave birth to five children, each of which was given its unique abilities, however only one would survive their 15th birthday and that child became the second Vampire Hunter.
abilities: Enhance strength; Speed; Intelligence; Healing factor; Durability

name: Aviratha “Avi” Ansari
description: Powerful young girl capable of moving between the multiverses. Her abilities eventually will allow her to enter the larger Grand Scheme. Aviratha is descendant from powerful Djinns who are said to guard the veil that separated the multiverse. One day when Aviratha was in school, the Akuma’s wave started to break down the veil between the realities. This awoken her spiritual powers and she began waking up in different realities, unable to find her way home. In one of these realities, Aviratha met her older self which told her of what is going to happen to her if she can’t return to her own reality.
abilities: Can travel through the multiverse; Dimensional bolts of energy

name: Japnirantar Ansari
description:
Abilities: Builds great inventions that Aviratha borrows to fight evil

Aviratha’s older brother who mocks her love for childish things mostly comics. He is secretly a fan of comics himself and self-declared super fan to the Elite Force. He is unaware of Aviratha or his family’s history as protectors.

name: Shashwat Ansari
description: Aviratha younger brother that likes to write his own story. In one reality, he is the only capable of seeing the creatures that haunt his world. It is hinted that, Shashwat will be able to see those same creatures in the Multiverse story. He is one of the only members of his family that knows of Avi’s abilities.

name: Janeen Ansari
description: Avi’s mother who is over enthusiastic and loves her family’s culture so much that she preaches it to anyone that will lend her an ear. She is a great cook and always excited about her children’s successes.

name: Aaban Ansari
description: Avi’s father that runs a Rug store which he secretly gambles in the back with his friends. He is sarcastic, yet very sweet. He often talks about his time living in Pakistan and moving the family to America for a chance at a successful future.

name: Constantina Zaidi
description: Avi’s powerful grandmother that can move beyond the multiverse into the greater Grand Scheme. She is known about Avi’s abilities before Avi was born because of her interactions with various realities. She is the one that trains Avi with her abilities and codenames her Ms. Multiverse.
abilities: Can travel; See between the multiverse

name: Abhilesh Yazdani
description: Powerful Djin that came to Earth to steal the powers of Avi and her family. He disguises himself as a friendly shop owner that opened his shop next to Avi’s father when she was young. It is later discovered that, Abhilesh is the second Djiin ever born and child of a Domi Mage.
abilities: Powerful magical energy; Can travel between the multiverse

name: Dale Hedison
description: Love interest to Avi, Dale is friendly and loves the multiverse. Next to Shashwat, he is the only one that knows of Avi’s abilities. He is serious and at times acts as a know it all, which Avi adores.

name: Rendi Rowland
description: Rendi is half African American and half Pakistani. She converted to Islam when she was four years old and often practices it to learn more about her culture and ancestors. She is Avi’s best friend and friend to Dale. When Avi first learned of her abilities, she wanted to tell Rendi but didn’t know how to. Unknowns to Avi, however, is that Rendi can see between realities and her family, like Avi are descendant from the Veknahs.

name: Jason Rhodes
description:
Abilities: Can manipulate his body into different shapes

Son of Molecule, Jason saw his father fight The Electrician and swore vengeance after the superhero severed his father disabled. He is the classmate and enemy of Kilo and Watts without knowing of their identity. While in school and unaware of Kilo and Watts true identities, he is their best friend often protecting them against others when they aren’t suited up.

name: Von D’juse
description:
Abilities: Weapons that can discharge large amounts of explosive fireworks

Son of a general that worked alongside Adolf Hitler. Born to terrifying ideals, Von grew up destroying things and creating weapons of mass destruction. One day while in Berlin, Von removed his own arms and replaced them with guns that can shoot massive explosives as projectiles.

name: Michae’ Rhodes
description:
Abilities: Weapon that can cause him to change his size

Michae’ is from France and is very immersed in his French upbringing. He married a model and together they had Jason, who would later take on his mantle as the new Molecule. While he had weapons to change his body size and the size of others. His son has developed the ability naturally through experiments he performed on his wife’s embryo. The experiment killed her while his son Jason survived. His attack on The Electrician caused the hero to leave the superhero business life after severing his right arm and almost causing him to bleed out. In the fight, Molecule lost the use of his legs and his left arm becoming disabled.

name: Sisica Amberethe
description:
Abilities: Can lower the temperature of almost anything including lava

Cold natured and has a strong dislike of children after losing her own during birth because of her low body temperature. Sisica came to Elitsyia to find a cure for her condition but was abducted into the Villain Core after killing a man because he spanked his child.

name: Julian French
description: Fighting the New Society of Heroes pushed this previously calm man to becoming a villain on his own right. He can remove sound from any area and move through sound like dimensions where he see them as colors. This allows him to appear anywhere on Earth as long as sound is heard there.
abilities: Steals sound; Can teleport through sound like dimensions

name: Connor Anson
description: Archenemy of Elite Boy and his father Elite Man. He is a mad scientist that often can be seen creating gadgets that grants him a wide range of abilities. He is highly intelligent, often beating other heroes except Elite Boy and Elite Man much to his dismay. He is a billionaire and has labs, homes, and bases of operations around the world. He is the leader and financial benefactor behind the Villain Core.
abilities: Human; Great inventor; Intelligence; Martial artist

name: Wave of Chaos
description: As their name applies, this group of villains have spread across the globe causing everything from pety crimes to bringing down networks of money. From that they also have goals to unleash Hell on Earth with the help of Armageddon.

name: Davim
description: Davim is a demonic frog like creature that serves as active member of the Wave of Chaos, he can shapeshift and has a great passion for learning and history often seen stealing books from librarys and even protecting libraries. He serves all the lords and is ultimate slave to the Dark Lord.
abilities: Frog like abilities; Omnisense; Magical abilties

name: Skolum
description: Skolum has been one of the dark figures often seen in the shadows of almost every battle or fight on earth. His main ability is to induce anger and fear in his subjects thus making one fight or appear helpless. His giant black hat is said to mask his decaying face. He carries a whip of wires and fire and can control his subjects if the whip touches them. He often is seen riding a giant beast creature called, Launny. He uses Launny to often freeze his enemies or to eat their souls.
abilities: Induces Anger; Fear; Manipulate behavior; Can turn into crows

name: Ambrosus
description: Ambrosus is a jokster at heart and often finds himself not caring to fight however he is easily angered and adores the time he can make jokes on others even his own race of demons. It is believed that he inspired the first prankster and joking even amongst the gods. Some say that he and Loki are one of a kind and both are incarnations of each other because of their similar nature. Ambrosus uses several magic tricks to manipulate reality. He is youngest sibling to Umbrin.

name: Vibraxus
description: Vibraxus carries the scales of Libra and from them he can manipulate balance and often manipulate fate. His very body is a portal to Eternity and from his hands he can omit giant waves of dark energy. Vibraxus and is one of the most powerful and sought out demons in Hell. From his temple he watches over Belckus hoping one day his master is revived. He found Umbrin and the two wonders the globe finding souls strong enough to break the 7 temples however it has proven hard with the battle with the Nightwalkers.
abilities: Scales of Libra; Dark Energy Waves

name: Tetelia
description: Tetelia is a beautiful woman that was once scorned by a man that left bruses around her body and ultimately raped her. She returned the hatred by killing him, his wife, and three children in their sleep. Her rampage travelled through time and she found the lost soul of a witch. She took the soul into her and from here she used her abilities to kiss anyone killing them instantely, she can change her body into virtually anything and is a skilled weaponist (learning how to use virtually any weapon). From this moment she was sought out by Umbrin and led his army for most of the early human civilization.
abilities: Skilled weaponist; Ninja like reflexes; Kiss of death; Body manipulation

name: Umbrin
description: Umbrin is one of the many sons to Belckus and made it his purpose to please his father by slowly opening the temples that guards his father’s prison. However to do this he needs the souls of powerful beings, thus him stealing Versah. He sent the Wave of Chaos out to destroy those that impose a threat to him and to collect souls of powerful beings and creatures alike from the world. So far he has open 1 out of 7 sealed temples. One of Umbrin’s sons is Caldrone & Lord Behemoth. His daughter Lady Deaththreat is one of his favorite children because of lack of emotions and constant victories. She was however defeated and he took her soul, her egg was reborn however in life.
abilities: Manipulate souls; Use them as weapons

name: Waveform
description: This group of high strong heroines formed with the sole mission to liberate women rights and take over from the men who have been in charge for too long. Besides their causes, they also fight real supernatural crimes as well.

name: Kia Strong
description: During her youth, Kia Strong was given her name Soundcage because of her unique abilities and often crying screams that can break almost any known structure. It is once thought by her father a scientist, that she created the sound barriers around her body to protect herself from the car crash that killed her mother when she was only 4 years old. Since then, her abilities have created ring like structures made of sound around her body, her suit was made by her father and since then she has been a hero fighting against experiments that her father’s company has since created.
abilities: Sound waves surrounding body; Released from body as attacks; Can break glass; The sound barrier

name: Samantha Woo
description:
Abilities: Strink body to the size of an insect

Born in southern China, Samantha Woo, Samanthan or SW as her friends called her, has always been a fan of science and once created a body suit which gave her supernatural abilities to strink and grow at incredible sizes. She later found out that she also could take the form of a butterfly with the suit and received its features and abilities. With the suit she can also shoot beams and has acute hearing & enhanced speed. She traveled the world to find the renowned Atticus Strong believing she could become his assistant. However she would later join his daughter’s super-hero team where she became Lady Butterfly.
abilities: Butterfly like features; Lazer beams from hands; Enhanced agility; Can grow body

name: Luka Seionus
description: The first to join the all girl superhero group Waveform, she was recruited by Atticus Strong to help his daughter stop the destruction of Elite City by several evil experiments from his previous employer. She has inherited a belt from her ancestors that can give the person that wears it superhuman strength, speed, and cat like reflexes. Its believed that this belt was made and handed down to worshipers of the goddess The Cat. Luka’s personality is very reserved and often laidback with more fight than words in her. However it is seen that when she speaks, she talks in rhymes and selective tongue.
abilities: Cat like reflexes; Magical belt which can cause invisibility; Super strength; Enhanced agility

name: Carla Tentress
description:
Abilities: Can sing a song that hypnotizes anyone close by; Has since grown to blasts opponents with enhanced soundwaves

Carla Tentress is a beautiful model that was born in Russia on December 23rd, 1984. She shares a unique ability to her mother a Seefor which allows her to sing melodies that can control men and cause emotional unbalance in women. Her body is soft like cotton and her hair is unusually always wet, it is believed that she was born on the island of Seefors and her mother sent her away so that she could grow up and uses her abilities differently than her. Carla was once apart of Waveform before turning into a villain, believing that her abilities should be used differently than what the group originally wanted for her which was to lure evil men into being good.

name: Wild 4
description: This team may not want to be mascots for the public zoo, but they could. Each of them have abilities resembling a different type of animal. It could be how they look, the type of power, or their preferred outfit, this group takes pride in their appearances regardless of being also outcasts in the public.

name: Pedra Hopkens
description: Born in England, Pedra Hopkens was sent off to SAA where she left shortly after to join the Circus Family and later the Wild 4. She has a tiger like body with fast reflexes and razor sharp claws. Like her fellow teammates she uses her unique appearance as a way to unite others like herself.
abilities: Tiger like appearance; Razor sharp claws

name: Jesse Rince
description: Jesse Rince like his peers was immediately dispelled from his home as an infant and was forced to grow up alone. He quickly joined Wild 4 in hopes to be surrounded by his own kind and get back at his parents & society for outcasting him.
abilities: Falcon like appearance; Razor sharp beak; Giant wings

name: Fera Jogens
description: Fera Jogens grew up unlike her teammates surrounded by love in an underwater palace south of Merlantia named Fushia. She was destined to be queen however because of her estranged marriage, she ran away from home. Fera now on the streets and known as Paladia uses her sonic hearing & fish like swimming abilities assist with the other members of Wild 4.

name: Peter Potor
description: With unknown parents and even dismissed by his own kind, Peter saw hatred by everyone and admitted it back to everyone he encountered. However, once he met the other members of Wild 4, he quickly grew to call them family and begin to lead them in battles choosing neither good nor evil in their fights.

name: Tony Stewart
description: Tony was a part of an experiment that led him to his death. Here he was injected with blood of a wolf that allowed him to gain claws and beastly features at night. He was also injected a strange aloid that gave him indestructible claws, skin, and nearly immortality. Tony in the world as a new man now was able to fight those that experimented on him. He shortly after joined Elite Force and later the Wild 4 as their leader.

name: Michael Nuculus
description:
Abilities: Durability Genius level intelligence Accelerated healing factor Pheromone manipulation

No one knew better of the opposing sides of good and evil Descendants better than Michael Nuculus “Rampage”. He worked as a spy with the Wild 4 at one time, Elite Force, and later as a rogue. For a moment his knowledge of the several teams led him to gather knowledge of both sides to eventually creating his own super powered team to fight to end the war between the two sides called The Outsiders. During his early teens he was merely a strong human with monkey like reflexes until he sprouted fur and small horns that caused him to hide in the shadows. He met several others like himself and joined the Wild 4 and left their team to become a member of Elite Force, however after leaving their team, he became leader of his own team.
abilities: Animal-like physiology Abnormal strength; Speed; Stamina; Agility; Razor sharp claws; Teeth

name: Witches Haven
description: A coven of witches who specializes in the elements. Coming together after each one of them have experienced a loss, rather it’s a cheating husband or loss of a child. The Witches Haven is a spellbinding troupe of empowered women whom fights the forces of darkness each day.

name: Sabrina Falcon
description: Sabrina is descendant of a group of witches that once were followers to Bewithia, the Witch Goddess. She helps create the Witch Haven as a way to help protect magic at all cost in the human world. Although it is later discovered that the Witch Haven has existed for almost 3,000 years and has started with some of the original followers of Bewithia.
abilities: Magical Abilities; Mostly over snow; Ice

name: Brenda Elswood
description: Brenda is a descendant of a group of witches that followed and worshipped Bewithia the Witch goddess almost 3,000 years ago. Her ancestors practiced mostly in defensive magic and as time passed, her magic itself would become darker in terms of being able to control heat and fire. She joined the Witch Haven in hopes to protect magic and magical beings; she once attended Anura in her youth.
abilities: Magical Abilities; Mostly over fire; Heat

name: Debra Heinsworth
description: Debra’s ancestors protected magic and followed the witch goddess Bewithia. They foretold of a school name Anura in which magic would call focus and here people would gather to learn more about magic and how to control their own. She would become a teacher at the school and often fighter amongst the Witches Haven as its eldest member. Her magic is strong and is often used in conjunction with wind and water to produce elemental attacks.
abilities: Magical Abilities; Extensive uses of water; Wind like elemental attacks

name: World Pirates
description: Just when you thought pirates were gone or lost amongst the seven seas, you are mistaken. General Boahmog somehow survived his mysterious disappearance 200 years ago when he fought Blackbeard to the death.

name: General Boahmog
description: General Boahmog is one of the galaxy’s most ruthless villians. His body is bullet proof, he tumbles mountains with one punch, and can control the minds of others. With the help of his self-created titans, the World Pirates. General Boahmog travels the universe stealing the life forms of every planet and star they can reach allowing them to gain vast amount of strength and to live longer.

name: World Pirates
description:
Age: Hundreds of years old

Behemoth like statues that has no heart and uses the brain signal of their master to move and take on instructions. Like the titans of greek mythology, these giant creatures can also take on human like forms while also acting on their own with the help of magic. They are led by General Boahmog.

name: X Team
description: One of the few groups that was formed off of Earth and has no contact with it whatsoever. When Lynk met the boys, he didn’t think of creating a group but a bond was formed and the three lives out their lives as normal in a dimensional holding place.

name: Lynk
description:
Abilities: Can close any gateway or dimensional access. Also can access any gateway or entrance

Age: 105 years old (appears 10)

A dimensional wrecker who goal is to abolish all travel throughout the dimensional gates that links the many different worlds. His appearance is like a suited boy with red and black streaks across his body. His razor sharp hair is sharper than glass.

name: Gera Holmes
description:
Abilities: Physical pain from others that are nearby

His mutation caused him to feel the pain of others either physically or mentally. This is later translated into a very powerful burst of energy that can disrupt time and space if he releases it from his body. He was banished to another dimension in an attempt to prevent that very explosion. He meets up with Lynk and the two share a bond.
abilities: Takes in emotional; Releases it in an atomic blast

name: Colnard Zuppa
description:
Abilities: Can transfer pain from one being to another

Age: 14 (appearance)

Colnard was born without parents and almost exist to live alone in his entire dimension. How he got there or why is there is unknown. The only person that can see him is Lynk because of Lynk’s special power to access any gateway. His appearance is that of a frail boy with scars around his body. Lynk meets him and the two along with Boom (Gera Holmes) form a sort of brother ship which they call the X Team. Scars appears on his back whenever he uses his power, it could be taken into account that the amount of scars he has on his back may indicate that he was trapped here for using his powers on others.

name: Young Supreme
description: Gifted youngsters from around the world. United to serve as a super powered team that no one would expect to fight crime because of their innocent appearances and ages.

name: Jenna Colgastein
description: Joining the Young Supreme at a young age, Jenna shows little sign of someone at her age because of her adult intelligence, behavior, and lazer eyes which causes her to wear sun shades to protect others from the radiation from her eyes. Jenna became the youngest member of any team across the world. In Young Supreme she represents Europe.

name: Vella Vummage
description: Vella was born in Russia to a Soviet leader and a barmaid. Since she was young, Vella had the power to shoot green volts of energy from her hands. She became Russia’s first superhero after joining Young Supreme. Vella represents Asia.

name: Silar Onage
description: Silar was one of the original members of the Young Supreme. After entering high school, Silar became the Day Rider and learned kung fu in order to beat his opponents. Day Rider later found several other members after using his sister’s computer to contact other special youths across the world. Each member represents a different continent. Silar represents North America.

name: Jet Rodgers
description: Jet Rodgers is the goofy team member of Young Supreme, often using his wits and prehistoric transformations to get out of situations often seeming impossible to escape.  Jet has the unique abilities to transform into prehistoric and imaginary creatures using a magical pendant that he wears around his neck and a watch that he wears around his arm both impossible to remove even while showering.
abilities: Can transform into prehistoric; Imaginary creatures using a magical pendant; Watch

name: Android X
description: Android X was created years before the Englishmen swarmed North America. During the moments of their last years, the Indians created this robot out of magic and with the help of their gods believing that they needed a way if not to protect them then to carry on their knowledge to future generations. Android x was model after a female goddess that died protecting the Wachuci clan. It joined the Young Supreme after almost 200 years because it was reprogramed with a child’s personality by the Young Watchmen.

name: Debroid
description: Debroid is the world’s smartest person; her intelligence can stretch to nearly god like as she grows older. She joined the Young Supreme after finding out about their vision to help save the world. She help reprogram Android X with the personality of a young child as believing that it would be more helpful and erased it’s memories of its previous existence with the Indians in hopes that it won’t seek vengeance. As of Chapter 13, Debroid becomes the Young Watchman and learns how to use a psychic blast from her head.

name: Z-Team
description: An enforcer team sent out by various villain commanders to cause great havoc on unexpected heroes and normal citizens. This group has powers that range from bad to very bad.

name: Letis Gollard
description: Letis is one of the most powerful psychics known. He is able to use psychic blasts from his hands and with a direct hit; his abilities can drain someone’s body energy forcing them to surrender. At one moment he was part of the Z-Team

name: Asinta Arnoldia
description: Asinta Arnoldia came to the Z-Team hoping to find answers of where her sister was taken. She has spikes erected from her body and can shoot it outward as rapid rates. At one moment in her life she was a residence and student at SAA.

name: Gasby Wills
description: Gasby Wills is a prominent super-human of Z-Team as she has a unique ability to turn herself to pure stone. Her body then becomes stronger than diamond and gold together while also enhancing her strength and ability to maximum levels. Gasby is also called Stone Girl.

name: Galland Miphop
description: Galland can absorb any object’s structure pattern to match its body detail. In some cases, this ability can make Galland also called Aluminum Man stronger than his original form.

name: Mike Illian
description: Mike Illian is a mutant that cannot just teleport he but teleport others by simply thinking of them or the object in question. Mike is known as Sector and is a part of the Z-Team.

name: Zeta 4
description: Teenagers acting as vigilantes, with no code to live by. This group only acts on their own will and own code. Formed to do what they want and when they want it. Rather robbing a bank or saving the day.

name: Patrick Benworth
description: Considering he team leader, Patrick discovered a hidden lab that was abandon mysteriously near his home town. It was believed to be where scientists were working on a way to create Descendants. Him and his crew of friends were playing around in the lab when an chemical accident gave them super powers. Although at times wild and out of control, they try their best to keep their abilities a secret in fear of someone finding out about them and making them into lab experiments.
abilities: Super human Strength; Flight; Super hearing; Super Speed; Sonic voice

name: James Rhodes
description: James always wanted to be a teacher of Geology because of his love of the Earth and “in his words, Earth and its many wonders”. James with his friends found an abandoned lab which would be the location where they would get their abnormal like abilities.
abilities: Super human Strength; Flight; Super hearing; Super Speed; Earthquakes

name: Dorian Redd
description: Constantly bullied in school, Dorian had a fascination with comics and its vivid outlook on heroes and how they are usually classified with kids like him before finding their true calling in life. When his friends found an abandon lab, Dorian became the one who wanted to propel their abilities to the next level, often causing destruction wherever he wanted. He killed those that bullied him through school and murder his family because of molestation when he was a child. He later revealed all this to the police before throwing them across a parking lot. He would become a villain of his own and often fighting the team he once was apart of.
abilities: Super human Strength; Flight; Super hearing; Super Speed; Telekinesis

name: Connor Ambrosius
description: Considered to one who has his head on straight in the group. Connor Ambrosius received his abiltiies like his friends in a lab experiment during which he received the ability over lightning. Considered one of the most powerful of his group next to ex-member Dorian, Connor also called Strike found he leading the group at times and often battling Mindcore in similar battles. Connor’s past unlike his friends are a complete mystery with most of past surrounding his parents being scientist that were killed. It is believed that his parents were two of the scientist involved in the same experiments that gave the group their abilities.
abilities: Super human Strength; Flight; Super hearing; Super Speed; Lightning
